	// ── Constants ──
	const KIND_NAMES: Record<number, string> = {
		30006: 'Contract',
		31006: 'ContractStatus',
		30007: 'Bid',
		30008: 'BidStatus',
		31000: 'Task',
		31002: 'RecurringTask',
		5: 'Deletion',
		0: 'ProfileMeta',
		4: 'DM',
		1984: 'Report',

		30063: 'ProfileImg',

	const TASK_STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
		OPEN: 'Open',
		BID_ACCEPTED: 'Bid Accepted',
		ESCROW_FUNDED: 'Escrow Funded',
		IN_PROGRESS: 'In Progress',
		RESCOPED: 'Rescoped',
		RESCOPE_ACCEPTED: 'Rescope Accepted',

		CANCELLED: 'Cancelled',
		REFUNDED: 'Refunded',
		DISPUTED: 'Disputed',
		DISPUTE_PROPOSAL: 'Dispute Proposal'
	};

	const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {

		'12': 'PendingFunding',
		'13': 'InProgress',
		pending: 'pending',
		accepted: 'accepted'
	};

	// ── State ──
	let npub = $state('');
	let hexPubkey = $state('');
	let relay = $state('wss://relay1.bittasker.com');
	let customRelay = $state('');
	let relayMode = $state<'preset' | 'custom'>('preset');
	let connected = $state(false);
	let connecting = $state(false);
	let events: (NostrEvent & { _role?: string })[] = $state([]);
	let logLines: { text: string; type: string; time: string }[] = $state([]);
	let view = $state<'timeline' | 'chain' | 'raw'>('timeline');
	let expandedEvents = $state(new Set<string>());
	let selectedKinds = $state(new Set([30006, 31006, 30007, 30008]));
	let showAuthor = $state(true);
	let showParticipant = $state(true);
	let pool: SimplePool | null = null;

	// Profile cache
	let profiles = $state(
		new Map<string, { name?: string; picture?: string; created_at?: number }>()
	);

	// Section toggles
	let section = $state<'explorer' | 'task-inspector' | 'profile-inspector'>('explorer');

	// Task inspector state
	let taskInspectorDtag = $state('');
	let taskInspectorLoading = $state(false);
	let taskInspectorEvents: (NostrEvent & { _role?: string })[] = $state([]);
	let taskInspectorAuthorProfile: { name?: string; picture?: string; created_at?: number } | null =
		$state(null);
	let taskInspectorParsedContent: Record<string, unknown> | null = $state(null);

	// Profile inspector state
	let profileInspectorInput = $state('');
	let profileInspectorLoading = $state(false);

		name?: string;
		picture?: string;
		about?: string;
		created_at?: number;
		relays?: string[];
	} | null = $state(null);

	// ── Helpers ──
	function addLog(text: string, type: string = 'info') {
		logLines = [...logLines, { text, type, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString() }];
	}
	function short(h: string | undefined, n: number = 8): string {
		if (!h) return '(none)';
		return h.slice(0, n) + '...' + h.slice(-n);
	}
	function fmtTime(ts: number): string {
		return new Date(ts * 1000).toISOString().replace('T', ' ').slice(0, 19);
	}
	function tagVal(tags: string[][], key: string): string | null {
		return tags.find((t) => t[0] === key)?.[1] ?? null;
	}
	function kindName(kind: number): string {
		return KIND_NAMES[kind] || `Kind-${kind}`;
	}
	function kindColor(kind: number): string {
		const c: Record<number, string> = {
			30006: '#6366f1',
			31006: '#06b6d4',
			30007: '#f59e0b',
			30008: '#f97316',
			31000: '#a855f7',
			5: '#ef4444',
			0: '#22c55e',
			10002: '#e879f9'
		};
		return c[kind] || '#8b90a0';
	}
	function statusLabel(s: string | null): string {
		if (!s) return '';
		return TASK_STATUS_LABELS[s] || STATUS_LABELS[s] || s;
	}
	function decodeNpub(input: string): string | null {
		const t = input.trim();
		if (/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/.test(t)) return t;
		if (t.startsWith('npub1')) {
			try {
				const d = nip19.decode(t);
				return d.type === 'npub' ? d.data : null;
			} catch {
				return null;
			}
		}
		if (t.startsWith('nprofile1')) {
			try {
				const d = nip19.decode(t);
				return (d as { data?: { pubkey?: string } }).data?.pubkey || null;
			} catch {
				return null;
			}
		}
		return null;
	}
	function profileName(hex: string): string | null {
		const p = profiles.get(hex);
		return p?.name || null;
	}

	// ── Profile batch fetch ──
	async function resolveProfiles(pubkeys: string[]) {
		if (!pool || pubkeys.length === 0) return;
		const unique = [...new Set(pubkeys)].filter((k) => !profiles.has(k));
		if (unique.length === 0) return;
		try {
			const results = await pool.querySync([relay], {
				kinds: [0],
				authors: unique,
				limit: unique.length
			});
			for (const e of results) {
				try {
					const c = JSON.parse(e.content);
					profiles.set(e.pubkey, {
						name: c.display_name || c.displayName || c.name,
						picture: c.picture,
						created_at: e.created_at
					});
				} catch {
					profiles.set(e.pubkey, {});
				}
			}
			// Mark unfound
			for (const k of unique) {
				if (!profiles.has(k)) profiles.set(k, {});
			}
		} catch (e) {
			addLog(`Profile fetch error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error'}`, 'error');
		}
	}

	// ── Connect (Event Explorer) ──
	async function connect() {
		const hex = decodeNpub(npub);
		if (!hex) {
			addLog('Invalid npub or hex', 'error');
			return;
		}
		hexPubkey = hex;
		if (pool) disconnect();
		connecting = true;
		pool = new SimplePool();

		const kinds =
			selectedKinds.size > 0 ? Array.from(selectedKinds) : [30006, 31006, 30007, 30008, 31000];
		addLog(`Connecting to ${relay}...`, 'info');
		addLog(`Querying: kinds=[${kinds.join(',')}], author+p-tag, limit=500`, 'info');

		try {
			const [authored, participant] = await Promise.all([
				pool.querySync([relay], { kinds, authors: [hex], limit: 500 }),
				pool.querySync([relay], { kinds, '#p': [hex], limit: 500 })
			]);
			addLog(`Authored: ${authored.length}, Participant: ${participant.length}`, 'success');

			const map = new Map<string, NostrEvent & { _role?: string }>();
			for (const e of authored) map.set(e.id, { ...e, _role: 'author' });
			for (const e of participant) {
				if (map.has(e.id)) map.get(e.id)!._role = 'author+participant';
				else map.set(e.id, { ...e, _role: 'participant' });
			}
			events = [...map.values()].sort((a, b) => b.created_at - a.created_at);
			connected = true;
			addLog(`Total unique events: ${events.length}`, 'success');

			// Resolve profiles for all unique pubkeys
			const allPubkeys = new Set<string>();
			for (const e of events) {
				allPubkeys.add(e.pubkey);
				for (const t of e.tags) {
					if (t[0] === 'p' && t[1]) allPubkeys.add(t[1]);
				}
			}
			await resolveProfiles([...allPubkeys]);

			// Diagnosis
			if (!events.some((e) => e.kind === 30006))
				addLog('⚠ NO Contract events (30006) — contracts tab will be empty', 'error');
			if (!events.some((e) => e.kind === 31006))
				addLog('⚠ NO Contract Status events (31006)', 'error');
			if (!events.some((e) => e.kind === 30008))
				addLog('⚠ NO Bid Status events (30008) — no bids accepted', 'error');
		} catch (e) {
			addLog(`Error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error'}`, 'error');
		} finally {
			connecting = false;
		}
	}

	function disconnect() {
		if (pool) {
			pool.close([relay]);
			pool = null;
		}
		connected = false;
		events = [];
		hexPubkey = '';
		profiles = new Map();
	}

	function toggleKind(kind: number) {
		if (selectedKinds.has(kind)) selectedKinds.delete(kind);
		else selectedKinds.add(kind);
		selectedKinds = new Set(selectedKinds);
	}
	function toggleExpand(id: string) {
		if (expandedEvents.has(id)) expandedEvents.delete(id);
		else expandedEvents.add(id);
		expandedEvents = new Set(expandedEvents);
	}

	function filteredEvents(): (NostrEvent & { _role?: string })[] {
		return events.filter((e) => {
			if (!selectedKinds.has(e.kind)) return false;
			const role = e._role || '';
			if (!showAuthor && role.includes('author')) return false;
			if (!showParticipant && role === 'participant') return false;
			return true;
		});
	}

	function kindCounts(): Record<number, number> {
		const counts: Record<number, number> = {};
		for (const e of events) counts[e.kind] = (counts[e.kind] || 0) + 1;
		return counts;
	}

	// ── Task Inspector ──
	async function inspectTask() {
		const dtag = taskInspectorDtag.trim();
		if (!dtag) {
			addLog('Enter a task d-tag or slug', 'error');
			return;
		}
		if (!pool) {
			// Create a fresh pool if not connected
			pool = new SimplePool();
		}
		taskInspectorLoading = true;
		taskInspectorEvents = [];
		taskInspectorAuthorProfile = null;
		taskInspectorParsedContent = null;

		try {
			// Query kind 31000 by d-tag
			const taskEvents = await pool.querySync([relay], { kinds: [31000], '#d': [dtag], limit: 5 });
			addLog(
				`Task events found by d-tag: ${taskEvents.length}`,
				taskEvents.length > 0 ? 'success' : 'error'
			);

			if (taskEvents.length > 0) {
				const taskEvent = taskEvents[0];
				try {
					taskInspectorParsedContent = JSON.parse(taskEvent.content);
				} catch {
					taskInspectorParsedContent = { _raw: taskEvent.content };
				}

				// Fetch author profile
				const authorHex = taskEvent.pubkey;
				const profileEvents = await pool.querySync([relay], {
					kinds: [0],
					authors: [authorHex],
					limit: 1
				});
				if (profileEvents.length > 0) {
					try {
						const c = JSON.parse(profileEvents[0].content);
						taskInspectorAuthorProfile = {
							name: c.display_name || c.displayName || c.name,
							picture: c.picture,
							created_at: profileEvents[0].created_at
						};
					} catch {
						taskInspectorAuthorProfile = {};
					}
				}

				// Fetch events with this task's #t tag (bids, contracts, statuses)
				const taskTagEvents = await pool.querySync([relay], {
					kinds: [30006, 31006, 30007, 30008, 5],
					'#t': [dtag],
					limit: 200
				});
				addLog(`Related events (by #t tag): ${taskTagEvents.length}`, 'info');

				// Fetch deletion events targeting the task event
				const deletionEvents = await pool.querySync([relay], {
					kinds: [5],
					'#e': [taskEvent.id],
					limit: 10
				});

				// Merge all
				const allEvents = [...taskEvents, ...taskTagEvents, ...deletionEvents];
				const dedup = new Map<string, NostrEvent & { _role?: string }>();
				for (const e of allEvents) {
					if (!dedup.has(e.id)) {
						dedup.set(e.id, { ...e, _role: e.pubkey === authorHex ? 'author' : 'participant' });
					}
				}
				taskInspectorEvents = [...dedup.values()].sort((a, b) => a.created_at - b.created_at);

				// Resolve all profiles
				const allPubkeys = new Set<string>();
				for (const e of taskInspectorEvents) {
					allPubkeys.add(e.pubkey);
					for (const t of e.tags) {
						if ((t[0] === 'p' || t[0] === 'e') && t[1]) allPubkeys.add(t[1]);
					}
				}
				await resolveProfiles([...allPubkeys]);
			}
		} catch (e) {
			addLog(`Task inspect error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error'}`, 'error');
		} finally {
			taskInspectorLoading = false;
		}
	}

	// ── Profile Inspector ──
	async function inspectProfile() {
		const input = profileInspectorInput.trim();
		const hex = decodeNpub(input);
		if (!hex) {
			addLog('Invalid npub/hex for profile lookup', 'error');
			return;
		}
		if (!pool) {
			pool = new SimplePool();
		}

		profileInspectorLoading = true;
		profileInspectorEvents = [];
		profileInspectorData = null;

		try {
			const kinds = [0, 30063, 10002, 30000, 30002];
			const results = await pool.querySync([relay], { kinds, authors: [hex], limit: 20 });
			profileInspectorEvents = results.sort((a, b) => b.created_at - a.created_at);
			addLog(`Profile events found: ${results.length}`, 'success');

			// Parse kind 0
			const kind0 = results.find((e) => e.kind === 0);
			if (kind0) {
				try {
					const c = JSON.parse(kind0.content);
					profileInspectorData = {
						name: c.display_name || c.displayName || c.name,
						picture: c.picture,
						about: c.about,
						created_at: kind0.created_at
					};
				} catch {
					profileInspectorData = {};
				}
			}

			// Parse relay list
			const kind10002 = results.find((e) => e.kind === 10002);
			if (kind10002) {
				const relays = kind10002.tags
					.filter((t) => t[0] === 'r' && t[1])
					.map((t) => t[1] + (t[2] || ''));
				if (profileInspectorData) {
					profileInspectorData.relays = relays;
				} else {
					profileInspectorData = { relays };
				}
			}

			if (!profileInspectorData) {
				profileInspectorData = {};
				addLog('⚠ No kind 0 (profile metadata) found — user has no profile', 'error');
			}
		} catch (e) {
			addLog(`Profile inspect error: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Unknown error'}`, 'error');
		} finally {
			profileInspectorLoading = false;
		}
	}

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (pool) pool.close([relay]);
	});
</script>

	<!-- SECTION 3: Profile Inspector -->

	{#if section === 'profile-inspector'}

						class:expanded={expandedEvents.has(e.id)}
						onclick={() => toggleExpand(e.id)}
					>
						<div class="event-header">
							<span
								class="kind-badge"
								style="background:{kindColor(e.kind)}22;color:{kindColor(e.kind)}"

							>
							<span class="time">{fmtTime(e.created_at)}</span>
							<span class="pubkey">id: {short(e.id, 6)}</span>

						{#if expandedEvents.has(e.id)}
							<div class="event-detail">
								<div class="tags">
									{#each e.tags as tag}<span class="tag"
											><b>#{tag[0]}</b>={tag.slice(1).join(', ')}</span
										>{/each}
								</div>
								<pre class="raw">{e.content?.length > 2000
										? e.content.slice(0, 2000) + '...'
										: e.content || '(empty)'}</pre>
							</div>
						{/if}
					</button>
				{/each}
			</div>
		{/if}
	{/if}

	<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
	<!-- Log -->
	<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
	{#if logLines.length > 0}
		<div class="log">

				<div class="log-line {l.type}"><span class="log-time">{l.time}</span> {l.text}</div>
			{/each}
		</div>
	{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	// Import polyfills FIRST before any other imports that might use Buffer/bitcoinjs-lib
	import '$lib/polyfills';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { SvelteMap, SvelteSet } from 'svelte/reactivity';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { walletStore, walletManager } from '$lib/stores/wallet.store';
	import { ndk } from '$lib/nostr/ndk';
	import KINDS from '$lib/utils/constants/kinds';
	import type { EscrowData } from '$lib/types/wallet';
	import type { ContractPermissions } from '$lib/types/contract';
	import { ContractStatus } from '$lib/utils/contract/types';
	import {
		completeTask,
		acceptTask,
		disputeTask,
		proposeResolution,
		acceptProposal,
		resolveAfterTimelock,
		cancelPaymentContract
	} from '$lib/utils/contract/v1/blockchainWrites';
	import { ethers } from 'ethers';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import { getErrorMessage } from '$lib/utils/wallet/contractErrorHandler';
	import DebugContractCard from '$lib/components/contracts/DebugContractCard.svelte';
	import { get } from 'svelte/store';
	import IconRefresh from '~icons/mdi/refresh';
	import IconChevronDown from '~icons/mdi/chevron-down';
	import IconChevronUp from '~icons/mdi/chevron-up';
	import IconContentCopy from '~icons/mdi/content-copy';
	import IconOpenInNew from '~icons/mdi/open-in-new';
	import ConfirmModal from '$lib/components/ConfirmModal.svelte';

	interface ContractWithPermissions extends EscrowData {
		permissions: ContractPermissions;
		isClient: boolean;
		isFreelancer: boolean;
		userAddress: string;
	}

	interface WalletAddressGroup {
		address: string;
		network: 'RSK' | 'BSC';
		contracts: ContractWithPermissions[];
		isExpanded: boolean;
		isLoading: boolean;
		error: string | null;
	}

	// State (SvelteMap/SvelteSet are reactive without $state)
	let contractsByAddress = new SvelteMap<string, WalletAddressGroup>();
	let safetyOverride = $state(false);
	let executingActions = new SvelteMap<string, boolean>();
	let expandedContracts = new SvelteSet<string>();
	let showOverrideConfirm = $state(false);
	let initialLoadComplete = $state(false);

	// Get connected wallet addresses
	function getConnectedAddresses(): Array<{ address: string; network: 'RSK' | 'BSC' }> {
		const state = get(walletStore);
		const addresses: Array<{ address: string; network: 'RSK' | 'BSC' }> = [];

		if (state.rsk.connected && state.rsk.address) {
			addresses.push({ address: state.rsk.address, network: 'RSK' });
		}

		if (state.bsc.connected && state.bsc.address) {
			addresses.push({ address: state.bsc.address, network: 'BSC' });
		}

		return addresses;
	}

	// Calculate permissions for a contract
	async function calculatePermissions(
		contract: EscrowData,
		userAddress: string
	): Promise<{ permissions: ContractPermissions; isClient: boolean; isFreelancer: boolean }> {
		// Defensive check for undefined addresses
		const clientAddr = contract.client?.toLowerCase() || '';
		const freelancerAddr = contract.freelancer?.toLowerCase() || '';
		const userAddr = userAddress?.toLowerCase() || '';
		const isClient = clientAddr !== '' && clientAddr === userAddr;
		const isFreelancer = freelancerAddr !== '' && freelancerAddr === userAddr;

		// Load dispute proposal if contract is in dispute
		// Note: Debug view has no Nostr status events; dispute proposal left as null
		if (contract.status === ContractStatus.InDispute) {
			// Debug view does not load Nostr status events, so dispute proposal is unavailable
		}

		const permissions = {
			canComplete: isFreelancer,
			canAccept: isClient,
			canDispute: isClient,
			canPropose: false,
			canAcceptProposal: false,
			canCancel: isClient,
			canRefund: isFreelancer,
			canResolveTimelock: false,
			canDelete: false
		};

		return { permissions, isClient, isFreelancer };
	}

	// function findLoadedContract(contractId: string): ContractWithPermissions | undefined {
	// 	for (const group of contractsByAddress.values()) {
	// 		const found = group.contracts.find((c) => c.id === contractId);
	// 		if (found) return found;
	// 	}
	// 	return undefined;
	// }

	// Load contracts for a specific address
	async function loadContractsForAddress(address: string, network: 'RSK' | 'BSC') {
		const key = `${network}-${address}`;

		const group = contractsByAddress.get(key);

		if (group) {
			// Create a new group object to trigger reactivity
			contractsByAddress.set(key, {
				...group,
				isLoading: true,
				error: null
			});
		} else {
			contractsByAddress.set(key, {
				address,
				network,
				contracts: [],
				isExpanded: true,
				isLoading: true,
				error: null
			});
		}

		try {
			const events = await ndk.fetchEvents(
				{ kinds: [KINDS.CONTRACT], '#p': [address], limit: 100 },
				{ closeOnEose: true }
			);
			const contracts = [...events].map((ev) => {
				const pTags = ev.tags.filter((t: string[]) => t[0] === 'p').map((t: string[]) => t[1]);
				const sTag = ev.tags.find((t: string[]) => t[0] === 's')?.[1];
				const dTag = ev.tags.find((t: string[]) => t[0] === 'd')?.[1];
				const amountTag = ev.tags.find((t: string[]) => t[0] === 'amount')?.[1];
				return {
					id: dTag ?? '',
					client: pTags[0] ?? '',
					freelancer: pTags[1] ?? address,
					baseAmount: amountTag ?? '0',
					clientFee: '0',
					freelancerFee: '0',
					totalAmount: amountTag ?? '0',
					status: sTag ? parseInt(sTag, 10) : 0,
					estimatedStartTime: 0,
					estimatedCompletionTime: 0,
					completionTime: 0,
					timelockExpiry: 0,
					clientFeeTier: 0,
					freelancerFeeTier: 0,
					createdAt: ev.created_at ?? 0,
					lastUpdated: ev.created_at ?? 0
				} as unknown as EscrowData;
			});

			const contractsWithPermissions: ContractWithPermissions[] = await Promise.all(
				contracts.map(async (contract) => {
					const { permissions, isClient, isFreelancer } = await calculatePermissions(
						contract,
						address
					);
					return {
						...contract,
						permissions,
						isClient,
						isFreelancer,
						userAddress: address
					};
				})
			);
			const updatedGroup = contractsByAddress.get(key);
			if (updatedGroup) {
				contractsByAddress.set(key, {
					...updatedGroup,
					contracts: contractsWithPermissions,
					isLoading: false,
					error: null
				});
			}
		} catch (error) {
			const updatedGroup = contractsByAddress.get(key);
			if (updatedGroup) {
				contractsByAddress.set(key, {
					...updatedGroup,
					isLoading: false,
					error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to load contracts'
				});
			}
		}
	}

	// Load all contracts
	async function loadAllContracts() {
		// Reset cached contract - obsolete in new contract API
		// Contract address resolution uses env vars via getDefaultContractAddress

		const addresses = getConnectedAddresses();

		if (addresses.length === 0) {
			initialLoadComplete = true;
			appStore.showErrorToast($t('debug.smart_contract.no_contracts'));
			return;
		}

		initialLoadComplete = false;

		try {
			await Promise.all(
				addresses.map(({ address, network }) => loadContractsForAddress(address, network))
			);
		} catch {
			// Error handled by loadContractsForAddress per-address
		} finally {
			initialLoadComplete = true;
		}
	}

	// Toggle address expansion
	function toggleAddress(key: string) {
		const group = contractsByAddress.get(key);
		if (group) {
			contractsByAddress.set(key, {
				...group,
				isExpanded: !group.isExpanded
			});
		}
	}

	// Toggle contract raw data
	function toggleContractRawData(contractId: string) {
		if (expandedContracts.has(contractId)) {
			expandedContracts.delete(contractId);
		} else {
			expandedContracts.add(contractId);
		}
	}

	// Get default contract address from env vars
	function getDefaultContractAddress(): string | null {
		const network = import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_NETWORK || 'testnet';
		return network === 'mainnet'
			? import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_MAINNET
			: import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_CONTRACT_ADDRESS_TESTNET;
	}

	// Execute contract function
	async function executeContractFunction(
		contractId: string,
		functionName: string,
		...args: unknown[]
	) {
		const actionKey = `${contractId}-${functionName}`;
		executingActions.set(actionKey, true);

		try {
			const contractAddress = getDefaultContractAddress();
			if (!contractAddress) {
				throw new Error('Contract address not configured');
			}

			switch (functionName) {
				case 'completeTask':
					await completeTask(contractId, { contractAddress });
					break;
				case 'acceptTask':
					await acceptTask(contractId, { contractAddress });
					break;
				case 'cancelEscrow':
					await cancelPaymentContract(contractId, { contractAddress });
					break;
				case 'disputeTask':
					await disputeTask(contractId, { contractAddress });
					break;
				case 'proposeResolution': {
					const freelancerAmount =
						typeof args[0] === 'string' ? args[0] : args[0] != null ? String(args[0]) : '0';
					const freelancerAmountWei = ethers.parseEther(freelancerAmount);
					await proposeResolution(contractId, freelancerAmountWei, { contractAddress });
					break;
				}
				case 'acceptProposal':
					await acceptProposal(contractId, { contractAddress });
					break;
				case 'resolveAfterTimelock': {
					// resolveAfterTimelock only does the blockchain tx; Nostr event handling is separated
					await resolveAfterTimelock(contractId, { contractAddress });
					break;
				}
				default:
					throw new Error(`Unknown function: ${functionName}`);
			}

			appStore.showSuccessToast($t('debug.smart_contract.actions.success'));

			// Refresh contracts after successful execution
			await loadAllContracts();
		} catch (error) {
			console.error(`Error executing ${functionName}:`, error);
			const errorMessage = getErrorMessage(error);
			appStore.showErrorToast(
				$t('debug.smart_contract.actions.error', { values: { error: errorMessage } })
			);
		} finally {
			executingActions.delete(actionKey);
		}
	}

	// Copy address to clipboard
	async function copyAddress(address: string) {
		try {
			await navigator.clipboard.writeText(address);
			appStore.showSuccessToast($t('debug.smart_contract.copy_address') + ' copied');
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Failed to copy address:', error);
		}
	}

	// Get network name
	function getNetworkName(network: 'RSK' | 'BSC'): string {
		const rskNetwork = import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_NETWORK || 'testnet';
		if (network === 'RSK') {
			return `RSK ${rskNetwork === 'mainnet' ? 'Mainnet' : 'Testnet'}`;
		}
		return 'BSC Testnet'; // BSC is typically testnet in this context
	}

	// Format address for display
	function formatAddress(address: string): string {
		return `${address.slice(0, 6)}...${address.slice(-4)}`;
	}

	// Get explorer URL for address
	function getExplorerUrl(address: string, network: 'RSK' | 'BSC'): string {
		const rskNetwork = import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_NETWORK || 'testnet';
		const bscNetwork = import.meta.env.VITE_BSC_NETWORK || 'testnet';

		if (network === 'RSK') {
			if (rskNetwork === 'mainnet') {
				return `https://rootstock.blockscout.com/address/${address}`;
			} else {
				return `https://rootstock-testnet.blockscout.com/address/${address}`;
			}
		} else {
			if (bscNetwork === 'mainnet') {
				return `https://bscscan.com/address/${address}`;
			} else {
				return `https://testnet.bscscan.com/address/${address}`;
			}
		}
	}

	// Load safety override from localStorage and initialize wallet
	onMount(async () => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			const saved = localStorage.getItem('debug-safety-override');
			if (saved === 'true') {
				safetyOverride = true;
			}
		}

		// Initialize wallet first
		try {
			await walletManager.initialize();
		} catch (error) {
			appStore.showErrorToast(
				$t('debug.smart_contract.wallet_init_error', {
					values: { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error' }
				})
			);
		}

		// Load contracts after wallet is initialized
		loadAllContracts();
	});

	// Save safety override to localStorage
	$effect(() => {
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			localStorage.setItem('debug-safety-override', safetyOverride.toString());
		}
	});

	// Handle safety override toggle change
	function handleSafetyOverrideChange(event: Event) {
		const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
		const newValue = target.checked;

		// If disabling, allow it immediately
		if (!newValue) {
			safetyOverride = false;
			return;
		}

		// If enabling, prevent the change and show confirmation
		event.preventDefault();
		target.checked = false; // Reset checkbox
		showOverrideConfirm = true;
	}

	// Enable safety override
	function enableSafetyOverride() {
		safetyOverride = true;
		showOverrideConfirm = false;
		console.warn('Safety override enabled - all contract functions are now available');
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { SvelteMap } from 'svelte/reactivity';
	import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
	import { getPublicKey } from 'nostr-tools';
	import { NDKRelaySet } from '@nostr-dev-kit/ndk';
	import { createDebug } from '$lib/utils/debug';
	import { boltzProvider } from '$lib/services/BoltzProvider';
	import {
		scanUnclaimedLockups,
		refundLockupDirect,
		loadClaimDataFromNostr,
		type UnclaimedLockup
	} from '$lib/services/swap-chain.service';
	import { claimTbtcOnArbitrum, claimRbtcOnRsk } from '$lib/services/swap-chain/boltz/claims';
	import {
		TBTC_ARB,
		ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS,
		BLOCKSCOUT_API_BASE,
		LOCKUP_TOPIC,
		CLAIM_TOPIC
	} from '$lib/services/swap-chain/utils';
	import { encodeEtherSwapRefund } from '$lib/services/swap-chain/abi';
	import { getNostrKeyPair } from '$lib/utils/nostrKeys';
	import { getRSKAddress, walletManager, sendRawTransaction } from '$lib/stores/wallet.store';
	import { ndk } from '$lib/nostr/ndk';
	import { applyNdkSignerFromNsec } from '$lib/nostr/ndkSigner';
	import nip44 from '$lib/nostr/nip44';
	import KINDS from '$lib/utils/constants/kinds';
	import { resolveExplicitRelayUrls } from '$lib/utils/relayUrls';
	import { NOSTR_FINAL_STATES } from '$lib/utils/wallet/swapStatusMap';

	const d = createDebug('debug-swaps');
	const RELAYS = resolveExplicitRelayUrls(import.meta.env.VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL);
	const SWAP_TYPES = [
		'boltz-swap-chain',
		'bittasker-swap-chain',
		'boltz-swap-reverse',
		'boltz-swap-submarine'
	] as const;

	// ── Swap row ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	interface SwapRow {
		swapId: string;
		swapType: string;
		nostrStatus: string;
		preimage: string;
		createdAt: number; // milliseconds (from Nostr event created_at * 1000)
		fromAsset: string;
		toAsset: string;
		fromAmount: number;
		toAmount: number;
		lockupTxHash: string;
		claimTxHash: string;
		claimDetails: {
			lockupAddress: string;
			amount: number;
			refundAddress: string;
			timeoutBlockHeight: number;
			claimAddress?: string;
		} | null;
		lockupClaimAddress: string;
		refundAddress: string;
		boltzStatus: string;
		boltzChecked: boolean;
		boltzClaimDetails: {
			lockupAddress: string;
			amount: number;
			refundAddress: string;
			timeoutBlockHeight: number;
			claimAddress?: string;
		} | null;
		boltzTransactionId: string;
		recovering: boolean;
		recoverResult: { ok: boolean; msg: string; txHash?: string } | null;
	}

	// ── State ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	let rskAddress = $state('');
	let walletReady = $state(false);
	let initError = $state('');
	let swaps = $state<SwapRow[]>([]);
	let loading = $state(false);
	let loadError = $state('');
	let showAdvanced = $state(false);
	let lockups = $state<UnclaimedLockup[]>([]);
	let scanning = $state(false);
	let refundingTxHash = $state<string | null>(null);
	let refundResults = $state<Record<string, { ok: boolean; msg: string }>>({});

	interface LogEntry {
		id: number;
		time: string;
		level: 'info' | 'success' | 'error' | 'warn';
		msg: string;
	}
	let logs = $state<LogEntry[]>([]);
	let logIdCounter = 0;

	function log(level: LogEntry['level'], msg: string) {
		logs = [
			{ id: logIdCounter++, time: new Date().toLocaleTimeString(), level, msg },
			...logs
		].slice(0, 200);
		if (level === 'error') d.error(msg);
		else d.log('[%s] %s', level, msg);
	}

	// ── Init ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			await walletManager.initialize();
			rskAddress = await getRSKAddress();
			walletReady = true;
			log('success', `Wallet ready — RSK: ${rskAddress}`);
			await loadSwaps();
		} catch (err) {
			initError = (err as Error).message;
			log('error', `Wallet init failed: ${initError}`);
		}
	});

	// ── Fetch swaps directly from NDK ─────────────────────────────────
	async function loadSwaps() {
		loading = true;
		loadError = '';
		log('info', 'Fetching swaps from Nostr via NDK...');

		try {
			const { nsec } = await getNostrKeyPair();
			await applyNdkSignerFromNsec(nsec);
			const npub = getPublicKey(nsec);
			const nsecHex = Buffer.from(nsec).toString('hex');
			const conversationKey = await nip44.getConversationKey(nsecHex, npub);
			const relaySet = NDKRelaySet.fromRelayUrls(RELAYS, ndk);

			// Fetch all swap events from all types
			let allEvents: Array<{
				swapId: string;
				swapType: string;
				content: Record<string, unknown>;
				createdAtSec: number;
			}> = [];

			for (const swapType of SWAP_TYPES) {
				log('info', `  Fetching ${swapType}...`);
				try {
					const events = await ndk.fetchEvents(
						{ authors: [npub], kinds: [KINDS.PENDING_SWAPS], '#t': [swapType] },
						{ closeOnEose: true },
						relaySet
					);

					// Deduplicate by swapId, keep latest by created_at
					const latestById = new SvelteMap<
						string,
						{
							swapId: string;
							swapType: string;
							content: Record<string, unknown>;
							createdAtSec: number;
						}
					>();
					for (const event of events) {
						const swapId = event.tagValue('d');
						if (!swapId) continue;
						const existing = latestById.get(swapId);
						const eventTs = event.created_at ?? 0;
						if (!existing || eventTs > existing.createdAtSec) {
							try {
								if (!event.content || typeof event.content !== 'string') continue;
								const decrypted = await nip44.decrypt(event.content, conversationKey);
								const data = JSON.parse(decrypted) as Record<string, unknown>;
								if (!NOSTR_FINAL_STATES.includes((data.status as string) ?? '')) {
									latestById.set(swapId, {
										swapId,
										swapType,
										content: data,
										createdAtSec: eventTs
									});
								}
							} catch {
								// skip undecryptable
							}
						}
					}
					allEvents = [...allEvents, ...latestById.values()];
					log('info', `    → ${latestById.size} swap(s)`);
				} catch (err) {
					log('warn', `    Failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
				}
			}

			log('info', `Found ${allEvents.length} pending swap(s)`);

			// Sort by Nostr created_at (seconds) descending — newest first
			allEvents.sort((a, b) => b.createdAtSec - a.createdAtSec);

			// Build rows
			const rows: SwapRow[] = allEvents.map((ev) => {
				const s = ev.content;
				return {
					swapId: ev.swapId,
					swapType: (s.type as string) ?? ev.swapType,
					nostrStatus: (s.status as string) ?? '?',
					preimage: (s.preimage as string) ?? '',
					createdAt: ev.createdAtSec * 1000, // convert to ms for display
					fromAsset: (s.fromAsset as string) ?? '',
					toAsset: (s.toAsset as string) ?? '',
					fromAmount: (s.fromAmount as number) ?? (s.amount as number) ?? 0,
					toAmount: (s.toAmount as number) ?? (s.onchainAmount as number) ?? 0,
					lockupTxHash: (s.lockupTxHash as string) ?? '',
					claimTxHash: (s.claimTxHash as string) ?? '',
					claimDetails: (s.claimDetails as SwapRow['claimDetails']) ?? null,
					lockupClaimAddress: (s.lockupClaimAddress as string) ?? '',
					refundAddress: (s.refundAddress as string) ?? '',
					boltzStatus: '',
					boltzChecked: false,
					boltzClaimDetails: null,
					boltzTransactionId: '',
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: null
				};
			});

			swaps = rows;
			loading = false;
			log('success', `Loaded ${rows.length} swap(s), newest first`);

			// Check Boltz status SEQUENTIALLY — one at a time.
			// This avoids the race condition where parallel swaps = swaps.map(...)
			// overwrites each other's changes.
			for (let i = 0; i < swaps.length; i++) {
				const swapId = swaps[i].swapId;
				try {
					const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) =>
						setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('timeout')), 8000)
					);
					const boltz = await Promise.race([boltzProvider.getSwapStatus(swapId), timeoutPromise]);
					// Direct index assignment — Svelte detects this on $state arrays
					swaps[i] = {
						...swaps[i],
						boltzStatus: boltz.status,
						boltzChecked: true,
						boltzClaimDetails: boltz.claimDetails ?? null,
						boltzTransactionId: boltz.transactionId ?? ''
					};
				} catch (err) {
					d.warn('Boltz check failed for %s: %s', swapId, (err as Error).message);
					swaps[i] = { ...swaps[i], boltzStatus: 'unknown', boltzChecked: true };
				}

				// If Nostr didn't persist claimDetails (bittasker-swap-chain events
				// drop them via buildSwapContent) and Boltz API didn't return them,
				// fetch from the on-chain lockup transaction as a self-healing step.
				const row = swaps[i];
				if (!row.claimDetails && !row.boltzClaimDetails && row.boltzTransactionId) {
					log('info', `  Fetching claim details from chain for ${swapId.slice(0, 12)}...`);
					const chainDetails =
						(await fetchClaimDetailsFromRsk(row.boltzTransactionId)) ??
						(await fetchClaimDetailsFromArbitrum(row.boltzTransactionId));
					if (chainDetails) {
						swaps[i] = { ...swaps[i], claimDetails: chainDetails };
						log('success', `  Recovered claim details from chain for ${swapId.slice(0, 12)}`);
					}
				}
			}
			log('info', 'All Boltz checks complete');
		} catch (err) {
			loadError = (err as Error).message;
			log('error', `Failed to load swaps: ${loadError}`);
			loading = false;
		}
	}

	// ── Checksum address helper (ethers v6 requires EIP-55) ────────────
	// IMPORTANT: must lowercase first — ethers.getAddress() throws on
	// mixed-case input that doesn't match EIP-55 (e.g. "0x9AEA6DDA...")
	let _ethersMod: typeof import('ethers') | null = null;
	async function cs(addr: string): Promise<string> {
		if (!_ethersMod) _ethersMod = await import('ethers');
		return _ethersMod.ethers.getAddress(addr.toLowerCase());
	}

	// ── Fetch claim details from Arbitrum lockup tx ────────────────────
	// For RBTC→TBTC swaps: Boltz locks tBTC on Arbitrum (ERC20Swap).
	// Event: Lockup(bytes32 indexed preimageHash, uint256 amount, address token,
	//         address indexed claimAddress, address indexed refundAddress, uint256 timelock)
	// topic0=sig, topic1=preimageHash, topic2=claimAddress, topic3=refundAddress
	// data = amount + token + timelock
	async function fetchClaimDetailsFromArbitrum(lockupTxHash: string): Promise<{
		lockupAddress: string;
		amount: number;
		claimAddress: string;
		refundAddress: string;
		timeoutBlockHeight: number;
	} | null> {
		try {
			const { ethers } = await import('ethers');
			const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://arb1.arbitrum.io/rpc');
			const receipt = await provider.getTransactionReceipt(lockupTxHash);
			if (!receipt?.to) {
				log('warn', '  Arbitrum: No receipt or contract address');
				return null;
			}

			const lockupLogs = receipt.logs.filter(
				(l) => l.address.toLowerCase() === receipt.to!.toLowerCase() && l.topics.length === 4
			);
			if (lockupLogs.length === 0) {
				log('warn', '  Arbitrum: No Lockup event found in tx logs');
				return null;
			}

			const lockupLog = lockupLogs[0];
			const claimAddress = ethers.getAddress('0x' + lockupLog.topics[2].slice(26));
			const refundAddress = ethers.getAddress('0x' + lockupLog.topics[3].slice(26));

			// Parse data: 3 x 32-byte words (amount, token, timelock)
			const data = lockupLog.data;
			const amount = Number(BigInt(data.slice(0, 66)));
			const timeoutBlockHeight = Number(BigInt('0x' + data.slice(130, 194)));

			const details = {
				lockupAddress: receipt.to,
				amount,
				claimAddress,
				refundAddress,
				timeoutBlockHeight
			};
			log(
				'success',
				`  Arbitrum claim details: ${details.amount} wei, timelock ${details.timeoutBlockHeight}, claim ${details.claimAddress.slice(0, 10)}...`
			);
			return details;
		} catch (err) {
			d.warn('fetchClaimDetailsFromArbitrum failed: %s', (err as Error).message);
			log('warn', `  Arbitrum fetch failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
			return null;
		}
	}

	// ── Fetch claim details from RSK lockup tx ────────────────────────
	// For TBTC→RBTC swaps: Boltz locks RBTC on RSK (EtherSwap).
	// Event: Lockup(bytes32 indexed preimageHash, uint256 amount,
	//         address indexed refundAddress, address claimAddress, uint256 timelock)
	// topic0=sig, topic1=preimageHash, topic2=refundAddress (msg.sender/Boltz)
	// data = amount (wei) + claimAddress (user, padded) + timelock
	async function fetchClaimDetailsFromRsk(lockupTxHash: string): Promise<{
		lockupAddress: string;
		amount: number;
		claimAddress: string;
		refundAddress: string;
		timeoutBlockHeight: number;
	} | null> {
		try {
			const { ethers } = await import('ethers');
			const provider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://public-node.rsk.co');
			const receipt = await provider.getTransactionReceipt(lockupTxHash);
			if (!receipt) {
				log('warn', '  RSK: No receipt found');
				return null;
			}

			// Find the Lockup event from the EtherSwap contract
			const lockupLogs = receipt.logs.filter(
				(l) =>
					l.topics[0]?.toLowerCase() === LOCKUP_TOPIC.toLowerCase() &&
					l.address.toLowerCase() === ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS.toLowerCase()
			);
			if (lockupLogs.length === 0) {
				log('warn', '  RSK: No Lockup event found');
				return null;
			}

			const lockupLog = lockupLogs[0];
			// topic2 = refundAddress (Boltz/msg.sender, can refund after timelock)
			const refundAddress = ethers.getAddress('0x' + lockupLog.topics[2].slice(26));

			// Parse data: 3 x 32-byte words (amount_wei, claimAddress, timelock)
			const data = lockupLog.data;
			const amountWei = Number(BigInt(data.slice(0, 66)));
			const amount = Math.round(amountWei / 1e10); // wei → sats (claimRbtcOnRsk expects sats)
			// data[32:64] = claimAddress (user, can claim with preimage)
			const claimAddress = ethers.getAddress('0x' + data.slice(90, 130));
			const timeoutBlockHeight = Number(BigInt('0x' + data.slice(130, 194)));

			const details = {
				lockupAddress: ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS,
				amount,
				claimAddress,
				refundAddress,
				timeoutBlockHeight
			};
			log(
				'success',
				`  RSK claim details: ${details.amount} sats, timelock ${details.timeoutBlockHeight}, claim ${details.claimAddress.slice(0, 10)}...`
			);
			return details;
		} catch (err) {
			d.warn('fetchClaimDetailsFromRsk failed: %s', (err as Error).message);
			log('warn', `  RSK fetch failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
			return null;
		}
	}

	// ── Fetch claim details by preimageHash from Blockscout ──────────
	// Ultimate fallback: compute preimageHash from preimage, query Blockscout
	// for the Lockup event indexed by topic1=preimageHash.
	async function fetchClaimDetailsByPreimageHash(preimage: string): Promise<{
		lockupAddress: string; amount: number; claimAddress: string; refundAddress: string; timeoutBlockHeight: number;
	} | null> {
		try {
			const { ethers } = await import('ethers');
			const preimageHash = ethers.sha256('0x' + (preimage.startsWith('0x') ? preimage.slice(2) : preimage));
			log('info', `  Looking up Lockup event by preimageHash: ${preimageHash.slice(0, 18)}...`);

			const lockupUrl = `${BLOCKSCOUT_API_BASE}?module=logs&action=getLogs&address=${ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS}&topic0=${LOCKUP_TOPIC}&topic1=${preimageHash}&topic0_1_opr=and&fromBlock=0&toBlock=latest`;
			const resp = await fetch(lockupUrl);
			const data = (await resp.json()) as { result?: Array<{ topics: string[]; data: string; blockNumber: string; transactionHash: string }> };

			if (!data.result || data.result.length === 0) {
				log('warn', '  No Lockup event found on RSK for this preimageHash');
				return null;
			}

			const event = data.result[0];
			const dataHex = event.data;

			const amountWei = Number(BigInt('0x' + dataHex.slice(2, 66)));
			const amount = Math.round(amountWei / 1e10);
			const claimAddress = ethers.getAddress('0x' + dataHex.slice(90, 130));
			const timeoutBlockHeight = Number(BigInt('0x' + dataHex.slice(130, 194)));
			const refundAddress = ethers.getAddress('0x' + event.topics[2].slice(26));

			const details = { lockupAddress: ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS, amount, claimAddress, refundAddress, timeoutBlockHeight };
			log('success', `  Found Lockup via preimageHash: ${details.amount} sats, claim ${details.claimAddress.slice(0, 10)}..., timelock ${details.timeoutBlockHeight}`);
			return details;
		} catch (err) {
			d.warn('fetchClaimDetailsByPreimageHash failed: %s', (err as Error).message);
			log('warn', `  PreimageHash lookup failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
			return null;
		}
	}

	// ── Recover a single swap ─────────────────────────────────────────
	async function recoverSwap(row: SwapRow) {
		const idx = swaps.findIndex((s) => s.swapId === row.swapId);
		if (idx < 0) return;
		swaps[idx] = { ...swaps[idx], recovering: true, recoverResult: null };
		log('info', `Recovering swap ${row.swapId.slice(0, 12)}...`);

		try {
			// Step 1: Get Boltz status if not checked
			let boltzStatus = swaps[idx].boltzStatus;
			let boltzClaimDetails = swaps[idx].boltzClaimDetails;
			if (!swaps[idx].boltzChecked) {
				const boltz = await boltzProvider.getSwapStatus(row.swapId);
				boltzStatus = boltz.status;
				boltzClaimDetails = boltz.claimDetails ?? null;
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					boltzStatus,
					boltzChecked: true,
					boltzClaimDetails,
					boltzTransactionId: boltz.transactionId ?? ''
				};
			}

			// Already done?
			if (['transaction.claimed', 'invoice.settled', 'invoice.paid'].includes(boltzStatus)) {
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: { ok: true, msg: 'Already claimed — funds are in your wallet.' }
				};
				return;
			}
			if (boltzStatus === 'transaction.refunded') {
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: { ok: true, msg: 'Already refunded.' }
				};
				return;
			}

			// Step 2: Get preimage
			let preimage = swaps[idx].preimage;
			if (!preimage) {
				log('info', '  No preimage in Nostr data, trying Preferences...');
				const cd = await loadClaimDataFromNostr(row.swapId);
				if (cd) {
					preimage = cd.preimageHex;
					log('success', '  Preimage recovered');
				}
			}
			if (!preimage) {
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: { ok: false, msg: 'No preimage found — cannot claim.' }
				};
				return;
			}

			// Step 3: Get claim details — try Boltz API, then Nostr, then on-chain
			let claimDetails = boltzClaimDetails ?? swaps[idx].claimDetails;
			if (!claimDetails) {
				// Try boltzTransactionId first, then fall back to lockupTxHash from Nostr
				const lockupTx = swaps[idx].boltzTransactionId || swaps[idx].lockupTxHash;
				if (lockupTx) {
					log('info', '  No claim details in Boltz/Nostr, fetching from on-chain...');
					claimDetails = await fetchClaimDetailsFromRsk(lockupTx);
					if (!claimDetails) {
						log('info', '  Not found on RSK, trying Arbitrum...');
						claimDetails = await fetchClaimDetailsFromArbitrum(lockupTx);
					}
					if (claimDetails) {
						swaps[idx] = { ...swaps[idx], claimDetails };
					}
				}
			}
			// Ultimate fallback: look up by preimageHash on Blockscout
			if (!claimDetails && preimage) {
				log('info', '  No lockup TX available, looking up by preimageHash on-chain...');
				claimDetails = await fetchClaimDetailsByPreimageHash(preimage);
				if (claimDetails) {
					swaps[idx] = { ...swaps[idx], claimDetails };
				}
			}
			if (!claimDetails) {
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: {
						ok: false,
						msg: 'No claim details found — swap may already be resolved.'
					}
				};
				return;
			}

			// Step 4: Execute claim
			const claimable = [
				'transaction.server.confirmed',
				'transaction.claim.pending',
				'transaction.server.mempool',
				'transaction.confirmed',
				'transaction.lockupFailed'
			];
			if (claimable.includes(boltzStatus)) {
				log('info', `  Boltz locked funds (${boltzStatus}). Claiming...`);
				const isArbitrum =
					claimDetails.lockupAddress.toLowerCase() !== ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS.toLowerCase();

				// CRITICAL: checksum all addresses — ethers v6 rejects non-EIP-55 addresses
				// Use claimAddress from on-chain Lockup event (the authoritative source).
				// Do NOT use lockupClaimAddress from Nostr — it may contain Boltz's
				// own address rather than the user's, causing SwapNotFound() reverts.
				const onChainClaimAddr =
					(claimDetails.claimAddress ?? row.boltzClaimDetails?.claimAddress) || null;
				const claimAddr = await cs(onChainClaimAddr || rskAddress);
				const refundAddr = await cs(claimDetails.refundAddress);
				const contractAddr = await cs(claimDetails.lockupAddress);

				if (isArbitrum) {
					// claimTbtcOnArbitrum already passes feeToken=TBTC_ARB to the gasless relay.
					// The gasless relay uses tBTC (produced atomically by the claim) for gas —
					// no pre-existing ETH on Arbitrum needed.
					const preimageHex0x = preimage.startsWith('0x') ? preimage : '0x' + preimage;
					log('info', '  Claiming tBTC on Arbitrum (gasless relay uses tBTC for gas)...');
					const err = await claimTbtcOnArbitrum({
						contractAddress: contractAddr,
						preimageHex: preimageHex0x,
						amount: claimDetails.amount,
						tokenAddress: TBTC_ARB,
						claimAddress: claimAddr,
						refundAddress: refundAddr,
						timelock: claimDetails.timeoutBlockHeight,
						sourceConnectedWalletId: null
					});
					if (err) throw err;
					swaps[idx] = {
						...swaps[idx],
						recovering: false,
						recoverResult: { ok: true, msg: 'tBTC claimed on Arbitrum!' }
					};
					log('success', '  tBTC claimed!');
				} else {
					// claimRbtcOnRsk → encodeEtherSwapClaim adds 0x prefix internally
					const preimageHex = preimage.startsWith('0x') ? preimage.slice(2) : preimage;
					log('info', '  Claiming rBTC on RSK...');
					const err = await claimRbtcOnRsk({
						preimageHex,
						amount: claimDetails.amount,
						claimAddress: claimAddr,
						refundAddress: refundAddr,
						timelock: claimDetails.timeoutBlockHeight,
						sourceConnectedWalletId: null
					});
					if (err) throw err;
					swaps[idx] = {
						...swaps[idx],
						recovering: false,
						recoverResult: { ok: true, msg: 'rBTC claimed on RSK!' }
					};
					log('success', '  rBTC claimed!');
				}
			} else if (['swap.expired', 'transaction.failed'].includes(boltzStatus)) {
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: { ok: false, msg: `Swap ${boltzStatus}. Use RSK Scanner below to refund.` }
				};
			} else {
				swaps[idx] = {
					...swaps[idx],
					recovering: false,
					recoverResult: { ok: false, msg: `Cannot recover: status is "${boltzStatus}".` }
				};
			}
		} catch (err) {
			swaps[idx] = {
				...swaps[idx],
				recovering: false,
				recoverResult: { ok: false, msg: (err as Error).message }
			};
			log('error', `  Recovery failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
		}
	}

	// ── RSK Scanner ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
	async function handleScan() {
		scanning = true;
		lockups = [];
		refundResults = {};
		log('info', 'Scanning RSK for lockups...');
		try {
			const { data, error } = await scanUnclaimedLockups();
			if (error) throw error;
			lockups = data;
			log('success', `Found ${data.length} lockup(s)`);
		} catch (err) {
			log('error', `Scan failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
		} finally {
			scanning = false;
		}
	}

	async function handleRefund(lockup: UnclaimedLockup) {
		refundingTxHash = lockup.txHash;
		refundResults[lockup.txHash] = { ok: false, msg: 'Refunding...' };
		log('info', `Refunding ${lockup.amountSats} sats...`);
		try {
			const { txHash, error } = await refundLockupDirect(lockup);
			if (error) throw error;
			refundResults[lockup.txHash] = { ok: true, msg: `TX: ${txHash}` };
			log('success', `Refund TX: ${txHash}`);
		} catch (err) {
			refundResults[lockup.txHash] = { ok: false, msg: (err as Error).message };
			log('error', `Refund failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
		} finally {
			refundingTxHash = null;
		}
	}

	// ── Refund RBTC from Boltz EtherSwap on RSK ──────────────────────
	// Queries Blockscout by preimageHash (topic1) to find the Lockup event,
	// then calls EtherSwap.refund(preimageHash, claimAddress, timelock).
	async function handleRefundRSK(row: SwapRow) {
		const idx = swaps.findIndex((s) => s.swapId === row.swapId);
		if (idx < 0) return;
		swaps[idx] = { ...swaps[idx], recovering: true, recoverResult: null };
		log('info', `Refunding RBTC for swap ${row.swapId}...`);

		try {
			const preimage = swaps[idx].preimage;
			if (!preimage) throw new Error('No preimage available — cannot refund without it');

			const { ethers } = await import('ethers');
			const preimageHash = ethers.sha256('0x' + preimage);
			log('info', `  PreimageHash: ${preimageHash.slice(0, 18)}...`);

			// Query Blockscout for Lockup event by preimageHash (topic1)
			const lockupUrl = `${BLOCKSCOUT_API_BASE}?module=logs&action=getLogs&address=${ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS}&topic0=${LOCKUP_TOPIC}&topic1=${preimageHash}&topic0_1_opr=and&fromBlock=0&toBlock=latest`;
			log('info', '  Querying Blockscout for Lockup event...');
			const lockupResp = await fetch(lockupUrl);
			const lockupData = (await lockupResp.json()) as {
				result?: Array<{
					topics: string[];
					data: string;
					blockNumber: string;
					transactionHash: string;
				}>;
			};

			if (!lockupData.result || lockupData.result.length === 0) {
				throw new Error(
					'No Lockup event found on RSK for this preimageHash. The lockup may never have been created.'
				);
			}

			const event = lockupData.result[0];
			const dataHex = event.data;

			// Parse event data: amount (uint256) + claimAddress (address, padded) + timelock (uint256)
			const amount = BigInt('0x' + dataHex.slice(2, 66));
			const claimAddress = '0x' + dataHex.slice(90, 130);
			const timelock = Number(BigInt('0x' + dataHex.slice(130, 194)));
			const lockupBlock = parseInt(event.blockNumber, 16);

			log(
				'info',
				`  Lockup found: ${ethers.formatEther(amount)} RBTC | claim: ${claimAddress.slice(0, 14)}... | timelock: ${timelock} | block: ${lockupBlock}`
			);

			// Check if already claimed
			const claimUrl = `${BLOCKSCOUT_API_BASE}?module=logs&action=getLogs&address=${ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS}&topic0=${CLAIM_TOPIC}&topic1=${preimageHash}&topic0_1_opr=and&fromBlock=0&toBlock=latest`;
			const claimResp = await fetch(claimUrl);
			const claimData = (await claimResp.json()) as { result?: Array<unknown> };
			if (Array.isArray(claimData.result) && claimData.result.length > 0) {
				throw new Error('Already claimed — Boltz took the RBTC using the preimage');
			}

			// Check timelock
			const rskProvider = new ethers.JsonRpcProvider('https://public-node.rsk.co');
			const currentBlock = await rskProvider.getBlockNumber();
			log('info', `  Current RSK block: ${currentBlock} | Timelock: ${timelock}`);

			if (currentBlock < timelock) {
				const blocksLeft = timelock - currentBlock;
				const minutesLeft = Math.ceil((blocksLeft * 30) / 60);
				throw new Error(
					`Timelock not expired — ~${minutesLeft}m remaining (${blocksLeft} blocks). Wait until block ${timelock}.`
				);
			}

			// Encode and send refund TX
			const calldata = encodeEtherSwapRefund(preimageHash, claimAddress, timelock);
			log('info', `  Sending refund to ${ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS.slice(0, 14)}...`);
			const txHash = await sendRawTransaction({
				to: ETHERSWAP_ADDRESS,
				data: calldata,
				value: '0',
				chain: 'rsk'
			});

			swaps[idx] = {
				...swaps[idx],
				recovering: false,
				recoverResult: { ok: true, msg: `Refund TX: ${txHash}` }
			};
			log('success', `Refund sent! TX: ${txHash}`);
			log('info', `View: https://rootstock.blockscout.com/tx/${txHash}`);
		} catch (err) {
			swaps[idx] = {
				...swaps[idx],
				recovering: false,
				recoverResult: { ok: false, msg: (err as Error).message }
			};
			log('error', `Refund failed: ${(err as Error).message}`);
		}
	}

	// ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	function fmtTime(ms: number): string {
		return ms ? new Date(ms).toLocaleString() : '—';
	}

	function statusColor(s: string): string {
		if (['transaction.claimed', 'invoice.settled', 'invoice.paid'].includes(s))
			return 'badge-success';
		if (
			[
				'swap.expired',
				'transaction.failed',
				'transaction.refunded',
				'transaction.lockupFailed'
			].includes(s)
		)
			return 'badge-error';
		if (
			[
				'transaction.server.confirmed',
				'transaction.confirmed',
				'transaction.claim.pending'
			].includes(s)
		)
			return 'badge-info';
		if (s === 'unknown') return 'badge-ghost';
		return 'badge-warning';
	}

	const STATUS_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
		'transaction.claimed': 'Claimed',
		'invoice.settled': 'Settled',
		'invoice.paid': 'Paid',
		'transaction.refunded': 'Refunded',
		'swap.expired': 'Expired',
		'transaction.failed': 'Failed',
		'transaction.lockupFailed': 'Lockup Failed',
		'transaction.server.confirmed': 'Claimable',
		'transaction.confirmed': 'Confirmed',
		'transaction.claim.pending': 'Claim Pending',
		'transaction.server.mempool': 'Locking...',
		'transaction.mempool': 'In Mempool',
		'invoice.pending': 'Invoice Pending',
		'swap.created': 'Created',
		unknown: 'Unknown'
	};
	function statusLabel(s: string): string {
		return STATUS_LABELS[s] ?? s;
	}

	function canRecover(row: SwapRow): boolean {
		return [
			'transaction.server.confirmed',
			'transaction.claim.pending',
			'transaction.server.mempool',
			'transaction.confirmed',
			'transaction.lockupFailed'
		].includes(row.boltzStatus);
	}

	function copyText(text: string) {
		navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => {});
	}
	function clearLog() {
		logs = [];
	}
</script>

<div class="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-6 py-6">

		<h1 class="text-3xl font-bold">Swap Recovery</h1>
		<p class="text-sm opacity-60">Recover locked funds from failed Boltz swaps.</p>
	</div>

	{#if initError}
		<div class="alert alert-error mb-4"><span>Wallet init failed: {initError}</span></div>
	{:else if !walletReady}
		<div class="alert alert-info mb-4">
			<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm"></span><span>Initializing wallet...</span>
		</div>
	{:else}
		<div class="mb-4 font-mono text-xs opacity-50">RSK: {rskAddress}</div>
	{/if}

	<!-- My Swaps -->
	<div class="card bg-base-200 mb-6">
		<div class="card-body p-5">
			<div class="flex items-center justify-between">
				<h2 class="card-title text-xl">My Swaps</h2>
				<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" disabled={loading || !walletReady} onclick={loadSwaps}>
					{#if loading}<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>{:else}Refresh{/if}
				</button>
			</div>

			{#if loading && swaps.length === 0}
				<div class="flex items-center gap-2 py-8">
					<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-md"></span><span
						>Loading swaps from Nostr...</span
					>
				</div>
			{:else if loadError}
				<div class="alert alert-error mt-2 text-sm">{loadError}</div>
			{:else if swaps.length === 0}
				<p class="py-4 text-sm opacity-50">No swaps found on Nostr.</p>
			{:else}
				<div class="mt-2 space-y-4">
					{#each swaps as row, index (row.swapId)}
						<div
							class="card bg-base-100 border-2"
							class:border-success={row.recoverResult?.ok}
							class:border-error={row.recoverResult && !row.recoverResult.ok}
							class:border-base-300={!row.recoverResult}
						>
							<div class="card-body p-4">
								<!-- Swap ID + status -->
								<div class="flex items-center gap-3">
									<span
										class="cursor-pointer font-mono text-sm hover:opacity-80"
										role="button"

<script lang="ts">
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import DebugWalletAssetList from '$lib/components/wallet/DebugWalletAssetList.svelte';
	import DebugWalletSendForm from '$lib/components/wallet/DebugWalletSendForm.svelte';
	import WalletPaymentModal from '$lib/components/wallet/WalletPaymentModal.svelte';
	import { walletManager, walletStore, rskConnection } from '$lib/stores/wallet.store';
	import type { TokenBalance } from '$lib/types/wallet';

	let selectedToken = $state<TokenBalance | null>(null);
	let isSendModalOpen = $state(false);
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let refreshTrigger = $state(0);

	// Use reactive state from wallet store (same as main wallet page)
	let hasErrors = $derived($walletStore.error || $rskConnection.error);

	/**
	 * Initialize wallet - matches main wallet page pattern exactly
	 */
	async function initializeWallet(): Promise<void> {
		try {
			isLoading = true;
			await walletManager.initialize();
			await walletManager.loadAssets();
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	}

	function handleSendToken(token: TokenBalance) {
		selectedToken = token;
		isSendModalOpen = true;
	}

	function handleCloseModal() {
		isSendModalOpen = false;
		selectedToken = null;
	}

	function handleSendSuccess() {
		// Refresh asset list after successful send
		refreshTrigger++;
		handleCloseModal();
	}

	onMount(async () => {
		await initializeWallet();
	});

	onDestroy(async () => {
		// Note: We don't call walletManager.cleanup() here because:
		// 1. The wallet might be used by other pages
		// 2. The main wallet page handles cleanup
		// 3. We only want to cleanup if we're the only page using the wallet
	});
</script>

<svelte:head>
	<title>{$t('wallet.debug_wallet.title')} - BitTasker</title>
</svelte:head>

<div class="container mx-auto max-w-4xl px-3 py-4 sm:px-4 sm:py-6">
	<!-- Page Header -->
	<div class="mb-4 sm:mb-6">

		<p class="text-xs opacity-70 sm:text-sm">{$t('wallet.debug_wallet.description')}</p>
	</div>

	<!-- Loading/Connecting State -->
	{#if $rskConnection.connecting || isLoading || $walletStore.isInitializing}
		<div class="alert alert-outline alert-info mb-3 py-2 sm:mb-6 sm:py-4">
			<div class="flex items-center">
				<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-sm mr-2"></span>
				<span>{$t('wallet.connecting')}</span>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Error State (only show after attempting initialization) -->
	{:else if hasErrors && !$walletStore.isConnected}
		<div class="alert alert-outline alert-error mb-3 py-2 sm:mb-6 sm:py-4">
			<svg
				xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
				class="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 stroke-current"
				fill="none"
				viewBox="0 0 24 24"
			>
				<path
					stroke-linecap="round"
					stroke-linejoin="round"
					stroke-width="2"

				/>
			</svg>
			<div class="flex-1">
				<div class="font-bold">{$t('wallet.page.connection_error')}</div>
				<div class="mt-1 text-sm">
					{#if $walletStore.error?.includes('No mnemonic found') || $walletStore.error?.includes('no mnemonic')}

					{:else}
						{$t('wallet.error.connection_failed')}
					{/if}
				</div>
				<div class="mt-3">
					<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" onclick={initializeWallet} disabled={isLoading}>
						{$t('wallet.page.retry_connection')}
					</button>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
		<!-- Asset List (only show when connected AND not initializing, same as main wallet page) -->
	{:else if $walletStore.isConnected && !$walletStore.isInitializing && !isLoading}
		<DebugWalletAssetList onSendToken={handleSendToken} {refreshTrigger} />
	{/if}

	<!-- Send Modal -->
	{#if selectedToken}
		<WalletPaymentModal isOpen={isSendModalOpen} onClose={handleCloseModal}>
			<DebugWalletSendForm
				token={selectedToken}
				onClose={handleCloseModal}
				onSuccess={handleSendSuccess}
			/>
		</WalletPaymentModal>
	{/if}
</div>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { ServiceBody } from '$lib/types/service.d';
	import type { Attachment } from '$lib/types/task';
	import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import { page } from '$app/stores';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import { serviceStore as store, STEPS } from '$lib/stores/service.store';
	import { createService, updateService, findServiceByUniqueId } from '$lib/nostr/service';
	import { findMyServices } from '$lib/nostr/findServices';
	import { myServicesStore } from '$lib/stores/service.store';
	import {
		ServiceStepEnum,
		ServicePricingTypeEnum,
		ServiceLocationTypeEnum
	} from '$lib/utils/enums/service.enum';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { browser } from '$app/environment';
	import { user } from '$lib/stores/user.store';
	import { getRSKAddress, walletStore } from '$lib/stores/wallet.store';
	import { loadPageTranslations } from '$lib/i18n/routeTranslations';
	import { buildEarningQueryUrl } from '$lib/utils/dashboardQuery';
	import {
		sanitizeInstantBuyDeliveryHours,
		sanitizeInstantBuyLeadHours,
		supportsInstantBuyAuthoring,
		validateInstantBuyDeliveryHours,
		validateInstantBuyLeadHours
	} from '$lib/utils/service-instant-buy/authoring';
	import {
		getServiceEditConflictMessage,
		isServiceEditConflictError
	} from '$lib/utils/service-edit-conflict';

	// Import step components
	import ServiceBasics from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServiceBasics.svelte';
	import ServiceLocation from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServiceLocation.svelte';
	import ServicePricing from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServicePricing.svelte';
	import ServiceTiers from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServiceTiers.svelte';
	import ServiceAddOns from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServiceAddOns.svelte';
	import ServiceFAQs from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServiceFAQs.svelte';
	import InquiryFormBuilder from '$lib/components/service/steps/InquiryFormBuilder.svelte';
	import ServicePortfolio from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServicePortfolio.svelte';
	import ServiceReview from '$lib/components/service/steps/ServiceReview.svelte';

	let errors = $state<Record<string, string>>({});
	let isSubmitting = $state(false);
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let isEditDataLoaded = $state(false);
	let direction: 'forward' | 'backward' = $state('forward');
	let attachmentsToRemove = $state<Attachment[]>([]);

	// Function to refresh My Services list after creating/updating a service
	async function refreshMyServices() {
		try {
			const result = await findMyServices({ page: 1, limit: 100, refresh: true });
			myServicesStore.update((s) => ({
				...s,
				items: result.services,
				currentPage: 1,
				hasMore: result.hasMore,
				error: null
			}));
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error refreshing My Services:', error);
		}
	}

	// Function to handle cancel/back to previous page
	function handleCancel() {
		// Check if we're in edit or duplicate mode
		const isEditing = $page.url.searchParams.get('edit') === 'true';
		// Clear the appropriate draft (creation or edit)
		store.clearDraft(isEditing);
		// Navigate back to previous page, fallback to My Services
		if (browser && window.history.length > 1) {
			window.history.back();
		} else {
			goto(getMyServicesUrl());
		}
	}

	// Save draft before leaving the page
	let isEditingMode = $state(false);
	let beforeUnloadHandler: (() => void) | null = null;

	function getMyServicesUrl(): string {
		const baseUrl = browser ? new URL(window.location.origin) : new URL('https://bittasker.local');
		return buildEarningQueryUrl(new URL('/earning', baseUrl), {
			tab: 'my-services'
		});
	}

	// Load the draft when the page is loaded
	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			// Load route translations (create service - all 10 steps) same as create-task
			await loadPageTranslations('/create-service');
			isLoading = true;

			// Check if we're in edit or duplicate mode
			const isEditing = $page.url.searchParams.get('edit') === 'true';
			const isDuplicating = $page.url.searchParams.get('duplicate') === 'true';
			const serviceIdParam = $page.url.searchParams.get('serviceId');

			isEditingMode = isEditing;

			if (isEditing && serviceIdParam) {
				// Load service for edit mode
				try {
					const service = await findServiceByUniqueId(serviceIdParam);

					if (!service) {
						appStore.showErrorToast($t('dashboard.services.create.errors.service_not_found'));
						goto(getMyServicesUrl());
						return;
					}

					// Load service into store for editing; always start at step 1 (do not restore draft step)
					await store.loadServiceForEdit(service.id, service);
					store.setStep(ServiceStepEnum.BASICS);
					isEditDataLoaded = true;
				} catch (error) {
					console.error('Error loading service for edit:', error);
					appStore.showErrorToast($t('dashboard.services.create.errors.load_failed'));
					goto(getMyServicesUrl());
					return;
				}
			} else if (isDuplicating && serviceIdParam) {
				// Duplicate option removed: redirect to create
				goto('/create-service');
				return;
			} else {
				// New service: restore create draft from storage so user can resume from last step when they come back
				await store.loadDraft(false);
				isEditDataLoaded = true;
			}

			// Setup auto-save on page unload
			if (browser) {
				beforeUnloadHandler = () => {
					// Force immediate save before leaving
					store.saveDraft(isEditingMode, true);
				};

				window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnloadHandler);
			}
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading draft:', error);
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	});

	// Save draft when component is destroyed
	onDestroy(() => {
		if (browser) {
			// Remove beforeunload listener
			if (beforeUnloadHandler) {
				window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnloadHandler);
			}
			// Save draft one more time when component is destroyed
			store.saveDraft(isEditingMode, true);
		}
	});

	function validateCurrentStep(): boolean {
		errors = {};
		const service = $store.service;

		switch ($store.currentStep) {
			case ServiceStepEnum.BASICS:
				if (!service?.title?.trim())
					errors.title = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.title_required');
				if (service?.title && service.title.length > 200)
					errors.title = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.title_too_long');
				if (!service?.description?.trim())
					errors.description = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.description_required');
				if (service?.description && service.description.length > 5000)
					errors.description = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.description_too_long');
				if (!service?.categories || service.categories.length === 0)
					errors.category = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.category_required');
				if (!service?.skills || service.skills.length === 0)
					errors.skill = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.skill_required');
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.LOCATION:
				if (!service?.serviceLocationTypes || service.serviceLocationTypes.length === 0)
					errors.location = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.location_type_required');
				// Validate location details based on selected types
				if (service?.serviceLocationTypes?.includes(ServiceLocationTypeEnum.TASKER_LOCATION)) {
					if (
						!service.locationDetails?.taskerLocation?.serviceLocation?.latitude ||
						!service.locationDetails?.taskerLocation?.serviceLocation?.longitude
					) {
						errors.location = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.service_location_required');
					}
				}
				if (service?.serviceLocationTypes?.includes(ServiceLocationTypeEnum.TASKEE_LOCATION)) {
					if (
						!service.locationDetails?.taskeeLocation?.useGlobalLocation &&
						(!service.locationDetails?.taskeeLocation?.serviceLocation?.latitude ||
							!service.locationDetails?.taskeeLocation?.serviceLocation?.longitude)
					) {
						errors.location = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.taskee_location_required');
					}
				}
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.PRICING: {
				if (!service?.pricing?.type) {
					errors.pricing = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.pricing_required');
				} else if (service.pricing.type === ServicePricingTypeEnum.FIXED) {
					if (service.pricing.amount == null || service.pricing.amount <= 0) {
						errors.amount = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.budget_required');
						errors.pricing = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.budget_required');
					}
				}
				const instantBuyLeadHoursValidation = validateInstantBuyLeadHours(
					service?.pricing?.type,
					service?.instantBuyLeadHours
				);
				const instantBuyDeliveryHoursValidation = validateInstantBuyDeliveryHours(
					service?.pricing?.type,
					service?.instantBuyDeliveryHours
				);
				if (!instantBuyLeadHoursValidation.valid) {
					errors.instantBuyLeadHours = $t(
						'dashboard.services.create.errors.instant_buy_lead_hours_invalid'
					);
				}
				if (!instantBuyDeliveryHoursValidation.valid) {
					errors.instantBuyDeliveryHours = $t(
						'dashboard.services.create.errors.instant_buy_delivery_hours_invalid'
					);
				}
				if (
					service?.instantBuyLeadHours != null &&
					!supportsInstantBuyAuthoring(service.pricing?.type)
				) {
					errors.instantBuyLeadHours = $t(
						'dashboard.services.create.errors.instant_buy_pricing_only_fixed_tiered'
					);
				}
				// TIERED and INQUIRY_REQUIRED: no amount/tiers required here
				break;
			}
			case ServiceStepEnum.TIERS:
				if (service?.pricing?.type === ServicePricingTypeEnum.TIERED) {
					if (!service.pricing.tiers || service.pricing.tiers.length < 2) {
						errors.pricing = $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.tiers_required');
					} else {
						const invalidTier = service.pricing.tiers.some(
							(t) => !t.description?.trim() || t.price == null || t.price <= 0
						);
						if (invalidTier) {
							errors.tiers = $t(
								'dashboard.services.create.errors.tiers_description_price_required'
							);
						}

						// When Book Now is enabled, all tiers must have delivery time
						if (service.instantBuyLeadHours != null) {
							const tiersMissingDeliveryTime = service.pricing.tiers.some((t) => !t.deliveryTime);
							if (tiersMissingDeliveryTime) {
								errors.tiers = $t(
									'dashboard.services.create.errors.tiers_delivery_time_required_for_book_now'
								);
							}
						}

						// Rush delivery price must be > 0 if enabled
						const invalidRushPrice = service.pricing.tiers.some(
							(t) =>
								t.rushDelivery?.enabled &&
								(t.rushDelivery.price == null || t.rushDelivery.price <= 0)
						);
						if (invalidRushPrice) {
							errors.tiers = $t(
								'dashboard.services.create.errors.tiers_description_price_required'
							);
						}
					}
				}
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.ADD_ONS:
				// Add-ons step is optional, no validation needed
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.FAQS:
				// FAQs step is optional, no validation needed
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.INQUIRY_FORM:
				// Inquiry form step validation is handled in PRICING step
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.PORTFOLIO:
				// Portfolio step is optional, no validation needed
				break;
			case ServiceStepEnum.REVIEW:
				// Review step doesn't need validation as it's just reviewing previous inputs
				break;
		}

		return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
	}

	const handleNext = async () => {
		if (!validateCurrentStep()) return;

		// When "Cotización Requerida" or "Precio fijo": skip only TIERS -> ADD_ONS (do not skip Add-ons)
		if (
			$store.currentStep === ServiceStepEnum.PRICING &&
			($store.service.pricing?.type === ServicePricingTypeEnum.INQUIRY_REQUIRED ||
				$store.service.pricing?.type === ServicePricingTypeEnum.FIXED)
		) {
			store.setStep(ServiceStepEnum.ADD_ONS);
			store.saveDraft($store.isEditing, true);
		} else {
			store.nextStep();
			store.saveDraft($store.isEditing, true);
		}
		direction = 'forward';
	};

	function handleBack() {
		// When returning from ADD_ONS and we skipped TIERS (Precio fijo or Cotización Requerida), go back to PRICING
		if (
			$store.currentStep === ServiceStepEnum.ADD_ONS &&
			($store.service.pricing?.type === ServicePricingTypeEnum.FIXED ||
				$store.service.pricing?.type === ServicePricingTypeEnum.INQUIRY_REQUIRED)
		) {
			store.setStep(ServiceStepEnum.PRICING);
		} else {
			store.previousStep();
		}
		direction = 'backward';
	}

	async function handleSubmit() {
		if (!validateCurrentStep()) return;

		try {
			isSubmitting = true;

			const normalizedPricing = $store.service.pricing
				? {
						...$store.service.pricing,
						currency:
							$store.service.pricing.currency === 'USDt'
								? 'USD'
								: ($store.service.pricing.currency ?? 'USD')
					}
				: {
						type: ServicePricingTypeEnum.FIXED,
						currency: 'USD',
						amount: 0
					};

			// Files are uploaded immediately when selected, no need to upload here

			const instantBuyLeadHours = sanitizeInstantBuyLeadHours(
				$store.service.pricing?.type,
				$store.service.instantBuyLeadHours
			);
			const instantBuyDeliveryHours = sanitizeInstantBuyDeliveryHours(
				$store.service.pricing?.type,
				$store.service.instantBuyDeliveryHours
			);
			const requiresProviderWallet =
				supportsInstantBuyAuthoring($store.service.pricing?.type) && instantBuyLeadHours != null;

			// Prefer current wallet if connected, otherwise use stored address (from previous versions/drafts)
			let providerWalletAddress =
				$walletStore.rsk?.address || $store.service.providerWalletAddress || undefined;

			// If Book Now is enabled but we don't have a wallet address yet, attempt to connect
			if (requiresProviderWallet && !providerWalletAddress) {
				try {
					providerWalletAddress = await getRSKAddress();
				} catch {
					// Graceful reuse: If editing an existing Book Now service, we should already have the address
					// in $store.service.providerWalletAddress (from loadServiceForEdit).
					// Only throw if we truly have no address for a service that REQUIRES Book Now.
					if (!$store.isEditing || !providerWalletAddress) {
						throw new Error($t('dashboard.services.create.errors.wallet_connect_book_now'));
					}
					// If editing and we failed to connect but HAVE a previous address, we proceed with the old one.
				}
			}

			const serviceData: ServiceBody = {
				uniqueId: $store.service.uniqueId || '',
				createdAt: $store.service.createdAt || 0,
				creator:
					$store.service.creator ||
					({
						username: '',
						avatar: '',
						name: $user?.name || ''
					} as { username: string; avatar: string; name: string }),
				title: $store.service.title || '',
				description: $store.service.description || '',
				serviceLocationTypes: $store.service.serviceLocationTypes || [],
				locationDetails: $store.service.locationDetails,
				pricing: normalizedPricing,
				skills: $store.service.skills || [],
				categories: $store.service.categories || [],
				portfolio: $store.service.portfolio,
				faqs: $store.service.faqs,
				instantBuyLeadHours,
				instantBuyDeliveryHours,
				status: 'active' // Set to active when publishing
			};

			// If Book Now is enabled, inject the wallet address.
			// If it was explicitly disabled, ensure the field is removed/undefined to clear legacy data.
			if (requiresProviderWallet) {
				serviceData.providerWalletAddress = providerWalletAddress;
			} else {
				serviceData.providerWalletAddress = undefined;
			}

			// Use store state so we update even if URL lost edit=true (e.g. after navigation)
			const dTag = $store.uniqueId || $store.service.uniqueId;
			const isUpdating = $store.isEditing && Boolean(dTag);

			if (isUpdating && dTag) {
				// updateService uses #d tag (human-readable identifier)
				await updateService(dTag, serviceData, {
					expectedServiceEventId: $store.id || undefined
				});
				appStore.showSuccessToast($t('dashboard.services.create.success.updated'));

				await store.clearDraft(true);
				await refreshMyServices();

				await goto(getMyServicesUrl());
			} else {
				await createService(serviceData);
				appStore.showSuccessToast($t('dashboard.services.create.success.created'));

				// Clear the draft (creation or duplicate)
				await store.clearDraft(false);

				// Brief delay so the relay can index the new event before we fetch
				await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 600));
				// Refresh My Services list and update store so the list is ready when we navigate
				await refreshMyServices();

				await goto(getMyServicesUrl());
			}
		} catch (error) {
			const errorMessage = isServiceEditConflictError(error)
				? getServiceEditConflictMessage()
				: error instanceof Error
					? error.message
					: $t('dashboard.services.create.errors.create_failed');
			errors.general = errorMessage;
			appStore.showErrorToast(errorMessage);
		} finally {
			isSubmitting = false;
		}
	}
</script>
