							<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick={handleBack}>
								{$t('dashboard.services.create.back')}
							</button>
						{:else}
							<button type="button" class="btn btn-secondary" onclick={handleCancel}>
								<svg
									xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
									class="mr-1 h-4 w-4"
									fill="none"
									viewBox="0 0 24 24"
									stroke="currentColor"
								>
									<path
										stroke-linecap="round"
										stroke-linejoin="round"
										stroke-width="2"
										d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"
									/>
								</svg>
								{$t('dashboard.services.create.back_to_services')}
							</button>
						{/if}

						{#if $STEPS.indexOf($store.currentStep) === $STEPS.length - 1}
							<button
								type="button"
								class="btn btn-primary {isSubmitting ? 'loading' : ''}"
								onclick={handleSubmit}
								disabled={isSubmitting}
							>
								{#if isSubmitting}
									<span></span>
								{:else if $page.url.searchParams.get('edit') === 'true'}
									{$t('dashboard.services.create.update')}
								{:else}
									{$t('dashboard.services.create.publish')}
								{/if}
							</button>
						{:else}
							<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary" onclick={handleNext}>
								{$t('dashboard.services.create.next')}
							</button>
						{/if}
					</div>
				</div>

				{#if errors.general}
					<div class="alert alert-error alert-outline mt-6 shadow-lg">
						<svg
							xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
							class="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 stroke-current"
							fill="none"
							viewBox="0 0 24 24"

							<path
								stroke-linecap="round"
								stroke-linejoin="round"

							/>
						</svg>
						<span>{errors.general}</span>
					</div>
				{/if}
			{/if}
		</div>
	</div>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Attachment, TaskBody } from '$lib/types/task';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { page } from '$app/stores';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import { getBudgetBucket } from '$lib/utils/helpers/budgetTier';
	import { taskStore as store, STEPS } from '$lib/stores/task.store';
	import { createTask, createRecurringTask, updateTask } from '$lib/nostr/task';
	import { findMyTasks } from '$lib/nostr/findMyTasks';
	import { TaskStatusEnum, TaskStepEnum, TaskTypeEnum } from '$lib/utils/enums/task.enum';
	import TaskBasics from '$lib/components/task/steps/TaskBasics.svelte';
	import TaskLocation from '$lib/components/task/steps/TaskLocation.svelte';
	import TaskBudget from '$lib/components/task/steps/TaskBudget.svelte';
	import TaskRecurring from '$lib/components/task/steps/TaskRecurring.svelte';
	import TaskReview from '$lib/components/task/steps/TaskReview.svelte';
	import savedSearchService, { type TaskBodyDto } from '$lib/api/services/saved-search.service';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
	import { browser } from '$app/environment';
	import { notificationCenterService } from '$lib/api/services/notificationCenter.service';
	let errors = $state<Record<string, string>>({});
	let isSubmitting = $state(false);
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let isEditDataLoaded = $state(false);
	let direction: 'forward' | 'backward' = $state('forward');
	let attachmentsToRemove = $state<Attachment[]>([]);
	let taskBudgetRef: {
		uploadPendingFiles?: () => Promise<unknown[]>;
	} | null = $state(null);
	let taskBasicsRef: {
		saveCurrentSkillInput?: () => void;
	} | null = $state(null);

	// Background function to trigger saved search checks
	const triggerSavedSearchChecks = async (taskData: TaskBody, eventId: string) => {
		try {
			// Convert taskType enum to string for API
			const taskTypeString = taskData.taskType === TaskTypeEnum.IN_PERSON ? 'IN_PERSON' : 'REMOTE';

			const budgetTier = getBudgetBucket(taskData.budget.amount, taskData.budget.currency);

			// Convert the task data to TaskBodyDto format
			const taskBodyDto: TaskBodyDto = {
				eventId: eventId,
				title: taskData.title,
				description: taskData.description,
				taskType: taskTypeString,
				skills: taskData.skills || [],
				categories: taskData.categories.map((category) => category.id) || [],
				deadline: taskData.deadline,
				dateRange: taskData.dateRange,
				budget: {
					currency: taskData.budget.currency,
					type: taskData.budget.type,
					tier: budgetTier
				},
				pickupLocation: taskData.pickupLocation
					? {
							longitude: taskData.pickupLocation.longitude!,
							latitude: taskData.pickupLocation.latitude!,
							displayName: taskData.pickupLocation.displayName
						}
					: undefined,
				dropOffLocation: taskData.dropOffLocation
					? {
							longitude: taskData.dropOffLocation.longitude!,
							latitude: taskData.dropOffLocation.latitude!,
							displayName: taskData.dropOffLocation.displayName
						}
					: undefined
			};

			const result = await savedSearchService.triggerSavedSearchCheck(taskBodyDto);

			if (result.success && result.matchCount > 0) {
				console.log(`📧 ${result.matchCount} saved search notifications sent`);
			}
		} catch (error) {
			// Silently handle errors in background operation - don't interrupt user flow
			console.warn('⚠️ Background saved search check failed:', error);
		}
	};

	// Function to refresh My Tasks list after creating/updating a task
	async function refreshMyTasks() {
		try {
			// Reload the first page of My Tasks to show the new task
			await findMyTasks({ page: 1, limit: 20, refresh: true });
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error refreshing My Tasks:', error);
		}
	}

	// Function to handle cancel/back to My Tasks
	function handleCancel() {
		// Check if we're in edit mode
		const isEditing = $page.url.searchParams.get('edit') === 'true';
		// Clear the appropriate draft (creation or edit)
		store.clearDraft(isEditing);
		// Navigate back to My Tasks
		goto('/hiring');
	}

	// Save draft before leaving the page
	let isEditingMode = $state(false);
	let beforeUnloadHandler: (() => void) | null = null;

	// Load the draft when the page is loaded
	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			isLoading = true;

			// Check if we're in edit mode
			const isEditing = $page.url.searchParams.get('edit') === 'true';
			isEditingMode = isEditing;

			if (isEditing) {
				// Load the draft for editing (uses EDIT_STORAGE_KEY)
				await store.loadDraft(true);
				// Mark that edit data is loaded
				isEditDataLoaded = true;
			} else {
				// Load draft for new task creation (uses CREATE_STORAGE_KEY)
				await store.loadDraft(false);
				// Mark that edit data is loaded
				isEditDataLoaded = true;
			}

			// Setup auto-save on page unload
			if (browser) {
				beforeUnloadHandler = () => {
					// Force immediate save before leaving
					store.saveDraft(isEditingMode, true);
				};

				window.addEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnloadHandler);
			}
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading draft:', error);
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	});

	// Save draft when component is destroyed
	onDestroy(() => {
		if (browser) {
			// Remove beforeunload listener
			if (beforeUnloadHandler) {
				window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', beforeUnloadHandler);
			}
			// Save draft one more time when component is destroyed
			store.saveDraft(isEditingMode, true);
		}
	});

	function validateCurrentStep(): boolean {
		errors = {};
		switch ($store.currentStep) {
			case 'basics':
				if (!$store.task.title?.trim()) errors.title = $t('task.errors.title_required');
				if ($store.task.title && $store.task.title.length > 200)
					errors.title = $t('task.errors.title_too_long');
				if ($store.task.dateRange) {
					// Validar que ambos campos de fecha sean requeridos
					if (
						!$store.task.dateRange.start ||
						!$store.task.dateRange.end ||
						$store.task.dateRange.end === 'null' ||
						$store.task.dateRange.end === null
					) {
						errors.deadline = $t('task.errors.date_range_required');
					}

					// Validar que las fechas estén en el futuro (comparando solo fechas, no horas)
					const today = new Date();
					const todayDateStr = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];

					const startDate = new Date($store.task.dateRange.start);
					const startDateStr = startDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];

					const endDate = new Date($store.task.dateRange.end);
					const endDateStr = endDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];

					if (
						endDateStr < todayDateStr ||
						startDateStr < todayDateStr ||
						endDateStr < startDateStr
					) {
						errors.deadline = $t('task.errors.date_range_future');
					}
				}
				if ($store.task.deadline) {
					const deadlineDate = new Date($store.task.deadline);
					const today = new Date();

					// Compare dates using date strings to avoid timezone issues
					const deadlineDateStr = deadlineDate.toISOString().split('T')[0];
					const todayDateStr = today.toISOString().split('T')[0];

					if (deadlineDateStr < todayDateStr)
						// Allow today's date for deadline
						errors.deadline = $t('task.errors.deadline_future');
				}
				if ($store.task?.categories?.length === 0)
					errors.category = $t('task.errors.category_required');
				if ($store.task?.skills?.length === 0) errors.skill = $t('task.errors.skill_required');
				break;
			case 'location':
				if ($store.isRemovals) {
					if (!$store.task.pickupLocation?.latitude || !$store.task.pickupLocation?.longitude) {
						errors.location = $t('task.errors.pickup_required');
					}
					if (!$store.task.dropOffLocation?.latitude || !$store.task.dropOffLocation?.longitude) {
						errors.location = $t('task.errors.dropoff_required');
					}
				}
				if (
					$store.task.taskType === TaskTypeEnum.IN_PERSON &&
					(!$store.task.pickupLocation?.latitude || !$store.task.pickupLocation?.longitude)
				) {
					errors.location = $t('task.errors.location_required');
				}
				break;
			case 'budget':
				if (!$store.task.budget.amount || $store.task.budget.amount <= 0) {
					errors.budget = $t('task.errors.budget_required');
				}
				if (!$store.task.description?.trim())
					errors.description = $t('task.errors.description_required');
				if ($store.task.description?.trim().length < 20)
					errors.description = $t('task.errors.description_min_length');
				break;
			case 'taskboost':
				// Task boost step doesn't need validation as it's optional
				break;
			case 'review':
				// Review step doesn't need validation as it's just reviewing previous inputs
				break;
		}

		return Object.keys(errors).length === 0;
	}

	const handleNext = async () => {
		// Save current skill input if we're on the basics step
		if ($store.currentStep === TaskStepEnum.BASICS && taskBasicsRef) {
			taskBasicsRef.saveCurrentSkillInput?.();
		}

		if (!validateCurrentStep()) return;

		// Proceed to next step immediately
		store.nextStep();
		store.saveDraft();
		direction = 'forward';
	};

	async function handleSubmit() {
		if (!validateCurrentStep()) return;

		let signedEventId: string | null = null;

		try {
			isSubmitting = true;

			if (taskBudgetRef && taskBudgetRef.uploadPendingFiles) {
				try {
					const uploadedAttachments = await taskBudgetRef.uploadPendingFiles();
					// Solo mostrar mensajes si realmente se subieron archivos
					if (uploadedAttachments.length > 0) {
						appStore.showInfoToast($t('task.upload.uploading_files'));
						appStore.showSuccessToast($t('task.upload.files_uploaded'));
					}
				} catch (uploadError) {
					appStore.showErrorToast($t('task.upload.upload_failed'));
					throw uploadError;
				}
			}

			const task: TaskBody = {
				title: $store.task.title,
				description: $store.task.description,
				budget: $store.task.budget,
				deadline: $store.task.deadline,
				dateRange: $store.task.dateRange,
				taskType: $store.task.taskType,
				pickupLocation: $store.task.pickupLocation,
				dropOffLocation: $store.task.dropOffLocation,
				skills: $store.task.skills,
				attachments: $store.task.attachments,
				categories: $store.task.categories,
				status: TaskStatusEnum.OPEN
			};

			const isUpdating = $page.url.searchParams.get('edit') === 'true';

			if (isUpdating) {
				signedEventId = await updateTask($store.id, task);
				appStore.showSuccessToast($t('task.success.updated'));

				// Refresh My Tasks list to show updated task
				await refreshMyTasks();

				const url = new URL($page.url);
				url.searchParams.delete('edit');
				goto(url);
			} else {
				if ($store.recurringTask.isRecurring) {
					signedEventId = await createRecurringTask(task, $store.recurringTask);
				} else {
					signedEventId = await createTask(task);
				}

				appStore.showSuccessToast($t('task.success.created'));

				// Enrich backend with task deadline for scheduled reminders
				if (signedEventId) {
					const deadlineStr = $store.task.deadline ?? $store.task.dateRange?.end;
					const taskDeadline = deadlineStr
						? Math.floor(new Date(deadlineStr).getTime() / 1000)
						: undefined;
					notificationCenterService.enrich({
						action: 'task_created',
						taskId: signedEventId,
						taskDeadline,
						taskTitle: $store.task.title || undefined
					});
				}
			}

			// Trigger saved search check BEFORE clearing draft (store still has task data)
			if (signedEventId) {
				const currentTask = {
					title: $store.task.title,
					description: $store.task.description,
					budget: $store.task.budget,
					deadline: $store.task.deadline,
					dateRange: $store.task.dateRange,
					taskType: $store.task.taskType,
					pickupLocation: $store.task.pickupLocation,
					dropOffLocation: $store.task.dropOffLocation,
					skills: $store.task.skills,
					attachments: $store.task.attachments,
					categories: $store.task.categories,
					status: TaskStatusEnum.OPEN
				};
				triggerSavedSearchChecks(currentTask, signedEventId);
			}

			// Clear the appropriate draft (creation or edit)
			await store.clearDraft(isUpdating);

			// Refresh My Tasks list to show new task
			await refreshMyTasks();

			await goto('/hiring');
		} catch (error) {
			const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : $t('task.errors.create_failed');
			errors.general = errorMessage;
			appStore.showErrorToast(errorMessage);
		} finally {
			isSubmitting = false;
		}
	}
</script>

<!-- Mismas dimensiones que Mi Panel: max-w-6xl, px-2 py-6 md:px-0 md:py-0 -->
<div class="mx-auto h-full max-w-6xl px-2 py-6 md:px-0 md:py-0">

<script lang="ts">
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import DashboardContractsPanelNDK from '$lib/components/contracts/DashboardContractsPanelNDK.svelte';
	import { parseEarningQuery } from '$lib/utils/dashboardQuery';
	import type { DashboardContractStatusFilter } from '$lib/utils/helpers/dashboardContractFilters';

	function translateOrFallback(
		translate: (key: string) => string,
		key: string,
		fallback: string
	): string {
		const translated = translate(key);
		return translated === key ? fallback : translated;
	}

	const parsed = $derived(parseEarningQuery(page.url));
	let contractsType = $derived(parsed.type ?? 'all');
	let currentContractsHighlight = $derived(parsed.highlight ?? null);
	let selectedServiceAddress = $derived(parsed.service ?? null);
	let activeStatus = $derived(parsed.status ?? null);
	let nonBlockingMessageCode = $state<string | null>(null);

	function handleContractsHighlightConsumed() {
		// eslint-disable-next-line svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity
		const params = new URLSearchParams();
		params.set('type', contractsType);
		if (selectedServiceAddress) params.set('service', selectedServiceAddress);
		goto(`/earning/contracts?${params.toString()}`, {
			replaceState: true,
			keepFocus: true,
			noScroll: true
		});
	}

	function handleContractsHighlightMissing() {
		nonBlockingMessageCode = 'contracts_highlight_not_found';
		handleContractsHighlightConsumed();
	}

	function handleContractsServiceFilterChange(serviceAddress: string | null) {
		nonBlockingMessageCode = null;
		// eslint-disable-next-line svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity
		const params = new URLSearchParams();
		params.set('type', serviceAddress ? 'services' : 'all');
		if (serviceAddress) params.set('service', serviceAddress);
		goto(`/earning/contracts?${params.toString()}`, {
			replaceState: true,
			keepFocus: true,
			noScroll: true
		});
	}

	function handleContractsFiltersReset() {
		nonBlockingMessageCode = null;
		goto('/earning/contracts?type=all', {
			replaceState: true,
			keepFocus: true,
			noScroll: true
		});
	}
</script>

{#if nonBlockingMessageCode === 'contracts_highlight_not_found'}
	<div class="alert alert-info my-4 text-sm">
		<span>
			{translateOrFallback(
				$t,
				'dashboard.earning.messages.contracts_highlight_not_found',
				'The requested contract highlight could not be found.'
			)}
		</span>
	</div>
{/if}

<div id="panel-contracts" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-contracts">
	<DashboardContractsPanelNDK
		initialType={contractsType}
		initialStatus={(activeStatus ?? 'all') as DashboardContractStatusFilter}
		showRoleFilters={false}
		fixedRole="freelancer"
		showServiceFilter={true}
		{selectedServiceAddress}
		onServiceFilterChange={handleContractsServiceFilterChange}
		onClearFilters={handleContractsFiltersReset}
		emptyStateActionLabel={translateOrFallback($t, 'dashboard.find_task', 'Find Tasks')}
		emptyStateActionHref="/tasks"
		highlightEscrowId={currentContractsHighlight}
		onHighlightConsumed={handleContractsHighlightConsumed}
		onHighlightMissing={handleContractsHighlightMissing}

<script lang="ts">
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { get } from 'svelte/store';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import DashboardServiceRequestsPanel from '$lib/components/service/DashboardServiceRequestsPanel.svelte';
	import { serviceQuoteUiStore } from '$lib/stores/service-quote-ui.store';
	import { parseEarningQuery } from '$lib/utils/dashboardQuery';

	function clearRequestsRouteMessage() {
		if (get(serviceQuoteUiStore).nonBlockingMessageCode !== null) {
			serviceQuoteUiStore.setNonBlockingMessage(null);
		}
	}

	function translateOrFallback(
		translate: (key: string) => string,
		key: string,
		fallback: string
	): string {
		const translated = translate(key);
		return translated === key ? fallback : translated;
	}

	const parsed = $derived(parseEarningQuery(page.url));
	let status = $derived(parsed.status);
	let selectedServiceAddress = $derived(parsed.service);
	let focusedRequestId = $derived(parsed.request);
	let nonBlockingMessageCode = $state<string | null>(null);

	function handleProviderRouteUpdate(
		update:
			| {
					type: 'service';
					serviceAddress: string;
					requestId?: string | null;
					status?: string | null;
			  }
			| { type: 'reset'; status?: string | null }
			| { type: 'request'; requestId: string | null; status?: string | null }
	) {
		if (update.type === 'reset') {
			nonBlockingMessageCode = null;
			clearRequestsRouteMessage();
			goto(`/earning/requests?status=${update.status ?? ''}`, {
				replaceState: true,
				keepFocus: true,
				noScroll: true
			});
			return;
		}

		if (update.type === 'request') {
			const pendingMessageCode = get(serviceQuoteUiStore).nonBlockingMessageCode;
			nonBlockingMessageCode =
				update.requestId === null && pendingMessageCode === 'service_requests_request_not_found'
					? 'service_requests_request_not_found'
					: null;
			if (pendingMessageCode !== null) {
				serviceQuoteUiStore.setNonBlockingMessage(null);
			}
			// eslint-disable-next-line svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity
			const params = new URLSearchParams();
			if (selectedServiceAddress) params.set('service', selectedServiceAddress);
			if (update.requestId) params.set('request', update.requestId);
			if (update.status) params.set('status', update.status);
			goto(`/earning/requests?${params.toString()}`, {
				replaceState: true,
				keepFocus: true,
				noScroll: true
			});
			return;
		}

		nonBlockingMessageCode = null;
		clearRequestsRouteMessage();
		// eslint-disable-next-line svelte/prefer-svelte-reactivity
		const params = new URLSearchParams();
		params.set('service', update.serviceAddress);
		if (update.requestId) params.set('request', update.requestId);
		if (update.status) params.set('status', update.status);
		goto(`/earning/requests?${params.toString()}`, {
			replaceState: true,
			keepFocus: true,
			noScroll: true
		});
	}
</script>

{#if nonBlockingMessageCode === 'service_requests_request_not_found'}
	<div class="alert alert-info my-4 text-sm">
		<span>
			{translateOrFallback(
				$t,
				'dashboard.earning.messages.service_requests_request_not_found',
				'The selected service quote thread could not be found.'
			)}
		</span>
	</div>
{/if}

<div id="panel-requests" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-requests">
	<DashboardServiceRequestsPanel
		{status}
		{selectedServiceAddress}
		{focusedRequestId}
		onResolveQuotesRoute={handleProviderRouteUpdate}
	/>

<script lang="ts">
	import { type EarningTab } from '$lib/utils/dashboardQuery';
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';

	let { children } = $props();

	function translateOrFallback(
		translate: (key: string) => string,
		key: string,
		fallback: string
	): string {
		const translated = translate(key);
		return translated === key ? fallback : translated;
	}

	const tabs = $derived.by(() => {
		const translate = $t;

		return [
			{
				id: 'bids',
				label: translateOrFallback(translate, 'dashboard.tabs.bids', 'Bids'),
				buttonLabel: translateOrFallback(translate, 'dashboard.find_task', 'Find Tasks'),
				buttonHref: '/tasks',
				icon: 'search'
			},
			{
				id: 'requests',
				label: translateOrFallback(translate, 'dashboard.tabs.requests', 'Requests'),
				buttonLabel: translateOrFallback(
					translate,
					'dashboard.services.my_services.create_service',
					'Create Service'
				),

		const path = page.url.pathname;

		const tabFromPath = match?.[1];
		if (tabFromPath && tabs.some((t) => t.id === tabFromPath)) {
			return tabFromPath as EarningTab;
		}
		return 'bids';
	});

	const activeTab = $derived.by(() => tabs.find((tab) => tab.id === activeTabId) || tabs[0]);

	function handleTabChange(tabId: string) {
		goto(`/earning/${tabId}`, { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true, noScroll: true });
	}

import { redirect } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { parseEarningQuery } from '$lib/utils/dashboardQuery';

export const prerender = false;

/**
 * Redirect handler for backward compatibility.
 * New URL: /earning/bids?service=X&request=Y&type=tasks&highlight=Z&status=S
 */
export function load({ url }: { url: URL }) {
	const parsed = parseEarningQuery(url);

	const targetUrl = new URL(`/earning/${parsed.tab}`, url.origin);

	// Carry over relevant query params
	if (parsed.service) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('service', parsed.service);
	}
	if (parsed.request) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('request', parsed.request);
	}
	if (parsed.type) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('type', parsed.type);
	}
	if (parsed.highlight) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('highlight', parsed.highlight);
	}
	if (parsed.status) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('status', parsed.status);
	}
	if (parsed.bidStatus) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('bidStatus', parsed.bidStatus);
	}

	throw redirect(301, targetUrl.toString());
}

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { user } from '$lib/stores/user.store';
	import { compressImage, validateImageFile } from '$lib/utils/imageCompression';
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';

	type FeedbackSubmission = {
		npub: string;
		status: 'Bug' | 'Feature';
		Description: string;
		Screenshot?: File;
		contact_info: string;
	};

	let status = $state<'' | 'Bug' | 'Feature'>('');
	let description = $state('');
	let screenshot = $state<File | null>(null);
	let contactInfo = $state('');
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let isSubmitted = $state(false);
	let error = $state('');
	let userNpub = $state('');
	let username = $state('');
	let statusBugInput = $state<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
	let fileInputEl = $state<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
	let isCompressing = $state(false);

	onMount(() => {
		// Get user's npub from the store
		const unsubscribe = user.subscribe((userData) => {
			if (userData.npub) {
				userNpub = userData.npub;
			}
			if (userData.name) {
				username = userData.name;
			}
		});

		// Load user data if not already loaded
		if (!userNpub) {
			user.getUserData().catch((err) => {
				console.error('Failed to load user data:', err);
			});
		}

		return unsubscribe;
	});

	async function handleSubmit() {
		if (!status) {
			error = $t('feedback.errors.select_type') || 'Please select Bug or Feature Request';
			if (statusBugInput) {
				statusBugInput.setCustomValidity(
					$t('feedback.errors.select_type') || 'Please select Bug or Feature Request'
				);
				statusBugInput.reportValidity();
			}
			return;
		} else if (statusBugInput) {
			statusBugInput.setCustomValidity('');
		}
		if (!description.trim()) {
			error = $t('feedback.errors.provide_description') || 'Please provide a description';
			return;
		}

		if (!userNpub) {
			error = $t('feedback.errors.missing_user') || 'Unable to identify user. Please try again.';
			return;
		}

		isLoading = true;
		error = '';

		try {
			const feedback: FeedbackSubmission = {
				npub: userNpub,
				status,
				Description: description.trim(),
				contact_info: contactInfo.trim(),
				Screenshot: screenshot || undefined
			};

			const formData = new FormData();
			formData.append('npub', feedback.npub);
			// Match NocoDB field casing exactly
			formData.append('status', feedback.status); // will be mapped to 'Status' on server
			formData.append('Description', feedback.Description);
			formData.append('contact_info', feedback.contact_info); // will be mapped to 'Contact info' on server
			if (feedback.Screenshot) formData.append('Screenshot', feedback.Screenshot);
			if (username) formData.append('username', username);

			// Debug: log outgoing payload (excluding file content)
			const debugPayload: Record<string, string | { name: string; size: number; type: string }> =
				{};
			for (const [k, v] of formData.entries()) {
				debugPayload[k] = v instanceof File ? { name: v.name, size: v.size, type: v.type } : v;
			}

			const res = await fetch('/srv-api/feedback', {
				method: 'POST',
				body: formData
			});
			if (!res.ok) {
				const data = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
				throw new Error(
					data?.error || $t('feedback.errors.submit_failed') || 'Feedback submission failed'
				);
			}
			isSubmitted = true;
			if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
				window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to submit feedback:', err);
			error = $t('feedback.errors.submit_failed') || 'Failed to submit feedback. Please try again.';
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	}

	async function handleFileChange(event: Event) {
		const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
		if (target.files && target.files[0]) {
			const originalFile = target.files[0];

			// Validate if it's an image file
			if (!originalFile.type.startsWith('image/')) {
				error = $t('feedback.errors.invalid_image') || 'Please select an image file';
				return;
			}

			// Validate image file before compression
			const validation = validateImageFile(originalFile);
			if (!validation.isValid) {
				error =
					validation.error || $t('feedback.errors.invalid_image_file') || 'Invalid image file';
				return;
			}

			isCompressing = true;
			error = '';

			try {
				// Compress the image
				const compressionResult = await compressImage(originalFile, {
					maxSizeMB: 2,
					maxWidthOrHeight: 3840,
					quality: 0.8,
					fileType: 'image/webp'
				});

				screenshot = compressionResult.file;
			} catch {
				screenshot = originalFile;
			} finally {
				isCompressing = false;
			}
		}
	}

	function resetForm() {
		status = '';
		description = '';
		screenshot = null;
		contactInfo = '';
		error = '';
		isSubmitted = false;
		isCompressing = false;
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { slide } from 'svelte/transition';
	import DashboardContractsPanelNDK from '$lib/components/contracts/DashboardContractsPanelNDK.svelte';
	import {
		serviceQuoteUiStore,
		createDashboardUrl,
		type DashboardContractsType
	} from '$lib/stores/service-quote-ui.store';
	import type { DashboardContractTypeFilter } from '$lib/utils/helpers/dashboardContractFilters';

	let contractsType = $state<DashboardContractsType>('all');
	let currentContractsHighlight = $state<string | null>(null);

	function syncFromUrl() {
		const typeParam = page.url.searchParams.get('type');
		contractsType =
			typeParam === 'tasks' || typeParam === 'services' ? typeParam : 'all';
		currentContractsHighlight = page.url.searchParams.get('highlight') || null;
	}

	onMount(syncFromUrl);

	$effect(() => {
		page.url.searchParams.toString();
		syncFromUrl();
	});

	const contractsInitialType = $derived.by<DashboardContractTypeFilter>(() => {
		if (contractsType === 'services') return 'services';
		if (contractsType === 'tasks') return 'tasks';
		return 'all';
	});

	function handleContractsHighlightConsumed() {
		const nextUrl = createDashboardUrl(page.url, {
			tab: 'contracts',
			type: contractsType,
			highlight: null
		});
		goto(nextUrl.toString(), { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true, noScroll: true });
	}

	function handleContractsHighlightMissing() {
		serviceQuoteUiStore.setNonBlockingMessage('contracts_highlight_not_found');
		const nextUrl = createDashboardUrl(page.url, {
			tab: 'contracts',
			type: contractsType,
			highlight: null
		});
		goto(nextUrl.toString(), { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true, noScroll: true });
	}
</script>

<div transition:slide={{ duration: 300 }}>
	<DashboardContractsPanelNDK
		initialType={contractsInitialType}
		showRoleFilters={false}
		fixedRole="client"
		highlightEscrowId={currentContractsHighlight}
		onHighlightConsumed={handleContractsHighlightConsumed}
		onHighlightMissing={handleContractsHighlightMissing}
	/>
</div>

	const setDrawerState = (
		isOpen: boolean,
		task: Task | null = selectedTask,
		tab: string = drawerInitialTab
	) => {
		drawerOpen = isOpen;
		selectedTask = task;
		drawerInitialTab = tab;
		if (!isOpen) activeTaskModal = null;
	};

	const setTaskModal = (type: 'edit' | 'delete' | null) => {
		if (type && !selectedTask) return;
		activeTaskModal = type;
	};

	const confirmEditTask = async () => {
		const taskToEdit = selectedTask;
		if (!taskToEdit) return;

		try {
			const contracts = await ndk.fetchEvents(
				{ kinds: [KINDS.CONTRACT], '#t': [taskToEdit.id], limit: 1 },
				{ closeOnEose: true }
			);
			if (contracts.size > 0) {
				appStore.showErrorToast(
					$t('dashboard.task_details_by_task.cannot_edit_with_contract') ||
						'Cannot edit task: A contract has been created for this task.'
				);
				activeTaskModal = null;
				return;
			}
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error checking contracts before edit:', error);
			appStore.showErrorToast(
				$t('dashboard.task_details_by_task.cannot_edit_error') ||
					'Unable to verify if task can be edited. Please try again.'
			);
			activeTaskModal = null;
			return;
		}

		const editTask: TaskBody = {
			title: taskToEdit.title,
			taskType: taskToEdit.taskType,
			description: taskToEdit.description,
			budget: taskToEdit.budget,
			deadline: taskToEdit.deadline ?? undefined,
			dateRange: taskToEdit.dateRange ?? undefined,
			pickupLocation: taskToEdit.pickupLocation ?? undefined,
			dropOffLocation: taskToEdit.dropOffLocation ?? undefined,
			skills: taskToEdit.skills,
			categories: taskToEdit.categories,
			attachments: taskToEdit.attachments,
			status: taskToEdit.status,
			translations: taskToEdit.translations
		};
		taskStore.saveEditTaskDraft(taskToEdit.id, taskToEdit.id, editTask);
		activeTaskModal = null;
		goto(`/create-task?edit=true`);
	};

	const confirmDeleteTask = async () => {
		const taskToDelete = selectedTask;
		if (!taskToDelete) return;
		try {
			isDeleting = true;
			const eventId =
				'eventId' in taskToDelete
					? (taskToDelete as Task & { eventId?: string }).eventId
					: undefined;
			await deleteTask(taskToDelete.id, eventId);
			$myTasksStore.items = $myTasksStore.items.filter((t) => t.id !== taskToDelete.id);
			activeTaskModal = null;
			setDrawerState(false, null);
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Failed to delete task:', error);
		} finally {
			isDeleting = false;
		}
	};
</script>

<div transition:slide={{ duration: 300 }}>
	<DashboardTasksPanel
		status={activeStatus}
		openTaskDrawer={(task, tab = 'details') => setDrawerState(true, task, tab)}
	/>
</div>

<TaskDrawer
	task={selectedTask}
	isOpen={drawerOpen}
	activeTab={drawerInitialTab}
	onClose={() => setDrawerState(false, null)}
	onRequestEditConfirm={() => setTaskModal('edit')}
	onRequestDeleteConfirm={() => setTaskModal('delete')}
	{isDeleting}
/>

	<div class="modal modal-open modal-middle" transition:fade={{ duration: 200 }}>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { slide } from 'svelte/transition';
	import MyQuotesPanel from '$lib/components/dashboard/quotes/MyQuotesPanel.svelte';
	import {
		serviceQuoteUiStore,
		getTaskerTimelines,
		isRequestSyncActive,
		createDashboardUrl
	} from '$lib/stores/service-quote-ui.store';

	function translateOrFallback(key: string, fallback: string): string {
		const translated = $t(key);
		return translated === key ? fallback : translated;
	}

	let focusedRequestId = $state<string | null>(null);
	let activeStatus = $state<string | null>(null);
	let taskerTimelines = $state<ReturnType<typeof getTaskerTimelines>>([]);
	let nonBlockingMessageCode = $state<string | null>(null);
	let taskerQuotesStoreSyncing = $state(false);
	const taskerQuotesSyncing = $derived(taskerQuotesStoreSyncing);
	let taskerQuotesError = $state<string | null>(null);
	let taskerQuotesLoaded = $state(false);

	function syncFromUrl() {
		focusedRequestId = page.url.searchParams.get('requestId') || null;
		activeStatus = page.url.searchParams.get('status') || null;
		const messageCodeParam = page.url.searchParams.get('messageCode');
		if (messageCodeParam) {
			nonBlockingMessageCode = messageCodeParam;
		}
	}

	onMount(() => {
		syncFromUrl();

		void serviceQuoteUiStore.loadTaskerTimelines(focusedRequestId).catch(() => {});

		const unsubscribeServiceQuotes = serviceQuoteUiStore.subscribe((state) => {
			taskerTimelines = getTaskerTimelines(state);
			nonBlockingMessageCode = state.nonBlockingMessageCode;
			taskerQuotesError = state.taskerLoadError;
			taskerQuotesLoaded = state.taskerLoaded;
			taskerQuotesStoreSyncing =
				state.loadingTasker || isRequestSyncActive(state, focusedRequestId, null);
		});

		return () => {
			unsubscribeServiceQuotes();
		};
	});

	$effect(() => {
		page.url.searchParams.toString();
		syncFromUrl();
	});

	function handleTaskerRequestFocus(requestId: string | null) {
		serviceQuoteUiStore.setNonBlockingMessage(
			requestId === null ? 'service_requests_request_not_found' : null
		);
		const nextUrl = createDashboardUrl(page.url, {
			tab: 'service-requests',
			view: 'tasker',
			requestId,
			status: activeStatus
		});
		goto(nextUrl.toString(), { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true, noScroll: true });
	}

	function handleTaskerRequestClear() {
		serviceQuoteUiStore.setNonBlockingMessage(null);
		const nextUrl = createDashboardUrl(page.url, {
			tab: 'service-requests',
			view: 'tasker',
			requestId: null,
			status: activeStatus
		});
		goto(nextUrl.toString(), { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true, noScroll: true });
	}

	function handleInvalidFocusedRequest() {
		handleTaskerRequestFocus(null);
	}
</script>

	 * Determine active tab from the current URL path.
	 * Matches /hiring/my-tasks, /hiring/contracts, /hiring/service-requests.

	let activeTabId = $derived.by(() => {

		const match = path.match(/\/hiring\/([\w-]+)/);
		const tabFromPath = match?.[1];

			return tabFromPath;
		}
		return 'my-tasks';
	});

	const activeTab = $derived.by(() => tabs.find((tab) => tab.id === activeTabId) || tabs[0]);

	/**
	 * Navigate to the selected tab's route.
	 * Preserves existing query params (type, highlight, status, etc.)
	 */
	function handleTabChange(tabId: string) {
		const nextUrl = new URL(`/hiring/${tabId}`, page.url.origin);
		// Carry over relevant query params for backward compatibility
		for (const [key, value] of page.url.searchParams) {
			nextUrl.searchParams.set(key, value);
		}
		goto(nextUrl.toString(), { replaceState: true, keepFocus: true, noScroll: true });
	}

import { redirect } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { parseEarningQuery } from '$lib/utils/dashboardQuery';

export const prerender = false;

const HIRING_TAB_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
	tasks: '/hiring/my-tasks',
	contracts: '/hiring/contracts',
	'service-requests': '/hiring/service-requests'
};

const EARNING_TABS = new Set(['bids', 'my-services', 'requests', 'saved-searches']);

export function load({ url }: { url: URL }) {
	const rawTab = url.searchParams.get('tab');

	if (!rawTab || (!HIRING_TAB_MAP[rawTab] && !EARNING_TABS.has(rawTab))) {
		throw redirect(301, '/hiring/my-tasks');
	}

	if (EARNING_TABS.has(rawTab)) {
		const parsed = parseEarningQuery(url);
		const targetUrl = new URL(`/earning/${parsed.tab}`, url.origin);

		if (parsed.service) {
			targetUrl.searchParams.set('service', parsed.service);
		}
		if (parsed.request) {
			targetUrl.searchParams.set('request', parsed.request);
		}
		if (parsed.type) {
			targetUrl.searchParams.set('type', parsed.type);
		}
		if (parsed.highlight) {
			targetUrl.searchParams.set('highlight', parsed.highlight);
		}
		if (parsed.status) {
			targetUrl.searchParams.set('status', parsed.status);
		}
		if (parsed.bidStatus) {
			targetUrl.searchParams.set('bidStatus', parsed.bidStatus);
		}

		throw redirect(301, targetUrl.toString());
	}

	const targetPath = HIRING_TAB_MAP[rawTab] ?? '/hiring/my-tasks';
	const targetUrl = new URL(targetPath, url.origin);

	const type = url.searchParams.get('type');
	if (type) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('type', type);
	}

	const highlight = url.searchParams.get('highlight');
	if (highlight) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('highlight', highlight);
	}

	const status = url.searchParams.get('status');
	if (status) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('status', status);
	}

	const requestId = url.searchParams.get('requestId');
	if (requestId) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('requestId', requestId);
	}

	const view = url.searchParams.get('view');
	if (view) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('view', view);
	}

	const messageCode = url.searchParams.get('messageCode');
	if (messageCode) {
		targetUrl.searchParams.set('messageCode', messageCode);
	}

	throw redirect(301, targetUrl.toString());
}

	import { messageTranslations } from '$lib/stores/translation.store';
	import { parseMessageContent } from '$lib/utils/helpers/messageParser';
	import { muteStore } from '$lib/stores/mute.store';
	import { truncateNpub } from '$lib/utils/nostr';
	import Avatar from '$lib/components/Avatar.svelte';
	import KINDS from '$lib/utils/constants/kinds';

	/**
	 * Helper function to get display content for a conversation
	 */
	function getDisplayContent(conversation: (typeof conversations)[0]): string {
		if (!conversation.lastEvent.content) {
			return $t('messages.no_messages');
		}

		const messageId = conversation.lastEvent.id;
		const messageTranslation = $messageTranslations.get(messageId);
		const parsedContent = parseMessageContent(conversation.lastEvent.content);
		const isReply = parsedContent.startsWith('> ') && parsedContent.includes('\n\n');

		// If it's a reply, only show the actual message (not the quoted part)
		if (isReply) {
			const parts = parsedContent.split('\n\n');
			const actualMessage = parts.slice(1).join('\n\n').trim();
			const actualMessageTranslation = $messageTranslations.get(messageId);
			return actualMessageTranslation ? actualMessageTranslation.translatedText : actualMessage;
		}

		// For regular messages, show translation if available
		if (messageTranslation) {
			return messageTranslation.translatedText;
		}

		return translateMessageContent(conversation.lastEvent.content);
	}

	/**
	 * Helper function to translate message content if it's a translation key
	 * Translation keys typically follow patterns like: dashboard.bids.bid_acceptance.acceptance_message
	 * This function is used in the template, so it will be reactive to language changes
	 */
	function translateMessageContent(content: string): string {
		if (!content || !content.trim()) {
			return content;
		}

		// Check if it looks like a translation key (contains dots and follows a pattern)
		// Translation keys typically have at least 2 segments separated by dots
		const translationKeyPattern = /^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*)+$/i;
		const trimmedContent = content.trim();

		if (translationKeyPattern.test(trimmedContent)) {
			try {
				// Try to translate it using the reactive $t function
				// Since this is called from the template, $t will be reactive
				const translated = $t(trimmedContent);
				// If translation returns the key itself or an error, return original
				// svelte-i18n returns the key if translation is missing, so check if it changed
				return translated && translated !== trimmedContent ? translated : content;
			} catch {
				// If translation fails, return original content
				return content;
			}
		}

		// Not a translation key, return as-is
		return content;
	}

	// State
	type ConversationLastEvent = Omit<NostrEvent, 'content'> & { content: string };

	let conversations = $state<
		{
			pubkey: string;
			lastEvent: ConversationLastEvent;
			profile: { name?: string; picture?: string };
		}[]
	>([]);
	let isLoading = $state(true);
	let error = $state('');

	// Search state
	let searchQuery = $state('');

	// First filter out muted users, then apply the search query
	const unmutedConversations = $derived(
		$muteStore.mutedPubkeys.size > 0
			? conversations.filter((c) => !$muteStore.mutedPubkeys.has(c.pubkey))
			: conversations
	);

	let filteredConversations = $derived(
		searchQuery.trim() === ''
			? unmutedConversations
			: unmutedConversations.filter((c) => {
					const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
					return (
						c.profile.name?.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
						c.pubkey.toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
						c.lastEvent.content?.toLowerCase().includes(query)
					);
				})
	);

	// Modal state
	let showModal = $state(false);
	let newMessagePubkey = $state('');
	let newMessageError = $state('');
	let newMessageProfile = $state<{ name?: string; picture?: string; pubkey?: string } | null>(null);
	let isProfileLoading = $state(false);

	// Username search state
	let isUsernameSearching = $state(false);
	let usernameSearchError = $state('');
	let showUsernameResults = $state(false);
	let usernameSearchResults = $state<
		{
			pubkey: string;
			profile: { name?: string; picture?: string };
		}[]
	>([]);
	let searchTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

	// Real-time subscription for conversation list updates
	let conversationListUnsubscribe: (() => void) | null = null;

	// Load conversations on mount
	onMount(async () => {
		await loadConversations();
	});

	// Cleanup on component destroy
	onDestroy(() => {
		if (conversationListUnsubscribe) {
			conversationListUnsubscribe();
		}
	});

	function setupConversationListListener(npub: string, nsec: Uint8Array) {
		// Clean up existing subscription
		if (conversationListUnsubscribe) {
			conversationListUnsubscribe();
		}

		// Setup new subscription for real-time conversation updates
		conversationListUnsubscribe = listenForIncomingMessages(npub, nsec, async (msg) => {
			const { plaintext, senderPubkey, event } = msg;

			// Filter out system messages - only show user-to-user messages in conversation list
			// System messages should be handled by notifications, not shown in chat previews
			if (!isUserToUserMessage(plaintext)) {
				return; // Skip system messages in conversation list
			}

			// Determine the other party before applying the mute check
			const recipientTag = event.tags.find((tag) => tag[0] === 'p');
			const otherPartyPubkey = senderPubkey === npub ? recipientTag?.[1] : senderPubkey;
			if (otherPartyPubkey && $muteStore.mutedPubkeys.has(otherPartyPubkey)) {
				return; // Skip messages from muted users
			}

			// Determine the OTHER person in this conversation
			// If senderPubkey is us (we sent the message), get recipient from #p tag
			// If senderPubkey is not us (we received the message), senderPubkey IS the other person
			let otherPubkey: string;

			if (senderPubkey === npub) {
				// We sent this message, so get the recipient from the #p tag
				const recipientTag = event.tags.find((tag) => tag[0] === 'p');
				if (!recipientTag || !recipientTag[1]) {
					console.error('No recipient found in message tags');
					return;
				}
				otherPubkey = recipientTag[1];
			} else {
				// We received this message, so the sender is the other person
				otherPubkey = senderPubkey;
			}

			// Find or create conversation for this OTHER person
			const existingConversationIndex = conversations.findIndex((c) => c.pubkey === otherPubkey);

			if (existingConversationIndex >= 0) {
				// Update existing conversation
				const existingConversation = conversations[existingConversationIndex];

				// Only update if this message is newer
				if (event.created_at > existingConversation.lastEvent.created_at) {
					const updatedConversation = {
						...existingConversation,
						lastEvent: {
							...event,
							content: plaintext // Store decrypted content for display
						}
					};

					// Remove from current position and add to top
					conversations = [
						updatedConversation,
						...conversations.slice(0, existingConversationIndex),
						...conversations.slice(existingConversationIndex + 1)
					];
				}
			} else {
				// Create new conversation with the OTHER person
				try {
					const profile = await fetchProfileMetadata(otherPubkey);
					const newConversation = {
						pubkey: otherPubkey,
						lastEvent: {
							...event,
							content: plaintext // Store decrypted content for display
						},
						profile: profile || {}
					};

					// Add to top of conversations
					conversations = [newConversation, ...conversations];
				} catch (err) {
					console.error('Failed to fetch profile for new conversation:', err);
				}
			}
		});
	}

	async function loadConversations() {
		try {
			isLoading = true;
			error = '';

			const people = await getMessagedPeople();

			if (!people.length) {
				return (isLoading = false);
			}

			// Decrypt ONLY last messages in parallel
			const { nsec, npub } = await getNostrKeyPair();
			const privkey = bytesToHex(nsec);

			const conversationPromises = people.map(async (person) => {
				try {
					const { plaintext } = await parseDMEvent(person.lastEvent, privkey, npub);

					// Filter system messages
					if (!isUserToUserMessage(plaintext)) {
						return null;
					}

					return {
						pubkey: person.pubkey,
						lastEvent: { ...person.lastEvent, content: plaintext },
						profile: person.profile
					};
				} catch (err) {
					console.error('Failed to decrypt last message:', err);
					return null;
				}
			});

			const results = await Promise.all(conversationPromises);
			conversations = results
				.filter((c) => c !== null)
				.sort((a, b) => b.lastEvent.created_at - a.lastEvent.created_at);

			// Setup real-time updates for conversation list
			console.log('listening for incoming conversations');
			setupConversationListListener(npub, nsec);
		} catch {
			error = 'messages.failed_load_conversations';
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	}

	// Profile subscription removed - using props instead

	// Handle conversation selection
	function selectConversation(pubkey: string) {
		goto(`/messages/to/${pubkey}`);
	}

	// Handle new message
	function startNewMessage() {
		newMessagePubkey = '';
		newMessageError = '';
		newMessageProfile = null;
		showModal = true;
		// Reset username search state
		showUsernameResults = false;
		usernameSearchResults = [];
		usernameSearchError = '';
		isUsernameSearching = false;
	}

	function closeModal() {
		showModal = false;
		// Clear search timeout when closing modal
		if (searchTimeout) {
			clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
			searchTimeout = null;
		}
		// Reset all search states
		isUsernameSearching = false;
		showUsernameResults = false;
		usernameSearchResults = [];
		usernameSearchError = '';
	}

	async function handlePubkeyInput(e: Event) {
		const value = (e.target as HTMLInputElement).value.trim();
		newMessagePubkey = value;
		newMessageError = '';
		newMessageProfile = null;
		showUsernameResults = false;
		usernameSearchResults = [];
		usernameSearchError = '';
		isUsernameSearching = false;

		if (!value) return;

		// Check if it's a valid npub or hex pubkey first
		let hexPubkey = value;
		let isValidPubkey = false;

		if (value.startsWith('npub')) {
			try {
				hexPubkey = nip19.decode(value).data as string;
				isValidPubkey = true;
			} catch {
				newMessageError = 'messages.invalid_npub_format';
				return;
			}
		} else if (/^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(value)) {
			hexPubkey = value;
			isValidPubkey = true;
		}

		// If it's a valid pubkey, fetch profile directly
		if (isValidPubkey) {
			isProfileLoading = true;
			try {
				const profileEvent = await fetchProfileMetadata(hexPubkey);
				if (profileEvent && profileEvent.name && profileEvent.picture) {
					newMessageProfile = { name: profileEvent.name, picture: profileEvent.picture };
				}
			} catch {
				newMessageError = 'messages.failed_fetch_profile';
			} finally {
				isProfileLoading = false;
			}
		} else {
			// If it's not a valid pubkey, search by username
			// Only search if the input looks like a username (not a pubkey)
			if (value.length >= 2 && !/^[a-fA-F0-9]+$/.test(value)) {
				// Clear previous timeout
				if (searchTimeout) {
					clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
					searchTimeout = null;
				}

				// Set new timeout for debounced search
				searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
					searchUsersByUsername(value);
				}, 500); // 500ms delay
			} else {
				// Clear search results if input is too short or looks like a pubkey
				if (searchTimeout) {
					clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
					searchTimeout = null;
				}
				showUsernameResults = false;
				usernameSearchResults = [];
				usernameSearchError = '';
				isUsernameSearching = false;
			}
		}
	}

	// Search for users by username
	async function searchUsersByUsername(username: string) {
		if (username.length < 2) {
			showUsernameResults = false;
			isUsernameSearching = false;
			return;
		}

		isUsernameSearching = true;
		usernameSearchError = '';
		showUsernameResults = true;

		try {
			const profileMap = new SvelteMap<string, { name?: string; picture?: string }>();
			const relayUrl = import.meta.env.VITE_NOSTR_RELAY_URL;

			if (!relayUrl) {
				throw new Error('No relay URL configured');
			}

			// Search for profile events with matching names
			const filter: Filter = {
				kinds: [0], // Profile events
				limit: 50 // Increase limit to get more results
			};

			// Also search for image events (kind 30063) to get profile pictures
			const imageFilter: Filter = {
				kinds: [KINDS.PROFILE_IMAGES], // Image events
				'#d': ['profile-images'], // Profile images tag
				limit: 50
			};

			let eventCount = 0;
			const maxEvents = 100; // Limit total events processed
			let searchCompleted = false;

			const pool = $appStore?.pool;
			if (!pool) {
				throw new Error('Pool not found');
			}

			// First, search for profile events
			const unsubscribeProfiles = pool.subscribe([relayUrl], filter, {
				onevent: (event: NostrEvent) => {
					if (searchCompleted) return;

					eventCount++;

					// Stop processing if we've seen too many events
					if (eventCount > maxEvents) {
						searchCompleted = true;
						unsubscribeProfiles.close();
						return;
					}

					try {
						const profileData = JSON.parse(event.content);

						// Check if the profile has a name and it matches our search
						if (profileData.name) {
							const profileName = profileData.name.toLowerCase();
							const searchTerm = username.toLowerCase();

							// More flexible matching - check if search term is contained in name
							// or if name starts with search term
							if (profileName.includes(searchTerm) || profileName.startsWith(searchTerm)) {
								// Store profile data in map
								profileMap.set(event.pubkey, {
									name: profileData.name,
									picture: profileData.picture || profileData.banner // Try banner if no picture
								});

								// Update results immediately as we find them
								usernameSearchResults = Array.from(profileMap.entries())
									.map(([pubkey, profile]) => ({
										pubkey,
										profile
									}))
									.slice(0, 5);

								// Stop searching if we have enough results
								if (profileMap.size >= 5) {
									searchCompleted = true;
									unsubscribeProfiles.close();
									isUsernameSearching = false;
								}
							}
						}
					} catch {
						// Skip invalid profile data
					}
				}
			});

			// Also search for image events to get profile pictures
			const unsubscribeImages = pool.subscribe([relayUrl], imageFilter, {
				onevent: (event: NostrEvent) => {
					if (searchCompleted) return;

					try {
						const imageData = JSON.parse(event.content);

						// If we have a profile for this pubkey, add the image
						if (profileMap.has(event.pubkey) && imageData.length > 0) {
							const profile = profileMap.get(event.pubkey);
							if (profile && !profile.picture) {
								profile.picture = imageData[0].url;

								// Update results with the new image
								usernameSearchResults = Array.from(profileMap.entries())
									.map(([pubkey, profile]) => ({
										pubkey,
										profile
									}))
									.slice(0, 5);
							}
						}
					} catch {
						// Skip invalid image data
					}
				}
			});

			// Wait for search to complete or timeout
			await new Promise((resolve) => {
				const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
					searchCompleted = true;
					unsubscribeProfiles.close();
					unsubscribeImages.close();
					resolve(undefined);
				}, 2000); // Reduced to 2 second search duration

				// Also resolve if we have enough results
				const checkResults = setInterval(() => {
					if (searchCompleted || profileMap.size >= 3) {
						clearTimeout(timeoutId);
						clearInterval(checkResults);
						searchCompleted = true;
						unsubscribeProfiles.close();
						unsubscribeImages.close();
						isUsernameSearching = false;
						resolve(undefined);
					}
				}, 100); // Check every 100ms
			});

			// Final update of results
			usernameSearchResults = Array.from(profileMap.entries())
				.map(([pubkey, profile]) => ({
					pubkey,
					profile
				}))
				.slice(0, 5);

			if (profileMap.size === 0) {
				usernameSearchError = 'messages.no_users_found';
			}
		} catch (err) {
			usernameSearchError = 'messages.search_failed';
			console.error('Username search failed:', err);
		} finally {
			isUsernameSearching = false;
		}
	}

	// Select user from search results
	function selectUserFromSearch(pubkey: string) {
		const selectedUser = usernameSearchResults.find((user) => user.pubkey === pubkey);
		if (selectedUser) {
			newMessagePubkey = pubkey;
			newMessageProfile = { ...selectedUser.profile, pubkey: selectedUser.pubkey };
			showUsernameResults = false;
			usernameSearchResults = [];
		}
	}

	async function submitNewMessage(e: Event) {
		e.preventDefault();
		let value = newMessagePubkey.trim();
		let hexPubkey = value;
		if (value.startsWith('npub')) {
			try {
				hexPubkey = nip19.decode(value).data as string;
			} catch {
				newMessageError = 'messages.invalid_npub_format';
				return;
			}
		} else if (!/^[a-fA-F0-9]{64}$/.test(value)) {
			newMessageError = 'messages.invalid_pubkey_format';
			return;
		}

		// Navigate to the new chat page
		goto(`/messages/to/${hexPubkey}`);
		showModal = false;
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { notificationCenterStore } from '$lib/stores/notificationCenter.store';
	import NotificationCard from '$lib/components/notifications/NotificationCard.svelte';
	import NotificationEmptyState from '$lib/components/notifications/NotificationEmptyState.svelte';
	import NotificationSkeleton from '$lib/components/notifications/NotificationSkeleton.svelte';
	import ConfirmModal from '$lib/components/ConfirmModal.svelte';
	import { browserNetworkStatus } from '$lib/utils/network-status';

	const filterTabs = ['all', 'unread', 'read'];

	let activeFilter = $derived($notificationCenterStore.activeFilter);
	let notifications = $derived($notificationCenterStore.notifications);
	let loading = $derived($notificationCenterStore.loading);
	let loadingMore = $derived($notificationCenterStore.loadingMore);
	let hasMore = $derived($notificationCenterStore.hasMore);
	let total = $derived($notificationCenterStore.total);
	let unreadCount = $derived($notificationCenterStore.unreadCount);
	let isOffline = $derived(!$browserNetworkStatus.online);
	let showClearConfirm = $state(false);

	onMount(() => {
		notificationCenterStore.refresh();
	});

	function handleFilterChange(filter: string) {
		notificationCenterStore.setFilter(filter);
	}

	function handleLoadMore() {
		notificationCenterStore.loadMore();
	}

	function handleMarkAllRead() {
		notificationCenterStore.markAllRead();
	}

	function handleClearAll() {
		showClearConfirm = true;
	}

	async function confirmClearAll() {
		showClearConfirm = false;
		await notificationCenterStore.clearAll();
	}
</script>

<svelte:head>
	<title>{$t('notifications.page_title')}</title>
</svelte:head>

<div class="mx-auto h-full max-w-3xl px-2 py-6 md:px-0">
	<div class="mb-6">
		<div>
			<h3>{$t('notifications.title')}</h3>
			<p class="text-base-content/70 text-sm">{$t('notifications.subtitle')}</p>
		</div>
		<div class="mt-2 flex justify-end gap-2">
			{#if unreadCount > 0}
				<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm text-primary" onclick={handleMarkAllRead}>
					{$t('notifications.mark_all_read')}
				</button>
			{/if}
			{#if notifications.length > 0}
				<button class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm text-error" onclick={handleClearAll}>
					{$t('notifications.clear_all')}
				</button>
			{/if}
		</div>
	</div>

	{#if isOffline}
		<div class="alert alert-warning mb-4 text-sm">
			<span>{$t('notifications.offline_indicator')}</span>
		</div>
	{/if}

	<div class="mb-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2">
		{#each filterTabs as tab (tab)}
			<button
				class="btn btn-sm {activeFilter === tab ? 'btn-primary' : 'btn-ghost'}"
				onclick={() => handleFilterChange(tab)}
			>
				{$t(`notifications.filters.${tab}`)}
				{#if tab === 'unread' && unreadCount > 0}
					<span class="badge badge-xs">{unreadCount}</span>
				{/if}
			</button>
		{/each}
	</div>

	{#if loading}
		<div class="border-base-300 bg-base-100 divide-base-200 divide-y rounded-xl border">
			<NotificationSkeleton count={5} />
		</div>
	{:else if notifications.length === 0}
		<NotificationEmptyState />
	{:else}
		<div class="divide-base-200 border-base-300 bg-base-100 divide-y rounded-xl border">
			{#each notifications as notification (notification.id)}
				<NotificationCard {notification} />
			{/each}
		</div>

		{#if hasMore}
			<div class="mt-4 text-center">
				<button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" onclick={handleLoadMore} disabled={loadingMore}>
					{#if loadingMore}
						<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xs"></span>
					{/if}
					{$t('notifications.show_all')}
				</button>
			</div>
		{/if}

		<div class="text-base-content/50 mt-4 text-center text-xs">
			{$t('notifications.stats.showing')}
			{notifications.length}
			{$t('notifications.stats.of')}
			{total}
			{$t('notifications.stats.notifications')}
		</div>
	{/if}
</div>

<ConfirmModal
	isOpen={showClearConfirm}
	title={$t('notifications.clear_all_confirm_title')}
	message={$t('notifications.clear_all_confirm_message')}
	confirmText={$t('notifications.clear_all')}
	confirmButtonClass="btn-error"
	onConfirm={confirmClearAll}

	let completedSections = $state({
		personalInfo: false,
		// location: false,
		skills: false,
		portfolio: false,
		videoIntro: false,
		availability: false
		// aiAssistant: false

		personalInfo: false,
		// location: false,
		skills: true,
		portfolio: true,
		videoIntro: true,
		availability: true
		// aiAssistant: false

	let skillsComponent: Skills;

	// Global save state

	let saveError = $state('');

	// Section completion handlers
	function handleSectionComplete(
		section: keyof typeof completedSections,
		completed: boolean,
		fromSave?: boolean
	) {
		completedSections[section] = completed;
		// Show toast only when save occurs, not on every completion change
		if (fromSave) {
			appStore.showSuccessToast($t('profile.page.profile_updated'));
		}
	}

	// Calculate overall progress
	let progress = $derived(
		(Object.values(completedSections).filter(Boolean).length /
			Object.keys(completedSections).length) *
			100
	);

	// Save all and exit function
	async function saveAllAndExit() {
		isSaving = true;
		saveError = '';

		try {
			// Trigger save for all components by dispatching submit events
			const _components = [
				personalInfoComponent,
				skillsComponent,
				portfolioComponent,
				videoIntroComponent,
				availabilityComponent
			];

			// Find all forms in the components and submit them
			const forms = document.querySelectorAll('form');
			const submitPromises = Array.from(forms).map((form) => {
				return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
					const submitEvent = new Event('submit', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true });
					form.dispatchEvent(submitEvent);
					// Give a small delay to allow the form submission to process
					setTimeout(resolve, 100);
				});
			});

			await Promise.all(submitPromises);

			// Wait a bit more for all saves to complete
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));

			// Navigate back to profile view
			goto('/profile');
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error saving profile:', error);
			saveError = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to save profile';
		} finally {
			isSaving = false;
		}
	}

<script lang="ts">
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { profileStore } from '$lib/stores/profile.store';
	import ProfileHeader from '$lib/components/profile/ProfileHeader.svelte';
	import ProfileInfoSection from '$lib/components/profile/ProfileInfoSection.svelte';
	import ProfileSidebar from '$lib/components/profile/ProfileSidebar.svelte';
	import ProfileReviewsSection from '$lib/components/profile/ProfileReviewsSection.svelte';

	// Format date (passed to children)
	function formatDate(dateString: string) {
		const date = new Date(dateString);
		return date.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
	}

	// Initialize profile store
	onMount(() => {
		profileStore.init();
	});

	function getReviewTargetPubkeyFromUrl(url: URL): string | undefined {
		const user = url.searchParams.get('user')?.trim();
		return user || undefined;
	}

	const reviewTargetPubkey = $derived.by(() => {
		return getReviewTargetPubkeyFromUrl(page.url);
	});
	const isOtherUserReviewsView = $derived(Boolean(reviewTargetPubkey));

	let profileStoreInitialized = false;

	$effect(() => {
		if (isOtherUserReviewsView) {
			if (profileStoreInitialized) {
				profileStore.destroy();
				profileStoreInitialized = false;
			}
			return;
		}

		if (!profileStoreInitialized) {
			profileStore.init();
			profileStoreInitialized = true;
		}

		return () => {
			if (profileStoreInitialized) {
				profileStore.destroy();
				profileStoreInitialized = false;
			}
		};
	});
</script>

		{:else}

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { getNpub } from '$lib/utils/nostrKeys';
	import { getReviewsForUser, getReviewsByReviewer } from '$lib/utils/reviews/queries';
	import { calculateReviewStats } from '$lib/utils/reviews/aggregation';
	import { findPendingReviews, type PendingReview } from '$lib/utils/reviews/helpers';
	import type { NostrVerifiedReview, ReviewStats } from '$lib/types/review';
	import ReviewSummaryCard from '$lib/components/profile/ReviewSummaryCard.svelte';
	import ReviewManagementTabs from '$lib/components/reviews/ReviewManagementTabs.svelte';
	import ReviewList from '$lib/components/reviews/ReviewList.svelte';
	import VerifiedReviewCard from '$lib/components/reviews/VerifiedReviewCard.svelte';
	import PendingReviewsList from '$lib/components/reviews/PendingReviewsList.svelte';

	const ALL_REVIEWS_LIMIT = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;

	type ReviewMetaLoadError = Error & {
		givenReviews?: NostrVerifiedReview[];
		pendingReviews?: PendingReview[];
	};

	let currentUserPubkey = $state<string | null>(null);
	let receivedReviews = $state<NostrVerifiedReview[]>([]);
	let givenReviews = $state<NostrVerifiedReview[]>([]);
	let pendingReviews = $state<PendingReview[]>([]);
	let stats = $state<ReviewStats | null>(null);
	let isLoading = $state(true);
	let error = $state<string | null>(null);
	let metaError = $state<string | null>(null);
	let activeTab = $state<'received' | 'given' | 'pending'>('received');
	let pendingCount = $state(0);
	let activeRequestId = 0;
	let lastLoadedPubkey = $state<string | null>(null);
	let hasManuallyChangedTab = $state(false);
	let summaryRole = $derived.by<'tasker' | 'taskee' | null>(() => {
		const roleSet = new Set(
			receivedReviews
				.map((review) => review.content?.revieweeRole)
				.filter((role): role is 'tasker' | 'taskee' => role === 'tasker' || role === 'taskee')
		);

		return roleSet.size === 1 ? [...roleSet][0] : null;
	});

	function extractPartialReviewMeta(error: unknown): {
		givenReviews?: NostrVerifiedReview[];
		pendingReviews?: PendingReview[];
	} {
		if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
			return {};
		}

		const maybeError = error as {
			givenReviews?: unknown;
			pendingReviews?: unknown;
		};

		return {
			givenReviews: Array.isArray(maybeError.givenReviews)
				? (maybeError.givenReviews as NostrVerifiedReview[])
				: undefined,
			pendingReviews: Array.isArray(maybeError.pendingReviews)
				? (maybeError.pendingReviews as PendingReview[])
				: undefined
		};
	}

	function createReviewMetaLoadError(
		reason: unknown,
		partialMeta: {
			givenReviews?: NostrVerifiedReview[];
			pendingReviews?: PendingReview[];
		}
	): ReviewMetaLoadError {
		const error =
			reason instanceof Error ? reason : new Error($t('reviews.management.partial_load_warning'));
		const reviewMetaError = error as ReviewMetaLoadError;
		if (partialMeta.givenReviews) {
			reviewMetaError.givenReviews = partialMeta.givenReviews;
		}
		if (partialMeta.pendingReviews) {
			reviewMetaError.pendingReviews = partialMeta.pendingReviews;
		}
		return reviewMetaError;
	}

	function applyPartialReviewMeta(error: unknown) {
		const { givenReviews: partialGivenReviews, pendingReviews: partialPendingReviews } =
			extractPartialReviewMeta(error);

		givenReviews = partialGivenReviews ?? [];
		pendingReviews = partialPendingReviews ?? [];
		pendingCount = pendingReviews.length;

		if (!hasManuallyChangedTab) {
			activeTab = pendingReviews.length > 0 ? 'pending' : 'received';
		}
	}

	async function loadReviewMeta(pubkey: string, nextPendingReviews?: PendingReview[]) {
		const [givenResult, pendingResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
			getReviewsByReviewer(pubkey, ALL_REVIEWS_LIMIT),
			nextPendingReviews ? Promise.resolve(nextPendingReviews) : findPendingReviews()
		]);

		const givenReviews =
			givenResult.status === 'fulfilled'
				? givenResult.value
				: extractPartialReviewMeta(givenResult.reason).givenReviews;
		const pendingReviews =
			pendingResult.status === 'fulfilled'
				? pendingResult.value
				: extractPartialReviewMeta(pendingResult.reason).pendingReviews;

		if (givenResult.status === 'rejected') {
			throw createReviewMetaLoadError(givenResult.reason, { givenReviews, pendingReviews });
		}

		if (pendingResult.status === 'rejected') {
			throw createReviewMetaLoadError(pendingResult.reason, { givenReviews, pendingReviews });
		}

		return { given: givenResult.value, pending: pendingResult.value };
	}

	function applyReviewMeta(reviewMeta: { given: NostrVerifiedReview[]; pending: PendingReview[] }) {
		givenReviews = reviewMeta.given;
		pendingReviews = reviewMeta.pending;
		pendingCount = reviewMeta.pending.length;
		if (!hasManuallyChangedTab) {
			activeTab = reviewMeta.pending.length > 0 ? 'pending' : 'received';
		}
	}

	async function loadReviewData(pubkey: string) {
		const requestId = ++activeRequestId;
		isLoading = true;
		error = null;
		metaError = null;

		try {
			const [receivedResult, metaResult] = await Promise.allSettled([
				getReviewsForUser(pubkey, ALL_REVIEWS_LIMIT),
				loadReviewMeta(pubkey)
			]);

			if (requestId !== activeRequestId) {
				return;
			}

			if (receivedResult.status === 'rejected') {
				throw receivedResult.reason;
			}

			receivedReviews = receivedResult.value;
			stats = calculateReviewStats(receivedResult.value);

			if (metaResult.status === 'fulfilled') {
				applyReviewMeta(metaResult.value);
			} else {
				console.error('Failed to load review management metadata:', metaResult.reason);
				applyPartialReviewMeta(metaResult.reason);
				metaError =
					metaResult.reason instanceof Error
						? metaResult.reason.message
						: $t('reviews.management.partial_load_warning');
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to load reviews:', err);
			if (requestId === activeRequestId) {
				error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('reviews.list.load_error');
			}
		} finally {
			if (requestId === activeRequestId) {
				isLoading = false;
			}
		}
	}

	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			const pubkey = await getNpub();

			currentUserPubkey = pubkey;

			if (!pubkey) {
				lastLoadedPubkey = null;
				isLoading = false;
				return;
			}

			if (lastLoadedPubkey === pubkey) {
				isLoading = false;
				return;
			}

			lastLoadedPubkey = pubkey;
			await loadReviewData(pubkey);
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to resolve user pubkey:', err);
			error = $t('reviews.profile.load_user_error');
			currentUserPubkey = null;
			isLoading = false;
		}
	});

	function handleTabChange(tab: 'received' | 'given' | 'pending') {
		hasManuallyChangedTab = true;
		activeTab = tab;
	}

	async function retryLoadReviewData() {
		if (!currentUserPubkey) {
			return;
		}

		hasManuallyChangedTab = false;
		lastLoadedPubkey = currentUserPubkey;
		await loadReviewData(currentUserPubkey);
	}

	async function retryLoadReviewMeta(nextPendingReviews?: PendingReview[]) {
		if (!currentUserPubkey) {
			return;
		}

		if (nextPendingReviews) {
			pendingReviews = nextPendingReviews;
			pendingCount = nextPendingReviews.length;
		}

		try {
			metaError = null;
			const reviewMeta = await loadReviewMeta(currentUserPubkey, nextPendingReviews);
			applyReviewMeta(reviewMeta);
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to refresh review metadata:', err);
			applyPartialReviewMeta(err);
			metaError =
				err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('reviews.management.partial_load_warning');
		}
	}

	async function handlePendingReviewSubmitted(nextPendingReviews?: PendingReview[]) {
		if (!currentUserPubkey) {
			return;
		}

		await retryLoadReviewMeta(nextPendingReviews);
	}
</script>

<div class="mx-auto h-full max-w-6xl px-2 py-6 pb-8 md:px-0 md:py-0">
	<div class="mb-8">
		<h3 class="mb-2 text-2xl font-bold">{$t('reviews.management.title')}</h3>
		<p class="text-base-content/70 text-lg">{$t('reviews.management.description')}</p>
	</div>

	<div>
		{#if isLoading}
			<div class="flex items-center justify-center py-12" role="status" aria-live="polite">
				<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-lg"></span>
				<span class="sr-only">{$t('reviews.management.loading')}</span>
			</div>
		{:else if error}
			<div class="space-y-3">
				<div class="alert alert-outline alert-error">
					<svg
						xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
						class="h-6 w-6 shrink-0 stroke-current"
						fill="none"
						viewBox="0 0 24 24"
					>
						<path
							stroke-linecap="round"
							stroke-linejoin="round"
							stroke-width="2"
							d="M10 14l2-2m0 0l2-2m-2 2l-2-2m2 2l2 2m7-2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"
