<script lang="ts">
	import { getContext, onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { cubicOut } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { nip19 } from 'nostr-tools';
	import { pushNotificationService } from '$lib/api/services/push-notification.service';
	import {
		createUserDeviceShortName,
		getDeviceIdentifier
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/deviceIdentity';
	import Modal from '$lib/components/Modal.svelte';

	const settings = getContext<{ npub: string; keysReady: boolean; error: string }>('settings');

	interface UserDevice {
		id: string;
		deviceId: string;
		deviceName?: string | null;
		platform?: string | null;
		isActive: boolean;
		lastUsedAt?: string | null;
		createdAt?: string;
		appVersion?: string | null;
		fcmToken?: string | null;
		lastTokenRefresh?: string | null;
		credentialId?: string | null;
		pushToken?: string | null;
		revokedAt?: string | null;
		updatedAt?: string;
		userId?: string;
		currentDevice?: boolean;
	}

	const DEVICE_ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
		ANDROID:
			'<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 18h.01M8 21h8a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H8a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2z"/>',
		IOS: '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 18h.01M8 21h8a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H8a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2z"/>',
		WEB: '<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9.75 17L9 20l-1 1h8l-1-1-.75-3M3 13h18M5 17h14a2 2 0 002-2V5a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z"/>'
	};
	const DEFAULT_ICON =
		'<path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 3v2m6-2v2M9 19v2m6-2v2M5 9H3m2 6H3m18-6h-2m2 6h-2M7 19h10a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H7a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2zM9 9h6v6H9V9z"/>';

	const PLATFORM_I18N: Record<string, string> = {
		ANDROID: 'common.components.devices.platforms.android',
		IOS: 'common.components.devices.platforms.ios',
		WEB: 'common.components.devices.platforms.web'
	};

	let devices = $state<UserDevice[]>([]);
	let loading = $state(true);
	let error = $state('');

	let showRevokeModal = $state(false);
	let deviceToRevoke = $state<UserDevice | null>(null);
	let revokeLoading = $state(false);
	let revokeError = $state('');

	let showRevokeAllModal = $state(false);
	let revokeAllLoading = $state(false);
	let revokeAllError = $state('');

	let inactiveExpanded = $state(false);

	let currentDevice = $derived(devices.find((d) => d.currentDevice) ?? null);
	let activeDevices = $derived(
		devices
			.filter((d) => !d.currentDevice && d.isActive)
			.sort((a, b) => {
				const aTime = a.lastUsedAt ? new Date(a.lastUsedAt).getTime() : 0;
				const bTime = b.lastUsedAt ? new Date(b.lastUsedAt).getTime() : 0;
				return bTime - aTime;
			})
	);
	let inactiveDevices = $derived(
		devices
			.filter((d) => !d.currentDevice && !d.isActive)
			.sort((a, b) => {
				const aTime = a.lastUsedAt ? new Date(a.lastUsedAt).getTime() : 0;
				const bTime = b.lastUsedAt ? new Date(b.lastUsedAt).getTime() : 0;
				return bTime - aTime;
			})
	);
	let otherDevices = $derived([...activeDevices, ...inactiveDevices]);

	onMount(() => {
		loadDevices();
	});

	async function loadDevices() {
		try {
			loading = true;
			error = '';
			const currentDeviceId = await getDeviceIdentifier();

			const deviceNameNpub = await createUserDeviceShortName(settings.npub);
			let deviceNameHex = '';

			if (settings.npub.startsWith('npub')) {
				const { data } = nip19.decode(settings.npub);
				deviceNameHex = await createUserDeviceShortName(data as string);
			}

			const items = await pushNotificationService.getMyDevices();

			devices = items.map((item) => {
				const isCurrentDevice =
					item.deviceId === currentDeviceId &&
					(item.deviceName === deviceNameNpub ||
						(deviceNameHex && item.deviceName === deviceNameHex));

				return { ...item, currentDevice: Boolean(isCurrentDevice) };
			});
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to load devices:', err);
			error = $t('settings.devices.error.loadFailed');
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}
	}

	function formatLastUsed(lastUsedAt?: string | null): string {
		if (!lastUsedAt) return $t('settings.devices.lastUsed.never');

		const date = new Date(lastUsedAt);
		const now = new Date();
		const diffMs = now.getTime() - date.getTime();
		const diffMins = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60));
		const diffHours = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60));
		const diffDays = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

		if (diffMins < 1) return $t('settings.devices.lastUsed.justNow');
		if (diffMins < 60)
			return `${diffMins} ${diffMins === 1 ? $t('common.devices.time_units.minute') : $t('common.devices.time_units.minutes')} ago`;
		if (diffHours < 24)
			return `${diffHours} ${diffHours === 1 ? $t('common.devices.time_units.hour') : $t('common.devices.time_units.hours')} ago`;
		if (diffDays < 7)
			return `${diffDays} ${diffDays === 1 ? $t('common.devices.time_units.day') : $t('common.devices.time_units.days')} ago`;

		return date.toLocaleDateString();
	}

	function getDeviceDisplayName(device: UserDevice): string {
		if (device.currentDevice) {
			return $t('settings.devices.thisDevice');
		}

		let deviceName =
			device.deviceName ||
			$t(
				PLATFORM_I18N[(device.platform || '').toUpperCase()] ||
					'common.components.devices.platforms.unknown'
			);

		if (deviceName.includes('-') && deviceName.length > 8) {
			const lastDashIndex = deviceName.lastIndexOf('-');
			const suffix = deviceName.substring(lastDashIndex + 1);
			if (suffix.length === 8) {
				deviceName = deviceName.substring(0, lastDashIndex);
			}
		}

		return deviceName;
	}

	function openRevokeModal(device: UserDevice) {
		deviceToRevoke = device;
		showRevokeModal = true;
		revokeError = '';
	}

	function closeRevokeModal() {
		showRevokeModal = false;
		deviceToRevoke = null;
		revokeError = '';
	}

	async function confirmRevokeDevice() {
		if (!deviceToRevoke) return;

		try {
			revokeLoading = true;
			revokeError = '';

			const deviceName = getDeviceDisplayName(deviceToRevoke);
			const revocationMessage = `Your device "${deviceName}" has been revoked from your BitTasker account for security reasons. Please log in again if this was not intended.`;

			await pushNotificationService.revokeDevice(deviceToRevoke.deviceId, revocationMessage);

			await loadDevices();

			closeRevokeModal();
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to revoke device:', err);
			revokeError = $t('settings.devices.error.revokeFailed');
		} finally {
			revokeLoading = false;
		}
	}

	function openRevokeAllModal() {
		showRevokeAllModal = true;
		revokeAllError = '';
	}

	function closeRevokeAllModal() {
		showRevokeAllModal = false;
		revokeAllError = '';
	}

	async function confirmRevokeAll() {
		try {
			revokeAllLoading = true;
			revokeAllError = '';

			const message = `All other device access has been revoked from your BitTasker account for security reasons. Please log in again if this was not intended.`;

			for (const d of otherDevices) {
				await pushNotificationService.revokeDevice(d.deviceId, message);
			}

			await loadDevices();
			closeRevokeAllModal();
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to revoke all devices:', err);
			revokeAllError = $t('settings.devices.error.revokeAllFailed');
		} finally {
			revokeAllLoading = false;
		}
	}
</script>

											xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"

<script lang="ts">
	import { getContext, onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { cubicOut } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { SvelteSet } from 'svelte/reactivity';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { muteStore } from '$lib/stores/mute.store';
	import { unmutePubkey } from '$lib/nostr/muteList';
	import { fetchProfileMetadata } from '$lib/nostr/profile';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';

	const settings = getContext<{
		keysReady: boolean;
		error: string;
	}>('settings');

	const mutedPubkeys = $derived(Array.from($muteStore.mutedPubkeys));
	let profileCache = $state<Record<string, { name?: string; picture?: string } | null>>({});
	let unmutingSet = new SvelteSet<string>();

	onMount(() => {
		for (const pubkey of $muteStore.mutedPubkeys) {
			profileCache = { ...profileCache, [pubkey]: null };
			fetchProfileMetadata(pubkey)
				.then((profile) => {
					profileCache = {
						...profileCache,
						[pubkey]: { name: profile?.name, picture: profile?.picture }
					};
				})
				.catch(() => {});
		}
	});

	async function handleUnmute(pubkey: string) {
		unmutingSet.add(pubkey);
		try {
			await unmutePubkey(pubkey);
			appStore.showSuccessToast($t('settings.muted_users.unmuted_toast'));
		} catch {
			appStore.showErrorToast($t('settings.muted_users.unmute_error'));
		} finally {
			unmutingSet.delete(pubkey);
		}
	}

	function shortPubkey(pubkey: string): string {
		return pubkey.slice(0, 8) + '...' + pubkey.slice(-6);
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { getContext } from 'svelte';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { cubicOut } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { copyToClipboard } from '$lib/utils/helpers/clipboard';
	import generateQrCodeUrl from '$lib/utils/helpers/generateQrCodeUrl';

	const settings = getContext<{
		npub: string;
		nsec: string;
		keysReady: boolean;
		error: string;
	}>('settings');

	let showNsec = $state(false);
	let copySuccess = $state('');
	let qrCodeDataUrl = $state('');
	let isGeneratingQr = $state(false);
	let showQrModal = $state(false);

	async function generateQrCode() {
		if (qrCodeDataUrl && !showQrModal) {
			showQrModal = true;
			return;
		}
		if (settings.nsec) {
			isGeneratingQr = true;
			try {
				qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQrCodeUrl(settings.nsec);
				showQrModal = true;
			} catch (err) {
				console.error('Failed to generate QR code:', err);
			} finally {
				isGeneratingQr = false;
			}
		}
	}

	function closeQrModal() {
		showQrModal = false;
	}

	async function copyKey(text: string, type: 'npub' | 'nsec') {
		try {
			copyToClipboard(text);
			copySuccess = type;
			setTimeout(() => {
				copySuccess = '';
			}, 2000);
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to copy:', err);
		}
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { getContext, onMount, tick } from 'svelte';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { cubicOut } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { animate, stagger } from 'motion';
	import { notificationCenterService } from '$lib/api/services/notificationCenter.service';
	import type { NotificationPreferencesExtended } from '$lib/types/notification';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import IconBell from '~icons/mdi/bell-badge';
	import IconMoon from '~icons/mdi/moon-waning-crescent';
	import IconGrid from '~icons/mdi/view-grid-outline';
	import IconClipboard from '~icons/mdi/clipboard-check';
	import IconBriefcase from '~icons/mdi/briefcase-outline';
	import IconChevronLeft from '~icons/mdi/chevron-left';
	import IconContract from '~icons/mdi/handshake';
	import IconBid from '~icons/mdi/gavel';
	import IconMessage from '~icons/mdi/chat-outline';
	import IconReview from '~icons/mdi/star-outline';
	import IconWallet from '~icons/mdi/wallet-outline';
	import IconSecurity from '~icons/mdi/shield-alert';
	import IconDiscovery from '~icons/mdi/magnify';
	import IconReengagement from '~icons/mdi/bell-ring-outline';

	const settings = getContext<{ keysReady: boolean; error: string }>('settings');

	const NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES: Array<
		[keyof NotificationPreferencesExtended, string, typeof IconBell]
	> = [
		['contractUpdates', 'contract', IconContract],
		['bidUpdates', 'bid', IconBid],
		['messageNotifications', 'message', IconMessage],
		['reviewNotifications', 'review', IconReview],
		['walletNotifications', 'wallet', IconWallet],
		['securityAlerts', 'security', IconSecurity],
		['discoveryNotifications', 'discovery', IconDiscovery],
		['reengagementNotifications', 'reengagement', IconReengagement]
	];

	const FIELD_TOAST_I18N: Record<string, string> = {
		pushEnabled: 'notifications.settings.push',
		emailEnabled: 'notifications.settings.email',
		quietHoursEnabled: 'notifications.settings.quiet_hours',
		quietHoursStart: 'notifications.settings.quiet_hours_start_label',
		quietHoursEnd: 'notifications.settings.quiet_hours_end_label',
		contractUpdates: 'notifications.types.contract',
		bidUpdates: 'notifications.types.bid',
		taskMatches: 'notifications.types.task',
		messageNotifications: 'notifications.types.message',
		reviewNotifications: 'notifications.types.review',
		serviceNotifications: 'notifications.types.service',
		walletNotifications: 'notifications.types.wallet',
		securityAlerts: 'notifications.types.security',
		discoveryNotifications: 'notifications.types.discovery',
		reengagementNotifications: 'notifications.types.reengagement',
		'taskNotificationSettings.enabled': 'notifications.settings.task.saved_search_matches',
		'taskNotificationSettings.frequency': 'notifications.settings.task.match_frequency',
		'taskNotificationSettings.broadcast': 'notifications.settings.task.new_task_alerts',
		'taskNotificationSettings.broadcastFrequency': 'notifications.settings.task.alert_frequency',
		'serviceNotificationSettings.enabled': 'notifications.settings.service.saved_search_matches',
		'serviceNotificationSettings.frequency': 'notifications.settings.service.match_frequency',
		'serviceNotificationSettings.broadcast': 'notifications.settings.service.new_service_alerts',
		'serviceNotificationSettings.broadcastFrequency':
			'notifications.settings.service.alert_frequency'
	};

	let prefs = $state<NotificationPreferencesExtended | null>(null);
	let loading = $state(true);
	let error = $state<string | null>(null);
	let savingField = $state<string | null>(null);
	let reduced = $state(false);
	let gridEl = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);

	const activeCategoryCount = $derived.by(() => {
		if (!prefs) return 0;
		return NOTIFICATION_CATEGORIES.filter(([field]) => prefs![field]).length;
	});

	onMount(async () => {
		reduced = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
		try {
			prefs = await notificationCenterService.getPreferences();
		} catch (err) {
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load preferences';
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}

		if (!reduced) {
			await tick();
			if (!gridEl) return;
			const cards = gridEl.querySelectorAll('.notif-settings-card');
			if (cards.length === 0) return;
			animate(cards, { scale: [0.96, 1], opacity: [0, 1] }, {
				duration: 0.3,
				delay: stagger(0.06, { startDelay: 0.08 }),
				easing: [0, 0, 0, 1]
			} as Parameters<typeof animate>[2]).finished.then(() => {
				if (gridEl) gridEl.classList.add('entrance-done');
			});
		}
	});

	function handleMouseMove(e: MouseEvent, card: HTMLElement) {
		const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
		const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
		const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-x', `${x}px`);
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-y', `${y}px`);
	}

	function handleMouseLeave(card: HTMLElement) {
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-x', '50%');
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-y', '50%');
	}

	let saveTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

	function debouncedSave(field: string, newValue: boolean | string) {
		if (saveTimeout) clearTimeout(saveTimeout);
		savingField = field;
		saveTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
			if (!prefs) return;
			try {
				await notificationCenterService.updatePreferences(prefs);
				const labelKey = FIELD_TOAST_I18N[field];
				const setting = labelKey ? $t(labelKey) : field;
				if (typeof newValue === 'boolean') {
					const message = newValue
						? $t('notifications.success.toggle_enabled', { values: { setting } })
						: $t('notifications.success.toggle_disabled', { values: { setting } });
					appStore.showSuccessToast(message);
				} else {
					appStore.showSuccessToast(
						$t('notifications.success.value_updated', { values: { setting } })
					);
				}
			} catch {
				appStore.showErrorToast($t('notifications.errors.settings_error'));
			} finally {
				savingField = null;
			}
		}, 500);
	}

	function toggleField(field: keyof NotificationPreferencesExtended) {
		if (!prefs || typeof prefs[field] !== 'boolean') return;
		prefs = { ...prefs, [field]: !prefs[field] };
		debouncedSave(field, prefs[field] as boolean);
	}

	function updateField(field: keyof NotificationPreferencesExtended, value: string) {
		if (!prefs) return;
		prefs = { ...prefs, [field]: value };
		debouncedSave(field, value);
	}

	function toggleNestedBoolean(
		group: 'taskNotificationSettings' | 'serviceNotificationSettings',
		key: 'enabled' | 'broadcast'
	) {
		if (!prefs) return;
		const current = prefs[group];
		prefs = { ...prefs, [group]: { ...current, [key]: !current[key] } };
		debouncedSave(`${group}.${key}`, prefs[group][key]);
	}

	function updateNestedString(
		group: 'taskNotificationSettings' | 'serviceNotificationSettings',
		key: 'frequency' | 'broadcastFrequency',
		value: string
	) {
		if (!prefs) return;
		const current = prefs[group];
		prefs = { ...prefs, [group]: { ...current, [key]: value } };
		debouncedSave(`${group}.${key}`, value);
	}

	const FREQUENCY_OPTIONS = ['INSTANT', 'DAILY', 'WEEKLY'];

	function timeToPercent(time: string): number {
		const [h, m] = time.split(':').map(Number);
		return ((h * 60 + m) / 1440) * 100;
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { getContext } from 'svelte';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { cubicOut } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { encryptMasterKeyData } from '$lib/utils/helpers/auth';
	import { copyToClipboard } from '$lib/utils/helpers/clipboard';
	import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '$lib/utils/helpers/validators';
	import { debounce } from '$lib/utils/helpers/common';
	import { generatePassword } from '$lib/utils/helpers/password';
	import { locale } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { StorageKeys } from '$lib/utils/constants/storage';
	import { Preferences } from '@capacitor/preferences';
	import authService from '$lib/api/services/auth.service';

	const settings = getContext<{
		nsec: string;
		npub: string;
		mnemonic: string;
		keysReady: boolean;
		error: string;
	}>('settings');

	let recoveryLoading = $state(false);
	let recoveryError = $state('');
	let recoverySuccess = $state('');
	let recoveryEmail = $state('');
	let recoveryPassword = $state('');
	let confirmRecoveryPassword = $state('');
	let showRecoveryPassword = $state(false);
	let showConfirmRecoveryPassword = $state(false);
	let emailError = $state('');
	let passwordError = $state('');
	let passwordMismatchError = $state('');
	let copySuccess = $state('');

	let passwordStrength = $state<'weak' | 'medium' | 'strong'>('weak');

	function getPasswordStrength(password: string): 'weak' | 'medium' | 'strong' {
		const length = password.length;
		if (length >= 12 && length <= 15) {
			return 'weak';
		} else if (length > 15 && length <= 20) {
			return 'medium';
		} else if (length > 20) {
			return 'strong';
		}
		return 'weak';
	}

	const updatePasswordStrength = debounce((event: unknown) => {
		const target = (event as Event).target as HTMLInputElement;
		if (target) {
			passwordStrength = getPasswordStrength(target.value);
		}
	}, 400);

	const validatePasswordMatch = debounce(() => {
		if (
			confirmRecoveryPassword &&
			recoveryPassword &&
			confirmRecoveryPassword !== recoveryPassword
		) {
			passwordMismatchError = $t('settings.validation.passwordMismatch');
		} else {
			passwordMismatchError = '';
		}
	}, 400);

	function handleGeneratePassword() {
		const newPassword = generatePassword($locale || 'en');
		recoveryPassword = newPassword;
		confirmRecoveryPassword = newPassword;
		passwordError = '';
		passwordMismatchError = '';
		passwordStrength = getPasswordStrength(newPassword);
	}

	async function _copyToClipboard(text: string, type: 'npub' | 'nsec' | 'recovery' | 'confirm') {
		try {
			copyToClipboard(text);
			copySuccess = type;
			setTimeout(() => {
				copySuccess = '';
			}, 2000);
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Failed to copy:', err);
		}
	}

	function validateRecoveryForm(): boolean {
		emailError = '';
		passwordError = '';
		passwordMismatchError = '';

		if (!recoveryEmail) {
			emailError = $t('settings.validation.emailRequired');
			return false;
		}

		const emailValidation = validateEmail(recoveryEmail);
		if (!emailValidation.isValid) {
			emailError = emailValidation.error!;
			return false;
		}

		if (!recoveryPassword) {
			passwordError = $t('settings.validation.passwordRequired');
			return false;
		}

		if (recoveryPassword !== confirmRecoveryPassword) {
			passwordMismatchError = $t('settings.validation.passwordMismatch');
			return false;
		}

		const passwordValidation = validatePassword(recoveryPassword);
		if (!passwordValidation.isValid) {
			passwordError = passwordValidation.error!;
			return false;
		}

		return true;
	}

	async function setupAccountRecovery(event: Event) {
		event.preventDefault();

		if (!validateRecoveryForm()) return;

		try {
			recoveryLoading = true;
			recoveryError = '';
			recoverySuccess = '';

			if (!settings.nsec.startsWith('nsec') || !settings.npub) {
				throw new Error($t('settings.error.invalidNostrKeys'));
			}

			if (!settings.mnemonic) {
				throw new Error($t('settings.error.noMnemonic'));
			}

			const { encryptedData: recoveryData } = await encryptMasterKeyData(
				settings.nsec,
				settings.mnemonic,
				recoveryPassword
			);

			const { value: credentialId } = await Preferences.get({
				key: StorageKeys.WEB_AUTHN_CREDENTIAL_ID
			});

			if (!credentialId) {
				throw new Error('No credential ID found');
			}

			const data = {
				credentialId: credentialId,
				recoveryData,
				email: recoveryEmail
			};

			await authService.setupRecovery(data);

			recoverySuccess = $t('settings.recovery.success');

			recoveryEmail = '';
			recoveryPassword = '';
			confirmRecoveryPassword = '';
			passwordMismatchError = '';
			passwordStrength = 'weak';
		} catch (err: unknown) {
			console.error('Failed to setup account recovery:', err);
			recoveryError = err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('settings.error.recoverySetup');
		} finally {
			recoveryLoading = false;
		}
	}
</script>

								<span class="label-text font-semibold"

									disabled={recoveryLoading}
									title={showRecoveryPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
								>
									{#if showRecoveryPassword}
										<svg
											xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
											class="h-5 w-5"
											fill="none"
											viewBox="0 0 24 24"
											stroke="currentColor"
										>
											<path
												stroke-linecap="round"
												stroke-linejoin="round"
												stroke-width="2"
												d="M13.875 18.825A10.05 10.05 0 0112 19c-4.478 0-8.268-2.943-9.543-7a9.97 9.97 0 011.563-3.029m5.858.908a3 3 0 114.243 4.243M9.878 9.878l4.242 4.242M9.88 9.88l-3.29-3.29m7.532 7.532l3.29 3.29M3 3l3.59 3.59m0 0A9.953 9.953 0 0112 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.543 7a10.025 10.025 0 01-4.132 5.411m0 0L21 21"
											/>
										</svg>
									{:else}
										<svg
											xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
											class="h-5 w-5"
											fill="none"
											viewBox="0 0 24 24"
											stroke="currentColor"

											<path

												stroke-linejoin="round"

<script lang="ts">
	import { setContext, onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { nip19 } from 'nostr-tools';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { getAllKeys } from '$lib/utils/nostrKeys';

	let { children } = $props();

	let npub = $state('');
	let nsec = $state('');
	let mnemonic = $state('');
	let keysReady = $state(false);
	let error = $state('');
	let loading = $state(true);

	setContext('settings', {
		get npub() {
			return npub;
		},
		get nsec() {
			return nsec;
		},
		get mnemonic() {
			return mnemonic;
		},
		get keysReady() {
			return keysReady;
		},
		get error() {
			return error;
		}
	});

	onMount(async () => {
		await loadKeys();
	});

	async function loadKeys() {
		try {
			loading = true;
			error = '';

			// getAllKeys() checks appStore cache first (Tier 1).
			// If the protected layout already loaded keys, this returns instantly.
			// If a passkey prompt is in flight from the protected layout, the mutex
			// in getBiometricData() makes us await the same promise — no duplicate prompt.
			const keys = await getAllKeys();

			let encodedNpub = keys.npub;
			if (!encodedNpub.startsWith('npub')) {
				try {
					encodedNpub = nip19.npubEncode(encodedNpub);
				} catch {
					// Already in correct format or invalid
				}
			}
			npub = encodedNpub;

			try {
				nsec = nip19.nsecEncode(keys.nsec);
			} catch (err) {
				console.error('Error encoding nsec:', err);
			}

			mnemonic = keys.mnemonic || '';
			keysReady = true;
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Error loading keys:', err);
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('settings.error.loadKeys');
		} finally {
			loading = false;
		}
	}
</script>

<div class="settings-content mx-auto h-full max-w-6xl px-2 py-6 md:px-0 md:py-0">
	<div class="mb-6">
		<h3>{$t('settings.title')}</h3>
		<p class="text-base-content/70">{$t('settings.subtitle')}</p>
	</div>

	{#if loading}
		<div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 py-12">
			<div class="loading loading-spinner loading-lg"></div>
		</div>
	{:else if error}
		<div
			class="alert alert-error alert-outline mb-6 flex w-fit min-w-full flex-col items-start px-5 sm:min-w-1/2"
		>
			<p>{$t(error)}</p>
			<button class="btn btn-sm btn-outline place-self-end" onclick={loadKeys}>
				{$t('settings.retry')}
			</button>
		</div>
	{:else}
		{@render children()}
	{/if}
</div>

		});
	});

	function handleMouseMove(e: MouseEvent, card: HTMLElement) {
		const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
		const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
		const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-x', `${x}px`);
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-y', `${y}px`);
	}

	function handleMouseLeave(card: HTMLElement) {
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-x', '50%');
		card.style.setProperty('--spotlight-y', '50%');
	}

<script lang="ts">
	// Import polyfills FIRST before any other imports that might use Buffer/bitcoinjs-lib
	import '$lib/polyfills';

	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import { walletManager, rskConnection, walletStore } from '$lib/stores/wallet.store';
	import { connectedWalletsStore } from '$lib/stores/connected-wallets.store';
	import { btcPrice } from '$lib/runes/btcPrice.svelte';
	import BalanceCard from '$lib/components/wallet/BalanceCard.svelte';
	import RgbWalletDebugCard from '$lib/components/wallet/RgbWalletDebugCard.svelte';
	import TransactionHistory from '$lib/components/wallet/TransactionHistory.svelte';
	import WalletPaymentModal from '$lib/components/wallet/WalletPaymentModal.svelte';
	import UnknownTokensCard from '$lib/components/wallet/UnknownTokensCard.svelte';
	import ReceivePaymentForm from '$lib/components/wallet/ReceivePaymentForm.svelte';
	import SendPaymentForm from '$lib/components/wallet/SendPaymentForm.svelte';
	import IconContentCopy from '~icons/mdi/content-copy';
	import IconDownload from '~icons/mdi/download';
	import IconUpload from '~icons/mdi/upload';
	import IconSwapHorizontal from '~icons/mdi/swap-horizontal';
	import IconCash from '~icons/mdi/cash';
	import IconBankOutline from '~icons/mdi/bank-outline';
	import IconWallet from '~icons/mdi/wallet';
	import IconCellphoneLink from '~icons/mdi/usb-flash-drive';
	import IconCloseCircle from '~icons/mdi/close-circle';
	import IconAlertCircle from '~icons/mdi/alert-circle';
	import IconPlus from '~icons/mdi/plus';
	import IconInformationOutline from '~icons/mdi/information-outline';
	import IconClose from '~icons/mdi/close';
	import IconHandCoin from '~icons/mdi/hand-coin';
	import IconChartLine from '~icons/mdi/chart-line';
	import PaymentRequestModal from '$lib/components/wallet/PaymentRequestModal.svelte';
	import BankingMenu from '$lib/components/wallet/BankingMenu.svelte';
	import BuySellForm from '$lib/components/wallet/BuySellForm.svelte';
	import SwapForm from '$lib/components/wallet/SwapForm.svelte';
	import BorrowFlowDrawer from '$lib/components/wallet/BorrowFlowDrawer.svelte';
	import EarnFlowDrawer from '$lib/components/wallet/EarnFlowDrawer.svelte';
	import ConnectedWallets from '$lib/components/wallet/ConnectedWallets.svelte';
	import { defiPositions } from '$lib/stores/defi-positions.store.svelte';
	import HelpModal from '$lib/components/wallet/HelpModal.svelte';
	import BalanceHistory from '$lib/components/wallet/BalanceHistory.svelte';
	import { openHelpModal } from '$lib/runes/helpModal.svelte';
	import PendingClaimBanner from '$lib/components/wallet/PendingClaimBanner.svelte';
	import ConnectedTransactionHistory from '$lib/components/wallet/ConnectedTransactionHistory.svelte';
	import { isConnectedWalletsEnabled, isLoanFlowEnabled } from '$lib/services/kill-switch';
	import {
		removePendingSwap,
		type PendingConnectedSwap
	} from '$lib/services/connected-wallet-reverse-swap';

	let walletsEnabled = $state(isConnectedWalletsEnabled());
	let showConnectModal = $state(false);

	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let balancesHidden = $state(!import.meta.env.DEV);
	let claimableSwaps = $state<PendingConnectedSwap[]>([]);

	async function initializeWallet(): Promise<void> {
		try {
			isLoading = true;
			await walletManager.initialize();
			await walletManager.loadAssets();
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}

		walletManager.loadRbtcExchangeRate();
	}

	onMount(async () => {
		await initializeWallet();
		walletManager.markExpectingInbound();

		// Load DeFi positions (Aave V3) if feature enabled
		if (isLoanFlowEnabled()) {
			defiPositions.refreshAllAave().catch((err) => {
				console.error('[wallet] Failed to refresh DeFi positions:', err);
			});
		}

		// Open receive modal if tab=receive is in URL
		const tab = page.url.searchParams.get('tab');
		if (tab === 'receive') {
			showReceiveModal = true;
		}

		// Restore active bridge state from Capacitor Preferences (survives page refresh)
		restoreActiveBridge();

		// Auto-validate swap chain: check if any COMPLETE swap is actually
		// incomplete on Boltz (e.g., single-hop Boltz chain swaps that were
		// marked COMPLETE before the destination chain claim was processed).
		validateSwapChainState();
	});

	/**
	 * Restore active bridge state from Capacitor Preferences.
	 * If a cross-chain bridge was in progress when the page was refreshed,
	 * set the activeBridge on the wallet store so SwapForm can resume tracking
	 * and the persistent banner shows.
	 */
	async function restoreActiveBridge() {
		try {
			const { Preferences } = await import('@capacitor/preferences');
			const { value } = await Preferences.get({ key: 'active_bridge' });
			if (value) {
				const bridge = JSON.parse(value);
				const elapsed = Date.now() - bridge.startedAt;
				// Only restore if bridge started within the last 30 minutes
				if (elapsed < 30 * 60 * 1000) {
					walletStore.update((s) => ({ ...s, activeBridge: bridge }));
					console.log('[wallet] Restored active bridge state:', bridge.sourceAsset, '→', bridge.destAsset);
				} else {
					// Stale — clean up
					await Preferences.remove({ key: 'active_bridge' });
				}
			}
		} catch {
			// Non-blocking
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Check the persisted swap chain state against Boltz's actual status.
	 * If a COMPLETE swap is still at transaction.server.confirmed on Boltz,
	 * revert it to PARTIAL so the user can retry the claim.
	 * Also resets COMPLETE swaps that are actually claimed (cleanup).
	 */
	async function validateSwapChainState() {
		try {
			const { getSwapChainState } = await import('$lib/services/swap-chain.service');
			const state = await getSwapChainState();
			if (!state || state.phase === 'IDLE' || !state.swap1Id) return;

			const { BoltzProvider } = await import('$lib/services/BoltzProvider');
			const boltz = new BoltzProvider();
			const boltzStatus = await boltz.getSwapStatus(state.swap1Id);

			if (
				state.phase === 'COMPLETE' &&
				(boltzStatus.status === 'transaction.server.confirmed' ||
					boltzStatus.status === 'transaction.claim.pending')
			) {
				// Swap marked COMPLETE but Boltz hasn't released funds —
				// revert to PARTIAL so it shows in pending swaps
				console.warn(
					'[wallet] Swap %s marked COMPLETE but Boltz status=%s — reverting to PARTIAL',
					state.swap1Id,
					boltzStatus.status
				);
				const { transitionTo } = await import('$lib/services/swap-chain/state');
				await transitionTo(state, 'PARTIAL', {
					error: `Swap not yet complete on Boltz: ${boltzStatus.status}`
				});
			} else if (
				state.phase === 'COMPLETE' &&
				(boltzStatus.status === 'transaction.claimed' ||
					boltzStatus.status === 'transaction.refunded')
			) {
				// Swap truly completed — clean up
				console.log(
					'[wallet] Swap %s confirmed as %s — cleaning up',
					state.swap1Id,
					boltzStatus.status
				);
				const { resetSwapChainState } = await import('$lib/services/swap-chain.service');
				await resetSwapChainState();
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.warn('[wallet] Swap chain validation failed:', err);
		}
	}

	let hasErrors = $derived($walletStore.error || $rskConnection.error);

	// Modal state for new UX
	let showReceiveModal = $state(false);
	let showSendModal = $state(false);
	let showBuySell = $state(false);
	let showSwap = $state(false);
	let showTransactionsModal = $state(false);
	let showConnectedTransactionsModal = $state(false);

	// Centralized Payment Request Modal state
	let paymentRequestModal = $state<{
		isOpen: boolean;
		// Pattern 1: Swap-based
		swapId?: string | null;
		// Pattern 2: Direct payment
		address?: string | null;
		network?: string | null;
		amount?: number | null;
		memo?: string | null;
		chargeFeesToPayer?: boolean;
		totalFees?: number | null;
		// Form state for restoration
		formState?: {
			amount: string;
			unit: 'sats' | 'usd';
			mathExpression: string;
			memo: string;
			selectedNetwork: string;
			chargeFeesToPayer: boolean;
		} | null;
	}>({
		isOpen: false,
		swapId: null,
		address: null,
		network: null,
		amount: null,
		memo: null,
		chargeFeesToPayer: false,
		totalFees: null,
		formState: null
	});

	// Function to open the payment request modal (supports both patterns)
	function openPaymentRequestModal(data: {
		swapId?: string;
		address?: string;
		network?: string;
		amount?: number;
		memo?: string;
		chargeFeesToPayer?: boolean;
		totalFees?: number;
		formState?: {
			amount: string;
			unit: 'sats' | 'usd';
			mathExpression: string;
			memo: string;
			selectedNetwork: string;
			chargeFeesToPayer: boolean;
		};
	}) {
		paymentRequestModal = {
			isOpen: true,
			...data
		};
	}

	// Function to close the payment request modal
	function closePaymentRequestModal() {
		paymentRequestModal = {
			isOpen: false,
			swapId: null,
			address: null,
			network: null,
			amount: null,
			memo: null,
			chargeFeesToPayer: false,
			totalFees: null,
			formState: null
		};
	}

	// Store receive form state for restoration
	let receiveFormState = $state<{
		amount: string;
		unit: 'sats' | 'usd';
		mathExpression: string;
		memo: string;
		selectedNetwork: string;
		chargeFeesToPayer: boolean;
	} | null>(null);

	// Tab state: 'wallet' | 'connected'
	let activeTab = $state<'wallet' | 'connected'>('wallet');

	// Connected wallet totals — single-pass aggregation
	let connectedTotals = $derived.by(() => {
		const wallets = $connectedWalletsStore.wallets;
		if (wallets.length === 0) return { usd: 0, sats: 0, usdt: 0, aggSats: 0, aggUsd: 0 };
		let usd = 0;
		let sats = 0;
		let usdt = 0;
		let aggSats = 0;
		for (const w of wallets) {
			const cur = w.balances;
			if (!cur) continue;
			const rbtc = Number(cur.rbtc?.raw ?? 0);
			const wbtc = Number(cur.wbtc?.raw ?? 0);
			const btc = Number(cur.btc?.raw ?? 0);
			const usdt0Arb = Number(cur['usdt0-arb']?.raw ?? 0);
			sats += rbtc + wbtc;
			aggSats += rbtc + btc;
			usd += ((rbtc + wbtc) / 1e8) * btcPrice.price + usdt0Arb / 1e6;
			usdt += usdt0Arb / 1e6;
		}
		return { usd, sats, usdt, aggSats, aggUsd: (aggSats / 1e8) * btcPrice.price };
	});

	// BankingMenu event listeners
	let bankingMenuOpen = $state(false);
	let showBorrow = $state(false);
	let showEarn = $state(false);

	function closeBankingMenu() {
		bankingMenuOpen = false;
		(document.getElementById('banking-menu-modal') as HTMLDialogElement)?.close();
	}

	$effect(() => {
		if (!bankingMenuOpen) return;
		const el = document.getElementById('banking-menu-modal');
		if (!el) return;

		function handleSend() {
			closeBankingMenu();
			showSendModal = true;
		}
		function handleReceive() {
			closeBankingMenu();
			showReceiveModal = true;
		}
		function handleBuy() {
			closeBankingMenu();
			// Delay by one frame so the browser finishes removing the
			// <dialog> from the top layer before the Drawer mounts.
			requestAnimationFrame(() => (showBuySell = true));
		}
		function handleSell() {
			closeBankingMenu();
			requestAnimationFrame(() => (showBuySell = true));
		}
		function handleSwap() {
			closeBankingMenu();
			showSwap = true;
		}

		el.addEventListener('banking:send', handleSend);
		el.addEventListener('banking:receive', handleReceive);
		el.addEventListener('banking:buy', handleBuy);
		el.addEventListener('banking:sell', handleSell);
		el.addEventListener('banking:swap', handleSwap);

		return () => {
			el.removeEventListener('banking:send', handleSend);
			el.removeEventListener('banking:receive', handleReceive);
			el.removeEventListener('banking:buy', handleBuy);
			el.removeEventListener('banking:sell', handleSell);
			el.removeEventListener('banking:swap', handleSwap);
		};
	});
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import { authState } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { user } from '$lib/stores/user.store';
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { createDebug } from '$lib/utils/debug';
	import { triggerPendingReviewBanner } from '$lib/utils/reviews';
	import ProtectedLayout from '$lib/components/ProtectedLayout.svelte';

	const { children } = $props();

	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			if (!$authState.isAuthenticated) return;

			await user.getUserData();

			// Eagerly load all keys — caches in appStore for all child routes.
			// This MUST happen before wallet init so getMnemonic()/getNostrKeyPair()
			// hit Tier 1 cache and never race with each other.
			const { getAllKeys } = await import('$lib/utils/nostrKeys');
			await getAllKeys();

			// Initialize wallet — keys are now cached, so getMnemonic() and
			// getNostrKeyPair() inside walletManager.initialize() return instantly.
			const { walletStore, walletManager } = await import('$lib/stores/wallet.store');
			const { get } = await import('svelte/store');
			let walletState = get(walletStore);

			if (!walletState.isConnected || !walletState.rsk?.wallet || !walletState.rsk?.provider) {
				await walletManager.initialize();
				walletState = get(walletStore);
			}

			// Start activity tracking for re-engagement reminders
			const { initActivityTracking } = await import('$lib/utils/activityTracker');
			initActivityTracking();

			// Trigger pending review banner (skip on /reviews)
			if (page.url.pathname !== '/reviews') {
				triggerPendingReviewBanner('reviews.pending.review_now', 'reviews.pending.dismiss');
			}
		} catch (error) {
			const d = createDebug('layout');
			d.error('Error initializing wallet', error);
			// Continue anyway - contracts will handle wallet initialization individually
		}
	});
</script>

<svelte:head>
	<title>{$t('dashboard.hiring.page_title')}</title>
	<meta name="description" content={$t('dashboard.hiring.page_description')} />
</svelte:head>

{#if $authState.isLoading}
	<div class="flex h-dvh w-full flex-col items-center justify-center">
		<span class="loading loading-spinner loading-xl"></span>
		<p>{$t('common.loading')}</p>
	</div>
{:else if $authState.isAuthenticated}
	<ProtectedLayout>
		{@render children()}
	</ProtectedLayout>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import QRCode from 'qrcode';
	import type { PageData } from './$types';

	let { data }: { data: PageData } = $props();

	// QR code states
	let appQrCode = $state('');

	// Social media URLs
	const appUrl = 'https://bittasker.com';
	const primalUrl = 'https://primal.net/p/BitTasker';
	const xUrl = 'https://x.com/BitTaskerDotCom';

	// QR code SVG paths
	const primalQrCodePath = '/images/primal-net-qr-code-transparent-background.svg';
	const xQrCodePath = '/images/qr-code-twitter-transparent-background.svg';

	// Generate app QR code on mount
	onMount(async () => {
		if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
		try {
			// Generate app QR code with Bitcoin logo
			const appCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
			await QRCode.toCanvas(appCanvas, appUrl, {
				errorCorrectionLevel: 'H',
				margin: 1,
				width: 300,
				color: {
					dark: '#000000',
					light: '#FFFFFF'
				}
			});

			// Add Bitcoin logo to center of app QR code
			const ctx = appCanvas.getContext('2d');
			if (ctx) {
				const logo = new Image();
				logo.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
				logo.onload = () => {
					const logoSize = appCanvas.width * 0.2;
					const logoX = (appCanvas.width - logoSize) / 2;
					const logoY = (appCanvas.height - logoSize) / 2;

					// White background circle
					ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
					ctx.beginPath();
					ctx.arc(appCanvas.width / 2, appCanvas.height / 2, (logoSize + 8) / 2, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
					ctx.fill();

					ctx.drawImage(logo, logoX, logoY, logoSize, logoSize);
					appQrCode = appCanvas.toDataURL();
				};
				logo.onerror = () => {
					appQrCode = appCanvas.toDataURL();
				};
				logo.src = '/images/logos/bittasker-logomark.svg';
			} else {
				appQrCode = appCanvas.toDataURL();
			}
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Failed to generate QR code:', error);
		}
	});
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Barcode } from '@capacitor-mlkit/barcode-scanning';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { t, locale } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { get } from 'svelte/store';
	import { authState } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
	import {
		createUserDeviceShortName,
		getDeviceIdentifier
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/deviceIdentity';
	import {
		deriveKeyFromPassword,
		deriveWalletFromNostr,
		exportKey
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/crypto';
	import { base64ToBytes } from '$lib/utils/helpers/encoding';
	import {
		decryptMasterKeyDataFromBiometrics,
		encryptMasterKeyData
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/auth';
	import {
		checkBiometricAvailability,
		checkNativePlatform,
		getBiometricData,
		setBiometricKey
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/biometrics';
	import { finalizeEvent, getPublicKey } from 'nostr-tools/pure';
	import { handleBiometricError } from '$lib/utils/helpers/biometricErrorHandler';
	import { Capacitor } from '@capacitor/core';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { linear } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { Buffer } from 'buffer';
	import { bytesToHex } from '@noble/hashes/utils';
	import { decodeNsec } from '$lib/utils/nostr';
	import { applyNdkSignerFromNsec } from '$lib/nostr/ndkSigner';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import authService from '$lib/api/services/auth.service';
	import { createDebug } from '$lib/utils/debug';
	const dbg = createDebug('auth:nsec:login');
	import QrCodeScanner from '$lib/components/QrCodeScanner.svelte';
	import ErrorAlertWithModal from '$lib/components/ErrorAlertWithModal.svelte';
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import migratePasskey, {
		passkeyMigration,
		resetMigration
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/migratePasskey';
	import MigratePasskey from '$lib/components/MigratePasskey.svelte';
	import WebQrCodeScanner from '$lib/components/WebQrCodeScanner.svelte';
	import { consumeDeepLink, isValidInternalPath } from '$lib/utils/deep-link';

	// Polyfill Buffer
	if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
		globalThis.Buffer = Buffer;
	}

	let error = $state('');
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let isNostrLogin = $state(false);
	let showNsec = $state(false);
	let nsec = $state('');
	let isBiometricsAvailable = $state(false);
	let isNativePlatform = $state(false);
	let isPasskeyError = $state(false);
	let lastAction = $state<'authenticate' | 'nsecLogin' | null>(null);

	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			// Check available authentication methods
			isBiometricsAvailable = await checkBiometricAvailability();
			isNativePlatform = checkNativePlatform();
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Error checking authentication methods:', err);
		}
	});

	async function authenticate() {
		try {
			isLoading = true;
			error = '';
			isPasskeyError = false;
			lastAction = 'authenticate'; // Track which action was attempted

			let credentails = null;

			if (isBiometricsAvailable) {
				credentails = await getBiometricData();
			}

			if (!credentails) {
				error = $t('login.errors.no_account');
				return (isPasskeyError = true);
			}

			let credentialId = credentails.credentialId;

			let exportedKey = credentails.exportedKey;

			const deviceId = await getDeviceIdentifier();
			const deviceName = await createUserDeviceShortName(credentails.npub);

			let response = await authService.passkeyLogin({
				npub: credentails.npub,
				challenge: credentails.challenge,
				credentialId,
				deviceId,
				deviceName,
				platform: isNativePlatform ? 'mobile' : 'web',
				response: credentails.response,
				appVersion: __APP_VERSION__,
				timezoneOffset: new Date().getTimezoneOffset(),
				lang: get(locale) || 'en'
			});

			let nsec = '';
			let mnemonic = '';

			if (response.isLegacy) {
				// @ts-expect-error - Legacy format to be removed in the future
				// TODO: Remove this once all users have migrated
				const _exportedKey = response.encryptedData.exportedMasterKey;
				const decryptedData = await decryptMasterKeyDataFromBiometrics(
					response.encryptedData,
					_exportedKey
				);
				nsec = decryptedData.nsec;
				mnemonic = decryptedData.mnemonic;

				const migrationResponse = await migratePasskey({
					npub: credentails.npub,
					decryptedData,
					deviceId,
					deviceName,
					username: response.user?.username ?? '',
					platform: checkNativePlatform() ? 'mobile' : 'web'
				});

				response = migrationResponse.response;
				exportedKey = migrationResponse.exportedKey;
				credentialId = migrationResponse.credentialId;
			} else {
				// decrypt nsec
				const decryptedData = await decryptMasterKeyDataFromBiometrics(
					response.encryptedData,
					credentails.exportedKey
				);
				nsec = decryptedData.nsec;
				mnemonic = decryptedData.mnemonic;
			}

			if (!nsec || !mnemonic) {
				error = $t('login.errors.failed');
				isPasskeyError = true;
				return;
			}

			if (!response.access_token) {
				throw new Error($t('login.errors.no_token'));
			}

			const biometricData = {
				npub: credentails.npub,
				exportedKey: exportedKey,
				encryptedData: response.encryptedData,
				credentialId
			};

			// If the account was pending deletion and the user just logged in,
			// the backend automatically cancels the deletion. Show a welcome-back toast.
			if (response.accountRestored) {
				appStore.showSuccessToast($t('login.account_restored_message'));
			}

			await authState.setupAuthData(
				response.access_token,
				'passkey',
				credentails.npub,
				response.user,
				biometricData,
				true,
				response.refresh_token
			);
		} catch (err: unknown) {
			console.error('Authentication failed:', err);

			// Handle specific WebAuthn cancellation error
			if (err instanceof Error) {
				// Silently ignore "A request is already pending" errors
				if (
					err.message.includes('A request is already pending') ||
					err.message.includes('request is already pending') ||
					err.message === ''
				) {
					// Don't show error for pending requests
					error = '';
					isPasskeyError = false;
				} else {
					// Use biometric error handler to translate error messages
					const platform = Capacitor.getPlatform() === 'web' ? 'web' : 'mobile-webauthn';
					error = await handleBiometricError(err, platform);
					// Check if error is related to passkeys/biometrics
					isPasskeyError =
						error !== '' &&
						(err.message.toLowerCase().includes('passkey') ||
							err.message.toLowerCase().includes('biometric') ||
							err.message.toLowerCase().includes('webauthn') ||
							err.message.toLowerCase().includes('authentication') ||
							err.name === 'NotAllowedError' ||
							err.name === 'NotSupportedError' ||
							err.name === 'SecurityError' ||
							err.name === 'TimeoutError');
				}
			} else {
				error = $t('login.errors.failed');
				isPasskeyError = false;
			}
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	}

	// Login with Nostr private key
	async function handleNsecLogin() {
		try {
			isLoading = true;
			error = '';
			isPasskeyError = false;
			lastAction = 'nsecLogin'; // Track which action was attempted

			// Only run in browser environment to avoid Buffer issues
			if (typeof Buffer === 'undefined') {
				throw new Error('Buffer is not defined');
			}
			// decode nsec includes validation of nsec
			const privateKey = decodeNsec(nsec);
			const npub = getPublicKey(privateKey);

			if (!privateKey && !npub) {
				error = 'Invalid nostr keys';
				return;
			}
			const { challenge } = await authService.getChallenge();

			const signedEvent = finalizeEvent(
				{
					kind: 22242,
					created_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
					content: challenge,
					tags: [
						['relay', window.location.origin],
						['challenge', challenge]
					]
				},
				privateKey
			);

			const deviceId = await getDeviceIdentifier();
			const deviceName = await createUserDeviceShortName(npub);

			let mnemonic = '';

			const response = await authService.encryptedNostrData({
				event: signedEvent,
				deviceId: deviceId,
				deviceName: deviceName,
				platform: isNativePlatform ? 'mobile' : 'web',
				appVersion: __APP_VERSION__
			});

			if (response && response.encryptedData) {
				// @ts-expect-error - Legacy format to be removed in the future
				const exportedMasterKey = response.encryptedData.exportedMasterKey;
				if (exportedMasterKey) {
					const decryptedData = await decryptMasterKeyDataFromBiometrics(
						response.encryptedData,
						exportedMasterKey
					);
					mnemonic = decryptedData.mnemonic;
				} else {
					// Account exists, decrypt wallet mnemonic
					const masterSalt = base64ToBytes(response.encryptedData.masterSalt);
					try {
						// try decryption with nsec hex format (...64 characters)
						let _nsec = nsec;
						if (nsec.startsWith('nsec1')) {
							_nsec = bytesToHex(privateKey);
						}
						const exportedMasterKey = await deriveKeyFromPassword(_nsec, masterSalt, 100000);
						const _exportedKey = await exportKey(exportedMasterKey);

						const decryptedData = await decryptMasterKeyDataFromBiometrics(
							response.encryptedData,
							_exportedKey
						);
						mnemonic = decryptedData.mnemonic;
					} catch {
						console.warn('Error decrypting in bech32 format, trying hex format');
						try {
							// try direct decryption with nsec bech32 format (nsec1...)
							const exportedMasterKey = await deriveKeyFromPassword(nsec, masterSalt, 100000);
							const _exportedKey = await exportKey(exportedMasterKey);
							const decryptedData = await decryptMasterKeyDataFromBiometrics(
								response.encryptedData,
								_exportedKey
							);
							mnemonic = decryptedData.mnemonic;
						} catch (error) {
							throw new Error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error');
						}
					}
				}
			} else {
				// Account does not exist, generate new wallet mnemonic
				mnemonic = await deriveWalletFromNostr(nsec);
			}

			let { encryptedData, exportedKey } = await encryptMasterKeyData(nsec, mnemonic, nsec);

			// Check if we're in a test environment (E2E tests) or dev mode (VITE skip passkey)
			const isTestEnvironment =
				import.meta.env.VITE_SKIP_PASSKEY === 'true' ||
				(typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
					'__PLAYWRIGHT_TEST__' in window &&
					(window as { __PLAYWRIGHT_TEST__?: boolean }).__PLAYWRIGHT_TEST__);
			dbg.log(
				'authenticate: isTestEnvironment=%s, isBiometricsAvailable=%s, isNative=%s',
				isTestEnvironment,
				isBiometricsAvailable,
				isNativePlatform
			);

			let credentialData = {
				credentialId: '',
				passkeyPubkey: '',
				clientDataJSON: '',
				attestationObject: '',
				challenge: ''
			};
			// Store master key data in biometrics
			// In native platform: use Capacitor WebAuthn plugin
			// In browser/CDP: use native navigator.credentials.create() with virtual authenticator
			if (isBiometricsAvailable) {
				dbg.log('authenticate: calling setBiometricKey...');
				try {
					credentialData = await setBiometricKey({
						npub,
						exportedKey,
						username: response?.username
					});
					dbg.log('authenticate: setBiometricKey returned:', {
						hasCredentialId: !!credentialData.credentialId,
						hasPasskeyPubkey: !!credentialData.passkeyPubkey,
						hasClientDataJSON: !!credentialData.clientDataJSON,
						hasAttestationObject: !!credentialData.attestationObject,
						hasChallenge: !!credentialData.challenge,
						credentialIdLen: credentialData.credentialId?.length || 0,
						passkeyPubkeyLen: credentialData.passkeyPubkey?.length || 0,
						attestationObjectLen: credentialData.attestationObject?.length || 0
					});
				} catch (err) {
					dbg.error('authenticate: setBiometricKey failed:', err);
					throw err;
				}
			} else {
				dbg.log('authenticate: isBiometricsAvailable=false, skipping setBiometricKey');
			}
			// sign a new event with the new challenge
			const loginEventPayload = {
				kind: 22242,
				created_at: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000),
				content: challenge,
				tags: [
					['relay', window.location.origin],
					['challenge', credentialData.challenge]
				]
			};
			const newSignedEvent = finalizeEvent(loginEventPayload, privateKey);

			// Login with nostr, register user if it does not exist
			const res = await authService.nostrLogin({
				event: newSignedEvent,
				challenge: credentialData.challenge,
				authMethod: (isTestEnvironment ? 'nsec' : 'passkey') as 'passkey',
				deviceId,
				encryptedData,
				deviceName,
				credentialId: credentialData.credentialId,
				passkeyPubkey: credentialData.passkeyPubkey,
				clientDataJSON: credentialData.clientDataJSON,
				attestationObject: credentialData.attestationObject,
				appVersion: __APP_VERSION__,
				platform: isNativePlatform ? 'mobile' : 'web',
				timezoneOffset: new Date().getTimezoneOffset(),
				lang: get(locale) || 'en'
			});

			if (res.isMigrated) {
				// Show modal info to user that passkey has been migrated and old passkeys for this account have been revoked
				// Wait for the modal to be closed by the user
				await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
					let unsubscribe: (() => void) | undefined;
					let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;

					unsubscribe = passkeyMigration.subscribe((state) => {
						if (state.state === 'info') {
							clearTimeout(timeoutId);
							unsubscribe?.();
							resolve(true);
						}
					});

					// Timeout after 5 minutes
					timeoutId = setTimeout(
						() => {
							unsubscribe();
							reject(new Error('Timeout waiting for user action'));
						},
						5 * 60 * 1000
					);

					passkeyMigration.update((state) => ({
						...state,
						isOpen: true,
						state: 'migrated',
						error: null,
						shouldProceed: false,
						context: null
					}));
				});
			}

			if (res.access_token) {
				const biometricData = {
					npub,
					encryptedData,
					exportedKey,
					credentialId: credentialData.credentialId
				};

				authState
					.setupAuthData(
						res.access_token,
						'passkey',
						npub,
						res.user,
						biometricData,
						false,
						res.refresh_token
					)
					.then(async () => {
						await applyNdkSignerFromNsec(privateKey);
						appStore.update((state) => ({
							...state,
							nostrKeys: { ...state.nostrKeys, nsec: privateKey, npub }
						}));
						// If the account was pending deletion and the user just logged in,
						// the backend automatically cancels the deletion. Show a welcome-back toast.
						if (res.accountRestored) {
							appStore.showSuccessToast($t('login.account_restored_message'));
						}
						if (res.isNewUser) {
							await goto('/auth/onboarding');
						} else {
							const deepLink = await consumeDeepLink();
							const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
							const returnTo = params.get('returnTo');
							const target =
								returnTo && isValidInternalPath(returnTo) ? returnTo : deepLink || '/hiring';
							await goto(target);
						}
						if ($passkeyMigration.isOpen) {
							resetMigration();
						}
					});
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Error:', err);
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('login.errors.failed');
			// Check if error is related to passkeys/biometrics (nsec login can involve passkey setup)
			if (err instanceof Error) {
				isPasskeyError =
					err.message.toLowerCase().includes('passkey') ||
					err.message.toLowerCase().includes('biometric') ||
					err.message.toLowerCase().includes('webauthn') ||
					err.message.toLowerCase().includes('authentication') ||
					err.name === 'NotAllowedError' ||
					err.name === 'NotSupportedError' ||
					err.name === 'SecurityError';
			} else {
				isPasskeyError = false;
			}
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	}

	function handleLoginWithQrCode(barcode: Barcode | string) {
		nsec = typeof barcode === 'string' ? barcode : barcode.displayValue;
		handleNsecLogin();
	}
</script>

<div
	class="mx-auto flex w-full max-w-2xl grow flex-col items-center justify-center px-2 pt-2 sm:pt-6 sm:pb-8"
>
	<div class="card bg-base-100 w-full p-4 shadow-xl">
		<div class="">
			{#if !$passkeyMigration.isOpen}
				<div class="flex flex-col items-center justify-center">
					<Logo
						class="mx-auto mt-0 mb-4 block w-full max-w-xs sm:mt-6 sm:mb-6 sm:max-w-sm md:max-w-md"
					/>
					<h3 class="mt-2 text-center font-bold sm:mt-4">{$t('login.title')}</h3>
					<br />
					<p class="mx-auto space-y-2 text-center">
						<span class="text-base-content text-md block text-center">
							{$t('login.subtitle')}
						</span>
					</p>
				</div>
				<div class="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-4">
					{#if !isNostrLogin}
						<div
							class="flex flex-col gap-4"
							in:fly={{
								duration: 200,
								easing: linear,
								y: 0,
								x: isNostrLogin ? 20 : -20

<script lang="ts">
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { linear } from 'svelte/easing';
	import { fly } from 'svelte/transition';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { autoLoadTranslations } from '$lib/i18n/routeTranslations';
	import { generateSecretKey, getPublicKey } from 'nostr-tools';
	import { bytesToHex } from '$lib/utils/helpers/encoding.js';
	import { resolveHandle } from '$lib/utils/helpers/usernameGenerator.js';
	import { applyNdkSignerFromNsec } from '$lib/nostr/ndkSigner';
	import { publishProfileMetadata } from '$lib/nostr/profile/metadata-publish';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import DisplayNameSetup from '$lib/components/onboarding/DisplayNameSetup.svelte';
	import RecoverySetup from '$lib/components/onboarding/RecoverySetup.svelte';
	import PasskeySetup from '$lib/components/onboarding/PasskeySetup.svelte';
	import ProfileSetup from '$lib/components/onboarding/ProfileSetup.svelte';
	import CompleteSetup from '$lib/components/onboarding/CompleteSetup.svelte';

	let { data } = $props();

	// Step order: 0 Display name, 1 Passkey, 2 Profile, 3 Recovery, 4 Complete
	const totalSteps = 5;

	// svelte-ignore state_referenced_locally
	let currentStep = $state(data.currentStep ?? 0);
	let direction = $state<'forward' | 'backward'>('forward');
	let isPublishing = $state(false);
	let publishError = $state('');

	const formData = $state({
		displayName: '',
		username: '',
		nsec: '',
		npub: ''
	});

	function profilePublishErrorMessage(err: unknown): string {
		if (err instanceof Error) {
			if (err.message === 'PROFILE_METADATA_VERIFY_TIMEOUT') {
				return $t('onboarding_auth.form.profile_publish.verify_timeout');
			}
			if (err.message === 'PROFILE_METADATA_PUBLISH_REJECTED') {
				return $t('onboarding_auth.form.profile_publish.relay_rejected');
			}
			return err.message;
		}
		return $t('onboarding_auth.form.profile_publish.failed');
	}

	const nextStep = async () => {
		if (currentStep === 0) {
			isPublishing = true;
			publishError = '';
			try {
				if (!formData.nsec) {
					const sk = generateSecretKey();
					formData.nsec = bytesToHex(sk);
					formData.npub = getPublicKey(sk);

					// generate username from display name and npub
					formData.username = await resolveHandle(formData.displayName, formData.npub);
					await applyNdkSignerFromNsec(sk);
					// Ensures ProfileSetup can recover the signer via syncNdkSignerFromAppStore if reached without the nsec prop
					appStore.update((s) => ({
						...s,
						nostrKeys: { ...s.nostrKeys, nsec: sk, npub: formData.npub }
					}));
				}

				const displayName = formData.displayName.trim();
				await publishProfileMetadata({ display_name: displayName }, {}, undefined, {
					requiredDisplayName: displayName
				});

				currentStep++;
				direction = 'forward';
			} catch (err) {
				publishError = profilePublishErrorMessage(err);
			} finally {
				isPublishing = false;
			}
			return;
		}

		currentStep++;
		direction = 'forward';
	};

	const prevStep = async () => {
		if (currentStep > 0) {
			currentStep--;
			direction = 'backward';
		} else {
			await goto('/auth/signup');
		}
	};
</script>

<div class="flex w-full grow flex-col items-center px-4 md:py-8" use:autoLoadTranslations>
	<div class="w-full max-w-4xl">

			<Logo
				class="mx-auto mt-4 mb-4 block max-h-[60px] w-full max-w-xs sm:max-h-none sm:max-w-sm md:max-w-md"

						>{$t('onboarding_auth.form.username_setup.step')}
						{currentStep + 1}
						{$t('onboarding_auth.form.username_setup.of')}
						{totalSteps}</span
					>
					<span class="text-base-content/70 text-sm"
						>{Math.round(((currentStep + 1) / totalSteps) * 100)}%</span
					>
				</div>
				<div class="bg-base-300 h-2 w-full rounded-full">
					<div
						class="bg-primary h-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ease-out"
						style="width: {((currentStep + 1) / totalSteps) * 100}%"
					></div>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>

		{#if currentStep === 0}
			<div
				in:fly={{
					duration: 200,
					x: direction === 'forward' ? 20 : -20,
					easing: linear,
					delay: 100
				}}
			>
				<DisplayNameSetup
					bind:displayName={formData.displayName}
					{nextStep}
					{isPublishing}
					{publishError}
				/>
			</div>
		{:else if currentStep === 1}
			<div
				in:fly={{
					duration: 200,
					x: direction === 'forward' ? 20 : -20,
					easing: linear,
					delay: 100
				}}
			>
				<PasskeySetup
					{nextStep}
					{prevStep}
					username={formData.username}
					npub={formData.npub}
					nsec={formData.nsec}
				/>
			</div>
		{:else if currentStep === 2}
			<div
				in:fly={{
					duration: 200,
					x: direction === 'forward' ? 20 : -20,
					easing: linear,
					delay: 100
				}}
			>
				<ProfileSetup
					{nextStep}
					{prevStep}
					mode={formData.displayName.trim() ? 'signup_enrichment' : 'nsec_first_publish'}
					displayName={formData.displayName}
					npub={formData.npub}
					nsec={formData.nsec}
				/>
			</div>
		{:else if currentStep === 3}
			<div
				in:fly={{
					duration: 200,
					x: direction === 'forward' ? 20 : -20,
					easing: linear,
					delay: 100
				}}
			>
				<RecoverySetup {nextStep} {prevStep} />
			</div>
		{:else if currentStep === 4}
			<div
				in:fly={{
					duration: 200,
					x: direction === 'forward' ? 20 : -20,
					easing: linear,
					delay: 100
				}}
			>
				<CompleteSetup />
			</div>
		{/if}
	</div>
</div>

<script lang="ts">
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { validateEmail } from '$lib/utils/helpers/validators';
	import authService from '$lib/api/services/auth.service';

	let email = $state('');
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let error = $state('');
	let success = $state(false);

	async function initiateRecovery(event: Event) {
		event.preventDefault();

		try {
			isLoading = true;
			error = '';

			if (!email) {
				error = $t('recovery_send.errors.email_required');
				return;
			}

			if (!validateEmail(email).isValid) {
				error = $t('recovery_send.errors.invalid_email');
				return;
			}

			await authService.initiateNostrRecovery(email);
			success = true;
		} catch (err: unknown) {
			const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('recovery_send.errors.failed_initiate');
			error = errorMessage;
		} finally {
			isLoading = false;
		}
	}
</script>

<script lang="ts">
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { isCaptchaVerified } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import authService from '$lib/api/services/auth.service';

	let error = $state('');
	let isLoading = $state(false);
	let turnstileWidget = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);
	let turnstileWidgetId: string | undefined;
	let captchaFailed = $state(false);
	let tosAccepted = $state(false);

	onMount(async () => {
		try {
			// E2E bypass: when running Playwright (or with VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS=true), skip Turnstile and enable Continue
			if (import.meta.env.VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS === 'true') {
				isCaptchaVerified.set(true);
				// Diagnostic: visible in Playwright page console and CI attachments
				console.log('[E2E] Turnstile bypass active on signup');
				return;
			}
			// Setup callback for Turnstile
			window.onloadTurnstileCallback = renderTurnstile;
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Error checking authentication methods:', err);
		}
	});

	// Render Turnstile widget
	function renderTurnstile() {
		if (!turnstileWidget || !window.turnstile) return;

		turnstileWidgetId = window.turnstile.render(turnstileWidget, {
			sitekey: import.meta.env.VITE_CLOUDFLARE_SITEKEY || '1x00000000000000000000AA',
			theme: 'auto',
			size: 'normal' as const,
			retry: 'never' as const,
			'retry-interval': 10000,
			callback: function (token: string) {
				verifyCaptcha(token);
			},
			'expired-callback': function () {
				isCaptchaVerified.set(false);
				captchaFailed = true;
				error = $t('signup.error.captcha_expired');
			},
			'error-callback': function () {
				captchaFailed = true;
				error = $t('signup.error.verification_error');
			}
		});
	}

	function resetTurnstile() {
		if (window.turnstile && turnstileWidgetId) {
			window.turnstile.reset(turnstileWidgetId);
			captchaFailed = false;
			error = '';
		}
	}

	async function verifyCaptcha(token: string) {
		try {
			const result = await authService.verifyTurnstile(token, 'signup');

			if (!result) {
				console.error('No data returned from captcha verification');
				throw new Error($t('signup.error.captcha_failed'));
			}

			const success = result.success;

			isCaptchaVerified.set(success);

			if (success) {
				error = ''; // Clear any previous errors
				captchaFailed = false;
			} else {
				error = result.message || $t('signup.error.captcha_failed');
				captchaFailed = true;
			}
		} catch (err) {
			console.error('Error verifying captcha:', err);
			error = err instanceof Error ? err.message : $t('signup.error.captcha_failed');
			isCaptchaVerified.set(false);
			captchaFailed = true;
		}
	}
</script>

import type { LayoutLoad } from './$types';
import { get } from 'svelte/store';
import { redirect } from '@sveltejs/kit';
import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import { StorageKeys } from '$lib/utils/constants/storage';
import { isCaptchaVerified } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
import { Preferences } from '@capacitor/preferences';
import { consumeDeepLink } from '$lib/utils/deep-link';

export const load: LayoutLoad = async ({ url }) => {
	if (!browser) return;

	const token = await Preferences.get({ key: StorageKeys.ACCESS_TOKEN });

	// If user is logged in and not in onboarding, redirect to dashboard
	if (token.value) {
		if (url.pathname.includes('/onboarding')) {
			return { currentStep: 2 };
		} else {
			// Check for a pending deep link before defaulting to /hiring
			const deepLink = await consumeDeepLink();
			if (deepLink) {
				redirect(303, deepLink);
			}
			redirect(303, '/hiring');
		}
	} else {
		if (url.pathname.includes('/onboarding')) {
			const verified = get(isCaptchaVerified);
			// E2E: allow onboarding when bypass env is set so we don't rely on store timing (CI race)
			const e2eBypass =
				typeof import.meta !== 'undefined' && import.meta.env?.VITE_E2E_TURNSTILE_BYPASS === 'true';
			if (!verified && !e2eBypass) {
				// Diagnostic: visible in Playwright page console and CI attachments when redirect happens
				console.warn(
					'[E2E] Auth layout redirect: isCaptchaVerified=false, redirecting to /auth/signup'
				);
				redirect(303, '/auth/signup');
			}
			// Diagnostic: when we allow onboarding
			if (e2eBypass) console.log('[E2E] Auth layout: allowing onboarding (E2E bypass env)');
			else console.log('[E2E] Auth layout: allowing onboarding (isCaptchaVerified=true)');
		}
	}
};

	async function buildHarnessNdkPaymentContract(args: {
		authorSk: Uint8Array;
		taskerPubkeyHex: string;
		taskeePubkeyHex: string;
	}): Promise<import('$lib/nostr/events/contract').NDKPaymentContract> {
		const { NDKEvent } = await import('@nostr-dev-kit/ndk');
		const { NDKPaymentContract } = await import('$lib/nostr/events/contract');
		const { getPublicKey } = await import('nostr-tools/pure');
		const template = createHarnessServiceContract().contractEvent.content;
		const legacy: Record<string, unknown> = {
			type: 'contract',
			escrowId: template.escrowId,
			contextType: template.contextType,
			contextTitle: template.contextTitle,
			contextDescription: template.contextDescription,
			clientPubkey: args.taskerPubkeyHex,
			freelancerPubkey: args.taskeePubkeyHex,
			taskTitle: template.taskTitle,
			taskDescription: template.taskDescription,
			amount: template.amount,
			purchaseMode: template.purchaseMode,
			quoteRequestId: template.quoteRequestId,
			proposalId: template.proposalId,
			selectedTierId: template.selectedTierId,
			estimatedStartTime: template.estimatedStartTime,
			estimatedCompletionTime: template.estimatedCompletionTime,
			agreementSnapshot: template.agreementSnapshot,
			pricingSnapshot: template.pricingSnapshot,
			status: template.status,
			currency: template.currency,
			network: import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_NETWORK || 'testnet',
			contractAddress: `0x${'b'.repeat(40)}`,
			version: 'v2'
		};
		delete legacy.taskId;
		const authorPk = getPublicKey(args.authorSk);
		const raw = new NDKEvent(ndk, {
			kind: 30006,
			pubkey: authorPk,
			created_at: 1_700_000_000,
			tags: [['n', String(import.meta.env.VITE_RSK_NETWORK || 'testnet')]],
			content: JSON.stringify(legacy),
			id: 'ef'.repeat(32),
			sig: 'ab'.repeat(64)
		});
		const parsed = await NDKPaymentContract.from(raw);
		if (!parsed) {
			throw new Error('Harness could not parse Kind 30006 payment contract');
		}
		return parsed;
	}

	async function installNdkContractsHarnessPlugins(
		synthetic30006: import('$lib/nostr/events/contract').NDKPaymentContract[],
		chainByPaymentId: Record<string, SecurePaymentLegacy>
	): Promise<void> {
		const existing = getContractsHarnessGlobals();
		const origSubscribe = existing?.origSubscribe ?? ndk.subscribe.bind(ndk);
		const origRuneStart =
			existing?.origRuneStart ??
			(PaymentContractRune.prototype.start as (
				this: InstanceType<typeof PaymentContractRune>
			) => Promise<void>);

		const bag: BittaskerContractsHarnessGlobals = {
			ndk,
			PaymentContractRune,
			origSubscribe,
			origRuneStart,
			synthetic30006,
			chainByPaymentId
		};
		setContractsHarnessGlobals(bag);

		ndk.subscribe = ((filters: NDKFilter | NDKFilter[], subOpts: NDKSubscriptionOptions) => {
			const list = Array.isArray(filters) ? filters : [filters];
			const kindsRaw = list.flatMap((f) => [...(f.kinds ?? [])] as number[]);
			const noopSub = {} as NDKSubscription;
			if (kindsRaw.includes(30006) && bag.synthetic30006.length > 0) {
				queueMicrotask(() => {
					if (subOpts.onEvents) {
						subOpts.onEvents(bag.synthetic30006);
					} else {
						for (const ev of bag.synthetic30006) {
							subOpts.onEvent?.(ev);
						}
					}
					subOpts.onEose?.(noopSub);
				});
				return { stop: () => {}, start: () => {} };
			}
			if (kindsRaw.includes(31006)) {
				queueMicrotask(() => {
					subOpts.onEvents?.([]);
					subOpts.onEose?.(noopSub);
				});
				return { stop: () => {}, start: () => {} };
			}
			return bag.origSubscribe(filters, subOpts);
		}) as typeof ndk.subscribe;

		PaymentContractRune.prototype.start = async function (
			this: import('$lib/runes/contractRune.svelte').PaymentContractRune
		) {
			await bag.origRuneStart.call(this);
			const pid = this.paymentId?.trim();
			const snap = pid ? bag.chainByPaymentId[pid] : undefined;
			if (snap) {
				this.blockchainData = snap;
				this.error = null;
			}
		};
	}
