	type HarnessQuoteTimelineOptions = {
		requestId?: string;
		requestEventId?: string;
		inquiryTitle?: string;
		inquiryDescription?: string;
		requestTitle?: string;
		requestDescription?: string;
		createdAt?: number;
		withProposal?: boolean;
	};

	function createHarnessQuoteTimeline(
		service: Service,
		options: HarnessQuoteTimelineOptions = {}
	): ServiceQuoteTimelineEntry {
		const serviceAddress = `30402:${service.npub}:${service.uniqueId ?? service.id}`;
		const requestId = options.requestId ?? 'qr_valid123';
		const requestEventId = options.requestEventId ?? `request-event-${requestId}`;
		const inquiryTitle = options.inquiryTitle ?? options.requestTitle ?? 'Need a brand refresh';
		const createdAt = options.createdAt ?? 1_700_000_000;
		const proposalEvent = options.withProposal
			? {
					id: `proposal-${requestEventId}`,
					kind: 6421 as const,
					pubkey: service.npub,
					created_at: createdAt + 60,
					tags: [
						['e', requestEventId],
						['p', 'b'.repeat(64)]
					],
					content: {
						type: 'service-proposal' as const,
						proposalId: `pr_${requestId}`,
						quoteRequestId: requestId,
						serviceId: serviceAddress,
						serviceAddress,
						paymentType: 'FIXED' as const,
						amountUsdt: '225.00',
						description: `${inquiryTitle} proposal`,
						estimatedDuration: '4 days',
						estimatedStartTime: createdAt,
						estimatedEndTime: createdAt + 259_200,
						expirationDays: 5,
						expirationHours: 0,
						expirationTimestamp: createdAt + 300_000,
						freelancerRskAddress: '0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111',
						freelancerFeeTier: 1 as const,
						pricingSnapshot: {
							serviceVersionRef: service.id
						},
						timestamp: createdAt + 60,
						version: 'v1' as const
					},
					sig: ''
				}
			: undefined;

		return {
			request: {
				id: requestEventId,
				kind: 6420,
				pubkey: 'b'.repeat(64),
				created_at: createdAt,
				tags: [],
				content: {
					type: 'service-quote-request',
					quoteRequestId: requestId,
					serviceId: serviceAddress,
					serviceAddress,
					pricingType: ServicePricingTypeEnum.INQUIRY_REQUIRED,
					tierId: 'premium',
					selectedAddOns: [],
					rushDelivery: false,
					inquiry: {
						title: inquiryTitle,
						description:
							options.inquiryDescription ?? options.requestDescription ?? `${inquiryTitle} details.`
					},
					timestamp: createdAt,
					version: 'v1'
				},
				sig: ''
			},
			proposals: proposalEvent ? [proposalEvent] : [],
			statusEventsByProposalId: {},
			latestProposal: proposalEvent,
			resolvedStatus: 'pending',
			resolvedTerminalEvent: undefined,
			expirationTimestamp: proposalEvent?.content.expirationTimestamp,
			isExpired: false,
			linkedEscrowId: undefined
		};
	}

	function buildRequestsHarnessStateSnapshot() {
		if (!requestsHarnessState) {
			return '';
		}

		const visibleTimelines = requestsHarnessState.selectedServiceAddress
			? (requestsHarnessState.timelinesByService[requestsHarnessState.selectedServiceAddress] ?? [])
			: requestsHarnessState.partialFailure
				? (requestsHarnessState.timelinesByService[requestsHarnessState.loadedServiceAddress] ?? [])
				: Object.values(requestsHarnessState.timelinesByService).flat();

		return JSON.stringify({
			selectedServiceAddress: requestsHarnessState.selectedServiceAddress,
			focusedRequestId: requestsHarnessState.focusedRequestId,
			loadError: requestsHarnessState.partialFailure ? 'provider query failed' : null,
			visibleRequestIds: visibleTimelines.map((timeline) => timeline.request.content.quoteRequestId)
		});
	}

	function syncRequestsHarnessSurface() {
		const harnessState = requestsHarnessState;
		if (!harnessState || !surfaceComponent) {
			return;
		}

		const serviceTitleByAddress = Object.fromEntries(
			harnessState.services.map((service) => [
				`30402:${service.npub}:${service.uniqueId ?? service.id}`,
				service.title
			])
		);
		const visibleTimelines = harnessState.selectedServiceAddress
			? (harnessState.timelinesByService[harnessState.selectedServiceAddress] ?? [])
			: harnessState.partialFailure
				? (harnessState.timelinesByService[harnessState.loadedServiceAddress] ?? [])
				: Object.values(harnessState.timelinesByService).flat();

		surfaceProps = {
			service:
				harnessState.services.find(
					(entry) =>
						`30402:${entry.npub}:${entry.uniqueId ?? entry.id}` ===
						harnessState.selectedServiceAddress
				) ?? null,
			services: harnessState.services,
			selectedServiceAddress: harnessState.selectedServiceAddress,
			showServiceTitles: harnessState.selectedServiceAddress === null,
			serviceTitleByAddress,
			timelines: visibleTimelines,
			focusedRequestId: harnessState.focusedRequestId,
			isSyncing: false,
			hasLoaded: true,
			loadError: harnessState.partialFailure ? 'provider query failed' : null,
			walletReady: true,
			feeTierReady: true,
			totalPendingRequestCount: visibleTimelines.filter(
				(timeline) => timeline.resolvedStatus === 'pending' && !timeline.latestProposal
			).length,
			onServiceFilterChange: (serviceAddress: string | null) => {
				requestsHarnessState = {
					...harnessState,
					selectedServiceAddress: serviceAddress,
					partialFailure: false
				};
				syncRequestsHarnessSurface();
			},
			onRequestFocusChange: (requestId: string | null) => {
				requestsHarnessState = {
					...harnessState,
					focusedRequestId: requestId
				};
				syncRequestsHarnessSurface();
			},
			onRequestClear: () => {
				requestsHarnessState = {
					...harnessState,
					focusedRequestId: null
				};
				syncRequestsHarnessSurface();
			},
			onSendProposal: async () => ({ success: true }),
			onDeleteProposal: async () => ({ success: true })
		};
	}

	function activateRequestsHarnessPartialFailure() {
		if (!requestsHarnessState) {
			return;
		}

		requestsHarnessState = {
			...requestsHarnessState,
			selectedServiceAddress: null,
			partialFailure: true,
			focusedRequestId: null
		};
		syncRequestsHarnessSurface();
	}

	async function waitForSurfaceReady(
		predicate: () => boolean,
		timeoutMs = 4_000
	): Promise<boolean> {
		const deadline = Date.now() + timeoutMs;

		while (Date.now() < deadline) {
			await tick();
			await new Promise<void>((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve()));
			if (predicate()) {
				return true;
			}
			await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
		}

		return false;
	}

import type { LayoutLoad } from './$types';
import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import { Preferences } from '@capacitor/preferences';
import { authState } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
import { StorageKeys } from '$lib/utils/constants/storage';
import { tryCatch } from '$lib/utils/tryCatch';
import { user } from '$lib/stores/user.store';

export const load: LayoutLoad = async ({ url }) => {
	// Only check authentication on the client side
	if (browser) {
		// Use a dynamic import so WebKit does not race the async i18n module initialization.
		void import('$lib/i18n/routeTranslations').then(({ loadPageTranslations }) =>
			loadPageTranslations(url.pathname)
		);

		let token: string | null = null;
		try {
			const result = await Preferences.get({ key: StorageKeys.ACCESS_TOKEN });
			token = result.value;
		} catch {
			token = null;
		}

		if (token && token !== null) {
			// User is authenticated, initialize user data
			await tryCatch(user.getUserData());
			authState.login();
		}
	}
};

// Disable SSR for public routes in Capacitor
export const ssr = false;

<script lang="ts">

	import { serviceQuoteUiStore } from '$lib/stores/service-quote-ui.store';
	import { appStore } from '$lib/stores/app.store';
	import {
		loadPersistedServiceSearchFilters,
		persistServiceSearchFilters
	} from '$lib/utils/service-search-persistence';
	import { debounceWithAbort } from '$lib/utils/helpers/common';
	import { hashSearchParams } from '$lib/utils/search.utils';
	import {
		manageSaveSearchBanner,
		dismissSaveSearchBanner,
		cancelDeferredBanner
	} from '$lib/utils/saveSearchBanner';

	// ── Constants ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	const DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH = 1024;
	const MAP_PRELOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000;
	const MAP_PRELOAD_FALLBACK_MS = 1000;
	const SCROLL_TO_TOP_THRESHOLD = 300;
	const LOADING_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000;
	const FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000;
	const BTC_PRICE_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000;
	const INITIAL_SKELETON_COUNT = 20;
	const RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS = 2000;
	const BTC_PRICE_CACHE_KEY = 'btc_price_cache';
	const BTC_PRICE_CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000;

	// ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	function getInitialSearchParams(): SearchServicesParams {
		return {
			categories: [],
			skills: [],
			serviceLocationTypes: [],
			page: 1,
			limit: 20,
			search: ''
		};
	}

	function browseText(key: string, fallback: string): string {
		const translated = $t(key) as string;
		return !translated || translated === key ? fallback : translated;
	}

	function isOwnService(service: Service | null | undefined): boolean {
		return !!service?.npub && !!$user?.npub && service.npub === $user.npub;
	}

	// ── State: Search & Filters ────────────────────────────────────────────────
	let searchParams = $state<SearchServicesParams>(getInitialSearchParams());
	let searchQuery = $state('');
	let isFilterDrawerOpen = $state(false);
	let isSaveSearchOpen = $state(false);
	let isApplyingFilters = $state(false);
	let searchVersion = $state(0);
	let isSearchInputFocused = $state(false);
	let searchAbortController: AbortController | null = null;
	let pendingSaveSearchParams: SearchServicesParams | null = null;
	const isNative = Capacitor.isNativePlatform();

	let activeFilterCount = $derived.by(() => {
		let count = 0;
		if (searchParams.categories && searchParams.categories.length > 0) count++;
		if (searchParams.skills && searchParams.skills.length > 0) count++;
		if (searchParams.serviceLocationTypes && searchParams.serviceLocationTypes.length > 0) count++;
		if (searchParams.pricingType) count++;
		if (searchParams.minPrice !== undefined || searchParams.maxPrice !== undefined) count++;
		if (searchParams.deliveryTime) count++;
		if (searchParams.location) count++;
		return count;
	});

	let hasActiveParams = $derived.by(
		() =>
			!!searchParams.search ||
			(searchParams.categories && searchParams.categories.length > 0) ||
			(searchParams.skills && searchParams.skills.length > 0) ||
			(searchParams.serviceLocationTypes && searchParams.serviceLocationTypes.length > 0) ||
			!!searchParams.pricingType ||
			searchParams.minPrice !== undefined ||
			searchParams.maxPrice !== undefined ||
			searchParams.deliveryTime !== undefined
	);

	const searchInputClass = $derived(
		(() => {
			let baseClass = 'input input-bordered w-full pl-10';
			if (searchQuery.length > 0 && searchQuery.length < 3) {
				baseClass += ' input-warning';
			} else if (searchQuery.length >= 3) {
				baseClass += ' input-success';
			}
			return baseClass;
		})()
	);

	// ── State: Loading ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	type LoadingState = 'initial' | 'loading' | 'loaded' | 'timeout' | 'error';
	let loadingState = $state<LoadingState>('initial');
	let showSkeleton = $derived(loadingState === 'initial' || loadingState === 'loading');
	let dataLoaded = $derived(
		loadingState === 'loaded' || loadingState === 'error' || loadingState === 'timeout'
	);
	let loadingTimedOut = $derived(loadingState === 'timeout');
	let unmounted = $state(false);
	let retryLoading = $state(false);
	let lastRetryTime = 0;
	let loadingTimeoutTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

	// ── State: UI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	let SaveServiceSearchForm: typeof SaveServiceSearchFormComponent | null = $state(null);
	let TaskLocationMap: typeof TaskLocationMapComponent | null = $state(null);
	let RequestQuoteModal: typeof RequestQuoteModalComponent | null = $state(null);
	let drawersLoaded = $state(false);
	let mapLoaded = $state(false);
	let modalLoaded = $state(false);
	let mapPreloadAttempted = $state(false);
	let windowWidth = $state(0);
	let viewMode = $state<'list' | 'map'>('list');
	let selectedServiceForMap = $state<Service | null>(null);
	let requestQuoteModalOpen = $state(false);
	let serviceForQuote = $state<Service | null>(null);
	let btcPrice = $state<number>(120000);
	let showScrollToTop = $state(false);
	let serviceListRef = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);

	function scrollToTop(): void {
		$appScrollContainer?.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
	}

	// ── Infinite scroll: configure the layout's InfiniteScroll component ───────
	// Configure immediately so the InfiniteScroll component picks up loadMore on init
	scroll.set({
		hasMore: true,
		threshold: 500,
		elementScroll: null,
		page: 0,
		horizontal: false,
		loadMore: async () => {
			if (!$servicesStore.hasMore || $servicesStore.loading) return;

			const lastItem = $servicesStore.items[$servicesStore.items.length - 1];
			const cursorTimestamp = $servicesStore.lastRelayTimestamp ?? lastItem?.createdAt;
			if (!cursorTimestamp) return;

			try {
				await findServicesWithTimeout({
					...searchParams,
					page: $servicesStore.currentPage + 1,
					until: cursorTimestamp - 1
				});
			} catch (error) {
				console.error('[FindServices] Error loading more services:', error);
			}

			// Update hasMore after fetch
			scroll.update((s) => ({ ...s, hasMore: $servicesStore.hasMore }));
		}
	});

	// Keep scroll.hasMore in sync with the store.
	// After filter/view changes, dispatch a scroll event to trigger the
	// InfiniteScroll component's fallback listener, which re-checks distance.
	function syncScrollHasMore() {
		scroll.update((s) => ({ ...s, hasMore: $servicesStore.hasMore }));

		if (browser && $servicesStore.hasMore && !$servicesStore.loading) {
			requestAnimationFrame(() => {
				const scrollEl = document.querySelector('.app-shell__content');
				if (scrollEl) {
					// Trigger the InfiniteScroll fallback's onScroll handler
					scrollEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'));
				}
			});
		}
	}

	// ── Data fetching ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	async function findServicesWithTimeout(params: SearchServicesParams): Promise<void> {
		const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
			setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('findServices timed out')), FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS);
		});
		await Promise.race([findServices(params), timeoutPromise]);
	}

	async function loadNostrData(): Promise<void> {
		if (loadingState === 'loaded') return;

		if (loadingTimeoutTimer) {
			clearTimeout(loadingTimeoutTimer);
			loadingTimeoutTimer = null;
		}

		loadingState = 'loading';

		loadingTimeoutTimer = setTimeout(() => {
			if (!unmounted && $servicesStore.loading) {
				loadingState = 'timeout';
			}
		}, LOADING_TIMEOUT_MS);

		try {
			cleanup();

			searchParams = {
				...searchParams,
				page: 1,
				limit: 20
			};

			servicesStore.update((state) => ({
				...state,
				items: [],
				currentPage: 1,
				hasMore: true,
				lastRelayTimestamp: undefined,
				error: null,
				searchParamsKey: ''
			}));

			await findServicesWithTimeout(searchParams);

			if (unmounted) return;

			servicesStore.update((state) => ({
				...state,
				searchParamsKey: hashSearchParams(searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)
			}));
			loadingState = 'loaded';
			syncScrollHasMore();
		} catch (error) {
			if (unmounted) return;
			console.error('[FindServices] Error loading Nostr data:', error);
			loadingState = 'error';
		} finally {
			if (loadingTimeoutTimer) {
				clearTimeout(loadingTimeoutTimer);
				loadingTimeoutTimer = null;
			}
		}
	}

	async function retryLoadServices() {
		const now = Date.now();
		if (now - lastRetryTime < RETRY_COOLDOWN_MS) return;
		lastRetryTime = now;
		retryLoading = true;
		loadingState = 'loading';
		servicesStore.update((state) => ({ ...state, error: null }));
		await loadNostrData();
		retryLoading = false;
	}

	// ── Search & Filters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	const debouncedSearch = debounceWithAbort((...args: unknown[]) => {
		void (async (capturedSearchQuery: string, capturedSearchParams: SearchServicesParams) => {
			const currentVersion = ++searchVersion;

			// Abort any in-flight search request
			if (searchAbortController) {
				searchAbortController.abort();
			}
			searchAbortController = new AbortController();

			// Dismiss any pending deferred banner from a previous search
			cancelDeferredBanner();
			await dismissSaveSearchBanner();

			// CRITICAL: set loading state BEFORE clearing the store.
			// servicesStore.update() notifies subscribers synchronously, so if we
			// clear the store first, one render frame sees items=[] + dataLoaded=true
			// which flashes the empty state. Setting showSkeleton first prevents this.
			loadingState = 'loading';

			servicesStore.update((state) => ({
				...state,
				currentPage: 1,
				hasMore: true,
				lastRelayTimestamp: undefined,
				error: null,
				searchParamsKey: ''
			}));

			const newParams: SearchServicesParams = {
				...capturedSearchParams,
				page: 1,
				search: capturedSearchQuery.trim().length >= 3 ? capturedSearchQuery.trim() : undefined
			};
			searchParams = { ...capturedSearchParams, ...newParams };

			try {
				await findServicesWithTimeout(searchParams);
				if (currentVersion !== searchVersion) return;
				servicesStore.update((state) => ({
					...state,
					searchParamsKey: hashSearchParams(searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)
				}));
				loadingState = 'loaded';
				syncScrollHasMore();

				// Show save search banner AFTER results load
				// On native mobile: suppress while keyboard is open (input focused), re-trigger on blur
				// On web: always show (no keyboard interruption)
				const shouldSuppress = isNative && isSearchInputFocused;
				if (shouldSuppress) {
					pendingSaveSearchParams = { ...searchParams };
					await dismissSaveSearchBanner();
				} else {
					pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
					await manageSaveSearchBanner(
						searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
						'services',
						() => (isSaveSearchOpen = true),
						{
							deferred: true,
							deferMs: 2500
						}
					);
				}
			} catch (err) {
				console.error('[FindServices] Search fetch error:', err);
				loadingState = 'error';
			}
		})(args[0] as string, args[1] as SearchServicesParams);
	}, 1000);

	async function handleFilterApply(filterParams: SearchServicesParams) {
		isApplyingFilters = true;

		// Abort any in-flight search
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}
		searchAbortController = new AbortController();

		// CRITICAL: set loading state BEFORE clearing the store (same race as debouncedSearch)
		loadingState = 'loading';

		servicesStore.update((state) => ({
			...state,
			currentPage: 1,
			hasMore: true,
			lastRelayTimestamp: undefined,
			error: null,
			searchParamsKey: ''
		}));

		searchParams = {
			...getInitialSearchParams(),
			limit: searchParams.limit ?? 20,
			...filterParams,
			page: 1
		};
		searchQuery = filterParams.search || '';

		await persistServiceSearchFilters(searchParams);
		await findServicesWithTimeout(searchParams);
		isApplyingFilters = false;
		isFilterDrawerOpen = false;

		servicesStore.update((state) => ({
			...state,
			searchParamsKey: hashSearchParams(searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)
		}));
		loadingState = 'loaded';
		syncScrollHasMore();

		// Show banner after results load
		const shouldSuppressFilter = isNative && isSearchInputFocused;
		if (shouldSuppressFilter) {
			pendingSaveSearchParams = { ...searchParams };
		} else {
			pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
			await manageSaveSearchBanner(
				searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
				'services',
				() => (isSaveSearchOpen = true),
				{
					deferred: true,
					deferMs: 2000
				}
			);
		}
	}

	async function clearFilters() {
		searchQuery = '';
		const currentLimit = searchParams.limit;
		searchParams = { ...getInitialSearchParams(), limit: currentLimit };

		pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
		cancelDeferredBanner();
		await dismissSaveSearchBanner();

		// Abort any in-flight search
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}

		// CRITICAL: set loading state BEFORE clearing the store (same race as debouncedSearch)
		loadingState = 'loading';

		servicesStore.update((state) => ({
			...state,
			currentPage: 1,
			hasMore: true,
			lastRelayTimestamp: undefined,
			error: null,
			searchParamsKey: ''
		}));

		await persistServiceSearchFilters(searchParams);
		isApplyingFilters = true;
		await findServicesWithTimeout(searchParams);
		servicesStore.update((state) => ({
			...state,
			searchParamsKey: hashSearchParams(searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>)
		}));
		loadingState = 'loaded';
		isApplyingFilters = false;
		syncScrollHasMore();
	}

	// ── BTC Price ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	async function fetchBtcPrice(): Promise<void> {
		if (browser) {
			const cached = sessionStorage.getItem(BTC_PRICE_CACHE_KEY);
			if (cached) {
				try {
					const { price, timestamp } = JSON.parse(cached);
					if (Date.now() - timestamp < BTC_PRICE_CACHE_TTL) {
						btcPrice = price;
						return;
					}
				} catch {
					// corrupted cache, ignore
				}
			}
		}
		try {
			const timeoutPromise = new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
				setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('BTC price fetch timed out')), BTC_PRICE_TIMEOUT_MS);
			});
			btcPrice = await Promise.race([cryptoPriceService.getCurrentPrice('BTC'), timeoutPromise]);
			if (browser) {
				sessionStorage.setItem(
					BTC_PRICE_CACHE_KEY,
					JSON.stringify({ price: btcPrice, timestamp: Date.now() })
				);
			}
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error fetching BTC price:', error);
		}
	}

	// ── Lazy loading ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	async function loadMapComponent(): Promise<void> {
		if (mapLoaded) return;
		try {
			TaskLocationMap = (await import('$lib/components/maps/TaskLocationMap.svelte')).default;
			mapLoaded = true;
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading service map component:', error);
		}
	}

	async function loadRequestQuoteModal(): Promise<void> {
		if (modalLoaded) return;
		try {
			RequestQuoteModal = (await import('$lib/components/service/RequestQuoteModal.svelte'))
				.default;
			modalLoaded = true;
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading request quote modal:', error);
		}
	}

	async function loadDrawerComponents(): Promise<void> {
		if (drawersLoaded) return;
		try {
			const saveSearchModule = await import('$lib/components/service/SaveServiceSearchForm.svelte');
			SaveServiceSearchForm = saveSearchModule.default;
			drawersLoaded = true;
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading save search component:', error);
		}
	}

	function attemptMapPreload(): (() => void) | null {
		if (!browser || mapLoaded || mapPreloadAttempted) return null;
		mapPreloadAttempted = true;

		if (windowWidth >= DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH) {
			void loadMapComponent();
			return null;
		}

		let idleCallbackId: number | undefined;
		let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

		if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
			idleCallbackId = window.requestIdleCallback(
				() => {
					if (!mapLoaded) void loadMapComponent();
				},
				{ timeout: MAP_PRELOAD_TIMEOUT_MS }
			);
		} else {
			timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
				if (!mapLoaded) void loadMapComponent();
			}, MAP_PRELOAD_FALLBACK_MS);
		}

		return () => {
			if (idleCallbackId && window.cancelIdleCallback) {
				window.cancelIdleCallback(idleCallbackId);
			}
			if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
		};
	}

	// ── View & Navigation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	function toggleViewMode() {
		viewMode = viewMode === 'list' ? 'map' : 'list';
		if (viewMode === 'map' && !mapLoaded) {
			void loadMapComponent();
		}

		// On mobile, prevent scrolling when in map view
		if (browser) {
			const scrollEl = document.querySelector('.app-shell__content');
			if (scrollEl instanceof HTMLElement) {
				if (viewMode === 'map' && windowWidth < DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH) {
					scrollEl.style.overflowY = 'hidden';
				} else {
					scrollEl.style.overflowY = '';
				}
			}
		}
	}

	function selectServiceForMap(service: Service) {
		selectedServiceForMap = service;
		scrollToServiceCard(service.id);
	}

	async function scrollToServiceCard(serviceId: string) {
		await tick();
		if (!serviceListRef) return;
		const cardElement = serviceListRef.querySelector<HTMLElement>(
			`[data-service-id="${serviceId}"]`
		);
		if (cardElement) {
			cardElement.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
		}
	}

	// ── Quote modal ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	async function openRequestQuoteModal(service: Service) {
		if (isOwnService(service)) {
			appStore.showErrorToast(
				browseText(
					'dashboard.services.browse.self_quote_blocked',
					"You can't request a quote on your own service."
				)
			);
			return;
		}

		if (!$authState.isAuthenticated) {
			goto(`/auth/login?returnTo=${encodeURIComponent('/services')}`);
			return;
		}
		await loadRequestQuoteModal();
		await tick();
		serviceForQuote = service;
		requestQuoteModalOpen = true;
	}

	async function handleQuoteRequestConfirm(
		payload: QuoteRequestPayload
	): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
		if (!serviceForQuote) {
			return {
				success: false,
				error: $t('dashboard.services.browse.quote_request_unavailable')
			};
		}

		const result = await serviceQuoteUiStore.submitQuoteRequest({
			service: serviceForQuote,
			payload
		});

		if (!result.success || !result.quoteRequestId) {
			return {
				success: false,
				error: result.error || $t('dashboard.services.browse.quote_request_submit_error')
			};
		}

		appStore.showSuccessToast($t('dashboard.services.browse.quote_request_submitted'));
		await goto(
			`/hiring/service-requests?view=tasker&request=${encodeURIComponent(result.quoteRequestId)}`
		);
		serviceForQuote = null;
		return { success: true };
	}

	function getSearchPlaceholder(): string {
		if (searchQuery.length > 0 && searchQuery.length < 3) {
			return $t('dashboard.services.browse.search_minimum_chars');
		}
		return $t('dashboard.services.browse.search_placeholder');
	}

	// ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
	onMount(() => {
		if (!browser) return;

		windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
		fetchBtcPrice();

		// Scroll-to-top visibility — $appScrollContainer is set by the layout's onMount
		const scrollEl = $appScrollContainer ?? document.querySelector('.app-shell__content');
		let cleanupScroll: (() => void) | undefined;
		if (scrollEl instanceof HTMLElement) {
			const onScroll = () => {
				showScrollToTop = scrollEl.scrollTop > SCROLL_TO_TOP_THRESHOLD;
			};
			scrollEl.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
			cleanupScroll = () => scrollEl.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
		}

		// Load persisted search filters before fetching data
		const initPromise = (async () => {
			const persistedFilters = await loadPersistedServiceSearchFilters();
			if (persistedFilters) {
				searchParams = {
					...getInitialSearchParams(),
					...persistedFilters,
					page: 1,
					limit: searchParams.limit ?? 20
				};
				searchQuery = searchParams.search ?? '';
			}

			const savedParamsRaw = sessionStorage.getItem('savedServiceSearchParams');
			if (savedParamsRaw) {
				try {
					const saved = JSON.parse(savedParamsRaw) as SearchServicesParams;
					sessionStorage.removeItem('savedServiceSearchParams');
					searchParams = {
						...getInitialSearchParams(),
						...saved,
						page: 1,
						limit: searchParams.limit ?? 20
					};
					searchQuery = saved.search ?? '';
				} catch (e) {
					console.warn('[FindServices] Invalid savedServiceSearchParams', e);
				}
			}
		})();

		loadingState = 'loading';

		initPromise.then(() => {
			if (unmounted) return;
			loadNostrData().then(() => {
				if (unmounted) return;
				// Measure controls height for sticky map offset
				const controlsWrapper = document.querySelector('.services-controls-wrapper');
				if (controlsWrapper) {
					const height = controlsWrapper.getBoundingClientRect().height;
					document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--listing-controls-height', `${height}px`);
				}
			});
		});

		const cleanupMapPreload = attemptMapPreload();

		// Defer loading save-search drawer
		if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
			window.requestIdleCallback(() => loadDrawerComponents(), { timeout: 1500 });
		} else {
			setTimeout(loadDrawerComponents, 500);
		}

		return () => {
			cleanupMapPreload?.();
			cleanupScroll?.();
		};
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (!browser) return;
		unmounted = true;

		if (loadingTimeoutTimer) {
			clearTimeout(loadingTimeoutTimer);
			loadingTimeoutTimer = null;
		}

		debouncedSearch.abort();
		cancelDeferredBanner();
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}
		cleanup();
	});
</script>

										>

									{retryLoading ? 'Retrying...' : $t('dashboard.services.browse.refresh')}

import type { LayoutLoad } from './$types';
import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import { Preferences } from '@capacitor/preferences';
import { authState } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
import { StorageKeys } from '$lib/utils/constants/storage';
import { tryCatch } from '$lib/utils/tryCatch';
import { user } from '$lib/stores/user.store';

export const load: LayoutLoad = async ({ url }) => {
	// Only check authentication on the client side
	if (browser) {
		// Use a dynamic import so WebKit does not race the async i18n module initialization.
		void import('$lib/i18n/routeTranslations').then(({ loadPageTranslations }) =>
			loadPageTranslations(url.pathname)
		);

		let token: string | null = null;
		try {
			const result = await Preferences.get({ key: StorageKeys.ACCESS_TOKEN });
			token = result.value;
		} catch {
			token = null;
		}

		if (token && token !== null) {
			// User is authenticated, initialize user data
			await tryCatch(user.getUserData());
			authState.login();
		}
	}
};

// Disable SSR for public routes in Capacitor
export const ssr = false;

		formatStandardDateShort,
		parseDateToLocalMidnight
	} from '$lib/utils/helpers/dateFormatter';
	import { locale } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import { TASKS_PER_PAGE } from '$lib/stores/task.store';
	import { debounceWithAbort } from '$lib/utils/helpers/common';
	import { taskTranslationService } from '$lib/services/task-translation.service';
	import { currentUserLanguage } from '$lib/stores/translation.store';
	import { LRUCache } from '$lib/utils/helpers/lru-cache';
	import TaskCard from '$lib/components/task/TaskCard.svelte';
	import cryptoPriceService from '$lib/api/services/crypto-price.service';
	import Drawer from '$lib/components/Drawer.svelte';
	import TaskListSkeleton from '$lib/components/task/TaskListSkeleton.svelte';
	import TaskListControls from '$lib/components/task/TaskListControls.svelte';
	import {
		manageSaveSearchBanner,
		dismissSaveSearchBanner,
		cancelDeferredBanner
	} from '$lib/utils/saveSearchBanner';

	// Icon imports for unplugin-icons
	import IconAlertCircle from '~icons/mdi/alert-circle';
	import IconChevronUp from '~icons/mdi/chevron-up';
	import IconMagnify from '~icons/mdi/magnify';

	// ============================================================================
	// CONSTANTS - Organized by category
	// ============================================================================

	// Scroll constants
	const SCROLL_TO_TOP_THRESHOLD = 300; // px - Show scroll to top button after scrolling this distance

	// Search constants
	const SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DELAY = 1000; // ms - Delay before executing search
	const SEARCH_MIN_LENGTH = 3; // Minimum characters for search

	// Layout constants
	const DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH = 1024; // Desktop breakpoint in pixels
	const DATE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE = 1000; // Maximum entries in LRU cache for date formatting

	// Data loading constants
	const BTC_PRICE_FALLBACK = 120000; // Default fallback BTC price in USD
	const LOADING_TIMEOUT_MS = 30000; // 30 seconds timeout for loading

	// Map preload timing constants
	const MAP_PRELOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 2000; // Load within 2 seconds even if not idle
	const MAP_PRELOAD_FALLBACK_MS = 1000; // Fallback timeout for browsers without requestIdleCallback
	const DRAWER_CLOSE_DELAY_MS = 300; // Delay for drawer close animation

	// Lazy loaded components with proper types
	let TaskLocationMap: typeof TaskLocationMapComponent | null = $state(null);
	let FilterDrawer: typeof FilterDrawerComponent | null = $state(null);
	let BidForm: typeof BidFormComponent | null = $state(null);
	let SaveSearchForm: typeof SaveSearchFormComponent | null = $state(null);
	let TaskTab: typeof TaskTabComponent | null = $state(null);

	// Configure the layout's InfiniteScroll component at init time
	scroll.set({
		hasMore: true,
		threshold: 500,
		elementScroll: null,
		page: 0,
		horizontal: false,
		loadMore: async () => {
			if (!$tasksStore.hasMore || $tasksStore.loading) return;

			const lastRelayTs = $tasksStore.lastRelayTimestamp;
			const lastItem = $tasksStore.items[$tasksStore.items.length - 1];
			const cursorTimestamp = lastRelayTs ?? lastItem?.createdAt;
			if (!cursorTimestamp) return;

			try {
				const nextPage = $tasksStore.currentPage + 1;
				await findTasks({
					...searchParams,
					page: nextPage,
					until: cursorTimestamp - 1,
					limit: TASKS_PER_PAGE
				});
			} catch (error) {
				console.error('[FindTasks] Error loading more tasks:', error);
			}

			scroll.update((s) => ({ ...s, hasMore: $tasksStore.hasMore }));
		}
	});

	// Component loading states
	let drawersLoaded = $state(false);
	let mapLoaded = $state(false);

	// ============================================================================
	// INITIALIZATION FUNCTIONS
	// ============================================================================

	/**
	 * Create initial search parameters with defaults
	 */
	function getInitialSearchParams(): SearchTasksParams {
		return {
			taskType: undefined,
			categories: [],
			skills: [],
			page: 1,
			limit: TASKS_PER_PAGE,
			budget: {
				tier: undefined,
				currency: undefined,
				type: undefined
			},
			search: ''
		};
	}

	// Reactive state for search parameters and UI controls
	let searchParams = $state<SearchTasksParams>(getInitialSearchParams());
	let searchQuery = $state('');

	// Enhanced discovery features
	let isFilterDrawerOpen = $state(false);

	// Save search state
	let isSaveSearchOpen = $state(false);
	let isSearchInputFocused = $state(false);
	let pendingSaveSearchParams: SearchTasksParams | null = null;
	const isNative = Capacitor.isNativePlatform();
	let searchVersion = $state(0);
	let searchAbortController: AbortController | null = null;

	// Loading states - consolidated into single state machine
	type LoadingState = 'initial' | 'loading' | 'loaded' | 'timeout' | 'error';
	let loadingState = $state<LoadingState>('initial');

	// Derived loading state flags for backward compatibility
	let showSkeleton = $derived(loadingState === 'initial' || loadingState === 'loading');

	// Scroll state
	// Using $state.raw for DOM element reference - only reassigned, not mutated
	let taskListRef = $state.raw<HTMLElement | null>(null);

	// Scroll to top button state
	let showScrollToTop = $state(false);

	// BTC price for USDT conversion
	let btcPrice = $state<number>(BTC_PRICE_FALLBACK);

	// View mode state - Airbnb style toggle
	let viewMode = $state<'list' | 'map'>('list');

	// Selected task for map display (separate from bid task to avoid conflicts)
	let selectedTaskForMap = $state<Task | null>(null);

	// Selected task for bid drawer (separate from map selection)
	let selectedTaskForBid = $state<Task | null>(null);

	// Derived: Check if map is visible (desktop sidebar or mobile map view)
	const isMapVisible = $derived(mapLoaded && (viewMode === 'list' || viewMode === 'map'));

	// Bid drawer state
	let isBidOpen = $state(false);

	// Task details drawer state
	let selectedTaskForDetails = $state<Task | null>(null);
	let isTaskDetailsOpen = $state(false);

	// Infinite scroll state - use atomic flag to prevent race conditions
	let isLoadingMore = $state(false);

	// ============================================================================
	// STORE MANAGEMENT FUNCTIONS
	// ============================================================================

	/**
	 * Clear tasks store - extracted to reduce duplication
	 */
	function clearTasksStore(): void {
		tasksStore.update((state) => ({
			...state,
			items: [],
			currentPage: 1,
			hasMore: true,
			error: null,
			searchParamsKey: ''
		}));
	}

	// ============================================================================
	// DATE FORMATTING - LRU Cache with max 1000 entries
	// ============================================================================

	// LRU caches for date formatting (max 1000 entries each)
	const dateFormatterCache = new LRUCache<string, string>(DATE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE);
	const dateRangeFormatterCache = new LRUCache<string, string>(DATE_CACHE_MAX_SIZE);

	// Current locale for cache key optimization
	let currentLocale = $state($locale || 'en');

	// ============================================================================
	// REACTIVE EFFECTS - Optimized and combined where appropriate
	// ============================================================================

	// Clear cache when locale changes
	$effect(() => {
		const newLocale = $locale || 'en';
		if (newLocale !== currentLocale) {
			currentLocale = newLocale;
			dateFormatterCache.clear();
			dateRangeFormatterCache.clear();
		}
	});

	/**
	 * Format a single date string with caching
	 * Uses optimized cache key: just the date string + locale
	 */
	function formatDateTimeReactive(dateString: string): string {
		if (!dateString) return '';

		// Optimized cache key: dateString + locale (no pipe separator needed)
		const cacheKey = `${dateString}:${currentLocale}`;
		const cached = dateFormatterCache.get(cacheKey);
		if (cached !== undefined) {
			return cached;
		}

		const date = parseDateToLocalMidnight(dateString);
		if (!date) return '';

		const formatted = formatStandardDateShort(date, currentLocale);
		dateFormatterCache.set(cacheKey, formatted);
		return formatted;
	}

	/**
	 * Format a date range with caching
	 * Uses optimized cache key: start|end:locale
	 */
	function formatDateRangeReactive(startDateString: string, endDateString: string): string {
		if (!startDateString && !endDateString) return '';

		// Optimized cache key: start|end:locale
		const cacheKey = `${startDateString || ''}|${endDateString || ''}:${currentLocale}`;
		const cached = dateRangeFormatterCache.get(cacheKey);
		if (cached !== undefined) {
			return cached;
		}

		const formatValue = (value: string) => {
			if (!value) return '';
			const date = parseDateToLocalMidnight(value);
			if (!date) return '';
			return formatStandardDateShort(date, currentLocale);
		};

		const startFormatted = formatValue(startDateString);
		const endFormatted = formatValue(endDateString);

		let formatted: string;
		if (startFormatted && endFormatted) {
			formatted = `${startFormatted} - ${endFormatted}`;
		} else {
			formatted = startFormatted || endFormatted || '';
		}

		dateRangeFormatterCache.set(cacheKey, formatted);
		return formatted;
	}

	// ============================================================================
	// SCROLL FUNCTIONS
	// ============================================================================

	function scrollToTop(): void {
		$appScrollContainer?.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
	}

	// Configure the layout's InfiniteScroll component
	// After filter/view changes, dispatch scroll event to trigger fallback check.
	function syncScrollHasMore() {
		scroll.update((s) => ({ ...s, hasMore: $tasksStore.hasMore }));

		if (browser && $tasksStore.hasMore && !$tasksStore.loading) {
			requestAnimationFrame(() => {
				const scrollEl = document.querySelector('.app-shell__content');
				if (scrollEl) {
					scrollEl.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll'));
				}
			});
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Lazy load drawer components after initial render
	 */
	async function loadDrawerComponents(): Promise<void> {
		if (drawersLoaded) return;
		try {
			const [filterModule, bidFormModule, saveSearchModule, taskTabModule] = await Promise.all([
				import('$lib/components/filters/FilterDrawer.svelte'),
				import('$lib/components/bidding/BidForm.svelte'),
				import('$lib/components/task/SaveSearchForm.svelte'),
				import('$lib/components/task/details/TaskTab.svelte')
			]);
			FilterDrawer = filterModule.default;
			BidForm = bidFormModule.default;
			SaveSearchForm = saveSearchModule.default;
			TaskTab = taskTabModule.default;
			drawersLoaded = true;
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading drawer components:', error);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Attempt to preload map component with proper cleanup tracking
	 * Returns cleanup function to cancel the preload if component unmounts
	 */
	function attemptMapPreload(reason: 'view-mode' | 'resize' | 'mount'): (() => void) | null {
		// Prevent multiple preload attempts
		if (mapLoaded || mapPreloadAttempted) return null;

		const isMobileOrTablet = windowWidth < DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH;
		const isDesktop = windowWidth >= DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH;

		// Only preload on mobile/tablet, or if explicitly requested for mount (desktop)
		if (reason === 'mount' && isDesktop) {
			// Desktop: load immediately on mount
			mapPreloadAttempted = true;
			loadMapComponent();
			return null;
		}

		if (!isMobileOrTablet && reason !== 'mount') {
			return null;
		}

		mapPreloadAttempted = true;

		let idleCallbackId: number | undefined;
		let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;

		if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
			idleCallbackId = window.requestIdleCallback(
				() => {
					if (!mapLoaded) {
						loadMapComponent();
					}
				},
				{ timeout: MAP_PRELOAD_TIMEOUT_MS }
			);
		} else {
			// Fallback for browsers without requestIdleCallback
			timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
				if (!mapLoaded) {
					loadMapComponent();
				}
			}, MAP_PRELOAD_FALLBACK_MS);
		}

		// Return cleanup function
		return () => {
			if (idleCallbackId && window.cancelIdleCallback) {
				window.cancelIdleCallback(idleCallbackId);
			}
			if (timeoutId) {
				clearTimeout(timeoutId);
			}
		};
	}

	/**
	 * Lazy load map component
	 * Permission check removed for faster loading - map component handles geolocation internally
	 */
	async function loadMapComponent(): Promise<void> {
		if (mapLoaded) return;

		try {
			TaskLocationMap = (await import('$lib/components/maps/TaskLocationMap.svelte')).default;
			mapLoaded = true;
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error loading map component:', error);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Fast hash function for search params to avoid expensive JSON.stringify
	 * Creates a deterministic hash from search parameters
	 */
	function hashSearchParams(params: SearchTasksParams): string {
		// Create a stable string representation without JSON.stringify overhead
		const parts: string[] = [];

		if (params.search) parts.push(`s:${params.search}`);
		if (params.taskType) parts.push(`t:${params.taskType}`);
		if (params.page) parts.push(`p:${params.page}`);
		if (params.limit) parts.push(`l:${params.limit}`);
		if (params.until) parts.push(`u:${params.until}`);

		if (params.categories?.length) {
			parts.push(`c:${[...params.categories].sort().join(',')}`);
		}
		if (params.skills?.length) {
			parts.push(`sk:${[...params.skills].sort().join(',')}`);
		}

		if (params.budget) {
			const b = params.budget;
			if (b.tier) parts.push(`bt:${b.tier}`);
			if (b.currency) parts.push(`bc:${b.currency}`);
			if (b.type) parts.push(`bty:${b.type}`);
		}

		return parts.join('|');
	}

	/**
	 * Fetch current BTC price (deferred)
	 */
	async function fetchBtcPrice(): Promise<void> {
		try {
			btcPrice = await cryptoPriceService.getCurrentPrice('BTC');
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('Error fetching BTC price:', error);
			// Keep using fallback price
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Load Nostr data with proper state management
	 */
	async function loadNostrData(): Promise<void> {
		// Create a key from search params using fast hash function
		const currentSearchKey = hashSearchParams(searchParams);
		const searchChanged =
			$tasksStore.searchParamsKey !== '' && $tasksStore.searchParamsKey !== currentSearchKey;

		// Check if we already have tasks in store (from previous navigation)
		const hasExistingTasks = $tasksStore.items.length > 0;

		// If we have existing tasks and search hasn't changed, don't reload - just use what's in the store
		if (hasExistingTasks && !searchChanged) {
			$tasksStore.searchParamsKey = currentSearchKey;
			loadingState = 'loaded';
			return;
		}

		// Prevent multiple loads - if already loading, don't start another
		if ($tasksStore.loading) return;

		try {
			loadingState = 'loading';

			// Only load if we don't have tasks or search changed
			const newSearchParams: SearchTasksParams = {
				...searchParams,
				page: 1,
				limit: TASKS_PER_PAGE
			};

			// Only include until if it has a value
			if (searchParams.until !== undefined) {
				newSearchParams.until = searchParams.until;
			}

			searchParams = newSearchParams;

			// Clear existing tasks before loading (only if search changed)
			if (searchChanged || !hasExistingTasks) {
				clearTasksStore();
			}

			await findTasks(searchParams);

			$tasksStore.searchParamsKey = currentSearchKey;
			loadingState = 'loaded';
			syncScrollHasMore();
		} catch (error) {
			loadingState = 'error';
			// Set error in store for user-facing error message
			tasksStore.update((state) => ({
				...state,
				error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to load tasks'
			}));
		}
	}

	// ============================================================================
	// SEARCH FUNCTIONS
	// ============================================================================

	/**
	 * Debounced search function with proper error handling
	 */
	const debouncedSearch = debounceWithAbort(async () => {
		const currentVersion = ++searchVersion;
		const trimmedQuery = searchQuery.trim();
		const newSearchValue = trimmedQuery.length < SEARCH_MIN_LENGTH ? '' : trimmedQuery;

		// Abort any in-flight search request
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}
		searchAbortController = new AbortController();

		// Dismiss any pending deferred banner from a previous search
		cancelDeferredBanner();
		await dismissSaveSearchBanner();

		// Update searchParams and explicitly clear until for new search
		searchParams = {
			...searchParams,
			page: 1,
			search: newSearchValue,
			until: undefined,
			limit: TASKS_PER_PAGE
		};

		await loadNostrData();

		if (currentVersion !== searchVersion) return;

		// Show save search banner AFTER results load
		// On native mobile: suppress while keyboard is open, re-trigger on blur
		// On web: always show (no keyboard interruption)
		const shouldSuppress = isNative && isSearchInputFocused;
		if (shouldSuppress) {
			pendingSaveSearchParams = { ...searchParams };
			await dismissSaveSearchBanner();
		} else {
			pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
			await manageSaveSearchBanner(
				searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
				'tasks',
				() => (isSaveSearchOpen = true),
				{
					deferred: true,
					deferMs: 2500
				}
			);
		}
	}, SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_DELAY);

	/**
	 * Handle advanced filter drawer apply
	 */
	async function handleFilterApply(filters: SearchTasksParams) {
		isFilterDrawerOpen = false;

		// Abort any in-flight search
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}
		searchAbortController = new AbortController();

		// Clear existing tasks when applying new filters
		clearTasksStore();

		searchParams = {
			...getInitialSearchParams(),
			...filters,
			page: 1,
			until: undefined,
			limit: TASKS_PER_PAGE
		};

		// Update UI controls based on applied filters
		searchQuery = filters.search || '';

		try {
			await findTasks(searchParams);
		} catch (error) {
			tasksStore.update((state) => ({
				...state,
				error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to apply filters'
			}));
		}

		// Show banner after results load
		const shouldSuppressFilter = isNative && isSearchInputFocused;
		if (shouldSuppressFilter) {
			pendingSaveSearchParams = { ...searchParams };
		} else {
			pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
			await manageSaveSearchBanner(
				searchParams as unknown as Record<string, unknown>,
				'tasks',
				() => (isSaveSearchOpen = true),
				{
					deferred: true,
					deferMs: 2000
				}
			);
		}
	}

	/**
	 * Clear all filters and reset search
	 */
	async function clearFilters() {
		searchQuery = '';

		const currentLimit = searchParams.limit;
		searchParams = { ...getInitialSearchParams(), limit: currentLimit };

		pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
		cancelDeferredBanner();
		await dismissSaveSearchBanner();

		// Abort any in-flight search
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}

		// Clear existing tasks when clearing filters
		clearTasksStore();

		try {
			await findTasks(searchParams);
		} catch (error) {
			tasksStore.update((state) => ({
				...state,
				error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Failed to clear filters'
			}));
		}
	}

	// Load more tasks
	async function loadMoreTasks(minCount?: number) {
		// Prevent multiple simultaneous loads - check and set atomically
		if (!$tasksStore.hasMore || $tasksStore.loading || isLoadingMore) {
			return;
		}

		// Set loading flag immediately to prevent race conditions
		isLoadingMore = true;

		try {
			const nextPage = $tasksStore.currentPage + 1;

			// Use lastRelayTimestamp as the cursor — this tracks the oldest relay event
			// received regardless of how many were muted, preventing pagination drift.
			// Fall back to the last visible item's timestamp if not yet set.
			const lastRelayTs = $tasksStore.lastRelayTimestamp;
			const lastItem = $tasksStore.items[$tasksStore.items.length - 1];
			const cursorTimestamp = lastRelayTs ?? lastItem?.createdAt;

			if (!cursorTimestamp) {
				console.warn('[FindTasks] No cursor timestamp found, cannot load more');
				isLoadingMore = false;
				return;
			}

			const untilTimestamp = cursorTimestamp - 1;
			const limit = minCount ? Math.max(minCount, TASKS_PER_PAGE) : TASKS_PER_PAGE;

			searchParams = {
				...searchParams,
				page: nextPage,
				until: untilTimestamp,
				limit
			};

			await findTasks(searchParams);
		} catch (error) {
			console.error('[FindTasks] Error loading more tasks:', error);
		} finally {
			isLoadingMore = false;
		}
	}

	// Track if map preload has been attempted to avoid repeated checks
	let mapPreloadAttempted = $state(false);

	// Track window width for responsive map preloading
	// Initialize safely for SSR
	let windowWidth = $state(DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH);

	// Combined effect: Setup scroll listener and loading timeout management
	$effect(() => {
		// Handle loading timeout for Nostr data
		let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
		if ($tasksStore.loading && searchParams.page === 1 && loadingState === 'loading') {
			timer = setTimeout(() => {
				if ($tasksStore.loading && searchParams.page === 1 && loadingState === 'loading') {
					loadingState = 'timeout';
					// Set error in store for user-facing error message
					tasksStore.update((state) => ({
						...state,
						error: 'Request timed out. Please try again.'
					}));
				}
			}, LOADING_TIMEOUT_MS);
		}

		return () => {
			if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);
		};
	});

	// Combined effect: Map loading and preloading with proper cleanup
	$effect(() => {
		if (!browser) return;

		// Load map component immediately when view mode changes to 'map'
		// This ensures fast loading when user switches to map view
		if (viewMode === 'map' && !mapLoaded) {
			// Cancel any pending preload attempts and load immediately
			loadMapComponent();
		}

		// Preload map component on mobile/tablet when in list view (only once)
		// This helps prepare the map for faster switching
		let preloadCleanup: (() => void) | null = null;
		if (viewMode === 'list' && !mapLoaded && !mapPreloadAttempted) {
			preloadCleanup = attemptMapPreload('view-mode');
		}

		return () => {
			// Cleanup preload if component unmounts or view mode changes
			if (preloadCleanup) {
				preloadCleanup();
			}
		};
	});

	// Window resize handler for responsive map preloading
	// Throttled to prevent excessive calls and forced reflows
	$effect(() => {
		if (!browser) return;

		// Initialize window width on mount
		windowWidth = window.innerWidth;

		let preloadCleanup: (() => void) | null = null;
		let resizeTimeout: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

		const handleResize = () => {
			// Throttle resize handler to prevent excessive calls
			if (resizeTimeout) {
				clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
			}

			resizeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
				resizeTimeout = null;
				// Use requestAnimationFrame to batch DOM reads
				requestAnimationFrame(() => {
					windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
					// If window resizes to mobile/tablet and map hasn't been preloaded, attempt it
					if (windowWidth < DESKTOP_MIN_WIDTH && !mapLoaded && !mapPreloadAttempted) {
						// Cleanup any existing preload attempt
						if (preloadCleanup) {
							preloadCleanup();
						}
						preloadCleanup = attemptMapPreload('resize');
					}
				});
			}, 150); // Throttle resize to 150ms
		};

		window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize, { passive: true });
		return () => {
			window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize);
			if (resizeTimeout) {
				clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
				resizeTimeout = null;
			}
			// Cleanup preload on unmount
			if (preloadCleanup) {
				preloadCleanup();
			}
		};
	});

	// Track cleanup functions for onMount operations
	let mountCleanup: {
		idleCallbackId?: number;
		timeoutId?: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
		preloadCleanup?: (() => void) | null;
	} = {};

	// Initial data fetch and setup
	onMount(async () => {
		if (browser && dev) {
			void import('$lib/utils/performance-testing-helper');
		}

		if (browser) {
			const savedParamsRaw = sessionStorage.getItem('savedSearchParams');
			if (savedParamsRaw) {
				try {
					const saved = JSON.parse(savedParamsRaw) as SearchTasksParams;
					sessionStorage.removeItem('savedSearchParams');
					searchParams = {
						...getInitialSearchParams(),
						...saved,
						page: 1,
						limit: TASKS_PER_PAGE
					};
				} catch (error) {
					console.warn('[FindTasks] Invalid savedSearchParams', error);
				}
			}
		}

		// Scroll-to-top visibility via $appScrollContainer
		const scrollEl = $appScrollContainer ?? document.querySelector('.app-shell__content');
		if (scrollEl instanceof HTMLElement) {
			const onScroll = () => {
				showScrollToTop = scrollEl.scrollTop > SCROLL_TO_TOP_THRESHOLD;
			};
			scrollEl.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
		}

		// Sync searchQuery with searchParams.search
		searchQuery = searchParams.search || '';

		// Scroll listeners are set up in $effect when taskListRef is available

		// Check if we have cached tasks that match current search
		const currentSearchKey = hashSearchParams(searchParams);
		const hasCachedData =
			$tasksStore.items.length > 0 && $tasksStore.searchParamsKey === currentSearchKey;

		// Load data if no cache or cache doesn't match
		if (!hasCachedData) {
			// Clear stale cache if exists (before calling loadNostrData)
			if ($tasksStore.items.length > 0 && $tasksStore.searchParamsKey !== currentSearchKey) {
				clearTasksStore();
			}
			// Always load if no cached data - loadNostrData will handle the logic
			loadNostrData();
		} else {
			// Use cached data
			loadingState = 'loaded';
		}

		// Defer non-critical operations
		if (browser) {
			const deferredOperations = () => {
				fetchBtcPrice();
				loadDrawerComponents();
				// Use reactive windowWidth instead of window.innerWidth
				// Attempt map preload for desktop (mount reason)
				mountCleanup.preloadCleanup = attemptMapPreload('mount');
			};

			if (window.requestIdleCallback) {
				mountCleanup.idleCallbackId = window.requestIdleCallback(deferredOperations);
			} else {
				mountCleanup.timeoutId = setTimeout(deferredOperations, 100);
			}
		}
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		if (mountCleanup.idleCallbackId && window.cancelIdleCallback) {
			window.cancelIdleCallback(mountCleanup.idleCallbackId);
		}
		if (mountCleanup.timeoutId) {
			clearTimeout(mountCleanup.timeoutId);
		}
		if (mountCleanup.preloadCleanup) {
			mountCleanup.preloadCleanup();
		}

		debouncedSearch.abort();
		cancelDeferredBanner();
		if (searchAbortController) {
			searchAbortController.abort();
		}
		cleanup();
	});

	// ============================================================================
	// DRAWER FUNCTIONS
	// ============================================================================

	const onSelectTask = async (task: Task) => {
		if (isBidOpen || task.status !== TaskStatusEnum.OPEN) return;

		if (!$user?.npub) {
			goto('/auth/signup').catch(() => {
				if (browser) window.location.href = '/auth/signup';
			});
			return;
		}

		if (task.npub === $user.npub) {
			appStore.showErrorToast($t('find_tasks.cannot_bid_own_task'));
			return;
		}

		if (!drawersLoaded) await loadDrawerComponents();
		selectedTaskForBid = task;
		isBidOpen = true;
	};

	const onViewTask = async (task: Task) => {
		if (isTaskDetailsOpen) return;
		if (!drawersLoaded) await loadDrawerComponents();
		selectedTaskForDetails = task;
		isTaskDetailsOpen = true;
	};

	function closeTaskDetails() {
		isTaskDetailsOpen = false;
		setTimeout(() => {
			if (!isTaskDetailsOpen) selectedTaskForDetails = null;
		}, DRAWER_CLOSE_DELAY_MS);
	}

	function closeBidDrawer() {
		isBidOpen = false;
		setTimeout(() => {
			if (!isBidOpen) selectedTaskForBid = null;
		}, DRAWER_CLOSE_DELAY_MS);
	}

	async function handleBidFromDetails() {
		if (isBidOpen || !selectedTaskForDetails) return;
		const task = selectedTaskForDetails;

		if (task.status !== TaskStatusEnum.OPEN) {
			appStore.showErrorToast(
				$t('find_tasks.task_no_longer_open') || 'This task is no longer open for bidding'
			);
			return;
		}
		if (!$user?.npub) {
			goto('/auth/signup').catch(() => {
				if (browser) window.location.href = '/auth/signup';
			});
			return;
		}
		if (task.npub === $user.npub) {
			appStore.showErrorToast($t('find_tasks.cannot_bid_own_task'));
			return;
		}

		isTaskDetailsOpen = false;
		selectedTaskForDetails = null;
		await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, DRAWER_CLOSE_DELAY_MS));

		if (!drawersLoaded) await loadDrawerComponents();
		selectedTaskForBid = task;
		isBidOpen = true;
	}

	// Function to get dynamic placeholder
	function getSearchPlaceholder(): string {
		if (searchQuery.length > 0 && searchQuery.length < 3) {
			return $t('find_tasks.search_minimum_chars');
		}
		return $t('find_tasks.search_placeholder');
	}

	// Function to get search input class
	function getSearchInputClass(): string {
		let baseClass = 'input input-bordered w-full pl-10';

		if (searchQuery.length > 0 && searchQuery.length < 3) {
			baseClass += ' input-warning';
		} else if (searchQuery.length >= 3) {
			baseClass += ' input-success';
		}

		return baseClass;
	}

	// ============================================================================
	// TASK SELECTION FUNCTIONS
	// ============================================================================

	/**
	 * Handle task selection for map display
	 */
	function selectTaskForMap(task: Task) {
		selectedTaskForMap = task;
	}

	// Toggle view mode function
	function toggleViewMode() {
		viewMode = viewMode === 'list' ? 'map' : 'list';
	}

	// ============================================================================
	// TASK DETAILS DRAWER DERIVED VALUES
	// ============================================================================

	const taskDetailsTitle = $derived.by(() => {
		if (!selectedTaskForDetails) return $t('dashboard.task_details_by_task.title');
		const userLang = $currentUserLanguage;
		if (userLang && selectedTaskForDetails.translations?.sourceLanguage !== userLang) {
			const translation = taskTranslationService.getStoredTranslation(
				selectedTaskForDetails,
				userLang
			);
			if (translation?.translatedTitle) return translation.translatedTitle;
		}
		return selectedTaskForDetails.title ?? $t('dashboard.task_details_by_task.title');
	});

	const isTaskOwner = $derived(
		!!selectedTaskForDetails && selectedTaskForDetails.npub === $user?.npub
	);
</script>

<!-- Mismas dimensiones que Mi Panel -->
<main
	class="find-tasks-container find-tasks-page mx-auto h-full min-h-0 w-full max-w-6xl flex-1 px-2 py-6 md:px-0 md:py-0"
>
	<div
		id="panel-find-tasks"
		role="tabpanel"
		aria-labelledby="tab-find-tasks"
		class="flex min-h-0 min-h-full flex-col lg:min-h-0"
	>
		<!-- Search and Filter Controls — sticky wrapper -->
		<div class="tasks-controls-wrapper">
			<TaskListControls
				bind:searchQuery
				searchInputClass={getSearchInputClass()}
				searchPlaceholder={getSearchPlaceholder()}
				onSearchInput={debouncedSearch}
				onSearchFocus={() => {
					isSearchInputFocused = true;
					if (isNative) {
						cancelDeferredBanner();
						dismissSaveSearchBanner();
					}
				}}
				onSearchBlur={() => {
					isSearchInputFocused = false;
					if (isNative && pendingSaveSearchParams) {
						const params = { ...pendingSaveSearchParams };
						pendingSaveSearchParams = null;
						manageSaveSearchBanner(params, 'tasks', () => (isSaveSearchOpen = true), {
							deferred: true,
							deferMs: 1500
						});
					}
				}}
				onFilterClick={() => (isFilterDrawerOpen = true)}
				onSaveSearch={async () => {
					if (!drawersLoaded) await loadDrawerComponents();
					isSaveSearchOpen = true;
				}}
				canSaveSearch={$tasksStore.searchParamsKey !== ''}
				{viewMode}
				onToggleViewMode={toggleViewMode}
				user={$user}
				{drawersLoaded}
				{loadDrawerComponents}
			/>
		</div>

		<!-- Main Content Area - Flattened structure with grid layout -->
		<section class="min-h-0 flex-1" data-tasks-content-area>
			<!-- Main Content - Dynamic Layout based on view mode -->
			{#if viewMode === 'list'}
				<!-- List View - Simplified grid layout -->
				<div class="grid min-h-0 grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2" data-tasks-list-view>
					<!-- Error Message (full width across both columns) -->
					{#if $tasksStore.error}
						<div class="col-span-full mb-3">
							<div class="alert alert-error alert-outline mb-3">
								<IconAlertCircle class="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 stroke-current" />
								<span>{$t('find_tasks.error_loading').replace('{error}', $tasksStore.error)}</span>
							</div>
						</div>
					{/if}

					<!-- Tasks List (scrolls) - Grid column 1 -->
					<div class="min-h-0" data-tasks-list-column bind:this={taskListRef}>
						<!-- Skeleton Loading -->
						{#if showSkeleton}

<script lang="ts">
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { AuthService } from '$lib/api/services/auth.service';
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { goto } from '$app/navigation';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';

	let error: string | null = $state(null);
	let isVerifying = $state(true);

	onMount(async () => {
		const token = page.url.searchParams.get('token');

		if (!token) {
			error =
				$t('verify_email.errors.invalid_token') || 'Invalid verification link. No token provided.';
			isVerifying = false;
			return;
		}

		try {
			const authService = new AuthService();
			await authService.verifyEmail(token);
			// After successful verification, redirect to login page
			goto('/auth/login');
		} catch {
			error =
				$t('verify_email.errors.verification_failed') ||
				'Failed to verify email. The link might be expired or invalid.';
			isVerifying = false;
		}
	});
</script>

<div class="mx-2 flex grow items-center justify-center">
	<div class="bg-base-100 w-full max-w-md rounded-lg p-8 shadow-lg">
		{#if isVerifying}
			<div class="text-center">
				<h2 class="mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold">
					{$t('verify_email.verifying_title') || 'Verifying your email...'}
				</h2>
				<div class="flex justify-center">
					<div
						class="border-primary h-8 w-8 animate-spin rounded-full border-4 border-t-transparent"
					></div>
				</div>
			</div>
		{:else if error}
			<div class="text-center">
				<h2 class="mb-4 text-2xl font-semibold text-red-600">
					{$t('verify_email.verification_failed_title') || 'Verification Failed'}
				</h2>
				<p class="text-base-content">{error}</p>
				<a href="/auth/login" class="text-primary btn btn-ghost btn-outline mt-4 hover:underline">
					{$t('verify_email.return_to_login') || 'Return to Login'}
				</a>
			</div>
		{/if}
	</div>
</div>

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { browser } from '$app/environment';
	import { page } from '$app/state';
	import { authState } from '$lib/stores/auth.store';
	import { appScrollContainer } from '$lib/stores/scrollContainer.store';
	import BottomNavBar from '$lib/components/BottomNavBar.svelte';
	import ProtectedTopBar from '$lib/components/topbar/ProtectedTopBar.svelte';
	import PublicTopBar from '$lib/components/topbar/PublicTopBar.svelte';
	import Toast from '$lib/components/Toast.svelte';
	import BlockchainToast from '$lib/components/wallet/BlockchainToast.svelte';
	import InfiniteScroll from '$lib/components/InfiniteScroll.svelte';

	const { children } = $props();

	// Derive layout state from current route
	const currentPath = $derived(page.url.pathname);
	const showTopBar = $derived(!currentPath.includes('/onboarding'));

	/**
	 * Route group `(protected)` is omitted from the URL but present in `page.route.id`
	 * (e.g. `/(protected)/reviews` → pathname `/reviews`). Use this for parent-shell
	 * behavior without maintaining a pathname allowlist per new route.
	 * @see https://svelte.dev/docs/kit/advanced-routing#Advanced-layouts-group
	 */
	const isProtectedRoute = $derived(
		page.route.id != null && page.route.id.includes('/(protected)')
	);

	// Generate breadcrumbs from current path
	const breadcrumbList = $derived.by(() => {
		if (page.url.pathname === '/') return {};

		const segments = page.url.pathname.split('/').filter(Boolean);
		return {
			'@context': 'https://schema.org',
			'@type': 'BreadcrumbList',
			itemListElement: segments.map((segment: string, i: number) => ({
				'@type': 'ListItem',
				position: i + 1,
				name: segment.replace(/-/g, ' ').replace(/\b\w/g, (c: string) => c.toUpperCase()),
				item: `https://bittasker.com/${segments.slice(0, i + 1).join('/')}`
			}))
		};
	});

	let scrollEl = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);
	let cleanupKb: (() => void) | undefined;
	let footerEl = $state<HTMLElement | null>(null);
	let footerObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;

	// Fetch notification unread count and connect WebSocket for ALL authenticated routes.
	// The bell icon renders in ProtectedTopBar for any authenticated user, so the count
	// must be available even on non-protected routes like /tasks and /services.
	// Note: re-login also triggers this via setupAuthData() in auth.store.ts, since
	// onMount only fires once per component lifecycle.
	async function fetchNotificationCount() {
		if (!$authState.isAuthenticated) return;

		try {
			const { notificationCenterStore } = await import('$lib/stores/notificationCenter.store');
			await notificationCenterStore.fetchUnreadCount();

			const { connectNotificationSocket } = await import(
				'$lib/api/services/notificationSocket.service'
			);
			await connectNotificationSocket();
		} catch {
			// Notification init is non-critical — don't break the layout
		}
	}

	// Device store: only needed under (protected)/; follow `isProtectedRoute` on client navigations.
	$effect(() => {
		if (!browser || !isProtectedRoute) return;

		let cancelled = false;

		const run = async () => {
			if (cancelled) return;
			const deviceModule = await import('$lib/stores/device.store');
			if (cancelled) return;
			await Promise.all([
				deviceModule.initializeDevicePlatform(),
				deviceModule.getOnboardingCompleted()
			]);
		};

		let idleCallbackId = 0;
		let timeoutId: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
		let scheduledWithIdleCallback = false;

		if (typeof requestIdleCallback !== 'undefined') {
			scheduledWithIdleCallback = true;
			idleCallbackId = requestIdleCallback(() => void run(), { timeout: 2000 });
		} else {
			timeoutId = setTimeout(() => void run(), 100);
		}

		return () => {
			cancelled = true;
			if (scheduledWithIdleCallback) {
				cancelIdleCallback(idleCallbackId);
			}
			if (timeoutId !== undefined) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
		};
	});

	onMount(() => {
		import('$lib/utils/helpers/keyboard').then((m) => {
			m.initKeyboard().then((cleanup: () => void) => {
				cleanupKb = cleanup;
			});
		});

		// Primary app scroll container (middle area in app-shell layout)
		appScrollContainer.set(scrollEl);

		void fetchNotificationCount();

		// Re-fetch notification count when app resumes from background.
		// This reconciles any missed WebSocket events during the background period.
		let lastResumeFetch = 0;
		const RESUME_DEBOUNCE_MS = 30_000;

		const handleVisibilityChange = () => {
			if (document.visibilityState === 'visible' && $authState.isAuthenticated) {
				const now = Date.now();
				if (now - lastResumeFetch > RESUME_DEBOUNCE_MS) {
					lastResumeFetch = now;
					import('$lib/stores/notificationCenter.store')
						.then(({ notificationCenterStore }) => notificationCenterStore.fetchUnreadCount())
						.catch(() => {});

					// Reconnect NDK relays — the OS may have killed WebSocket connections
					// while the app was backgrounded. Without this, subscriptions on pages
					// like /task/[taskId]/bids would query stale relays and get zero events.
					import('$lib/nostr/ndk').then(({ ndk }) => ndk.connect().catch(() => {})).catch(() => {});
				}
			}
		};

		document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);

		return () => {
			cleanupKb?.();
			appScrollContainer.set(null);
			document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', handleVisibilityChange);
		};
	});

	// Measure the actual footer height and expose it as a CSS variable.
	// This avoids any bottom-nav overlap caused by height rounding, fonts, or safe-area differences.
	$effect(() => {
		if (footerObserver) {
			footerObserver.disconnect();
			footerObserver = null;
		}

		// If the footer is unmounted (or not rendered on desktop), ensure we don't keep a stale value.
		if (!footerEl) {
			if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
				document.documentElement.style.removeProperty('--app-footer-height');
			}
			return;
		}

		if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;

		let mq: MediaQueryList | null = null;
		const onMqChange = () => updateVar();

		function updateVar() {
			const el = footerEl;
			if (!el || typeof document === 'undefined') return;

			// Desktop (lg+) has no bottom dock/footer; avoid leaving a stale mobile value around.
			const isLgUp =
				typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)').matches;
			if (isLgUp) {
				document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-footer-height', `0px`);
				return;
			}

			// Avoid setting 0px during first paint / hidden states, which would
			// cause bottom-positioned UI to slip under the dock.
			const measured = Math.ceil(el.getBoundingClientRect().height ?? 0);
			if (measured <= 0) {
				// If the footer is actually hidden by CSS, 0 is correct.
				const isHidden =
					typeof window !== 'undefined' &&
					(window.getComputedStyle(el).display === 'none' ||
						window.getComputedStyle(el).visibility === 'hidden');
				if (isHidden) {
					document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-footer-height', `0px`);
				} else {
					// When switching from desktop->mobile, the footer can briefly report 0 before layout stabilizes.
					// Use the safe fallback immediately so floating UI doesn't get covered by the dock.
					document.documentElement.style.setProperty(
						'--app-footer-height',
						`var(--bottom-nav-height-safe)`
					);
				}
				return;
			}
			const h = Math.max(0, measured);
			document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-footer-height', `${h}px`);
		}

		updateVar();
		// Keep the variable in sync across breakpoint changes.
		if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
			mq = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)');
			try {
				mq.addEventListener('change', onMqChange);
			} catch {
				// Safari fallback
				mq.addListener(onMqChange);
			}
		}
		footerObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => updateVar());
		footerObserver.observe(footerEl);

		return () => {
			footerObserver?.disconnect();
			footerObserver = null;
			if (mq) {
				try {
					mq.removeEventListener('change', onMqChange);
				} catch {
					mq.removeListener(onMqChange);
				}
			}
		};
	});
</script>

<svelte:head>
	<!-- Breadcrumb JSON-LD (app-specific, other SEO in root layout) -->
	{#if page.url.pathname !== '/'}
		<!-- eslint-disable svelte/no-at-html-tags -->
		{@html `<\u{73}cript type="application/ld+json">${JSON.stringify(breadcrumbList)}</script>`}
		<!-- eslint-enable svelte/no-at-html-tags -->
	{/if}
</svelte:head>

{#if showTopBar}
	<header class="app-shell__header">
		<!-- ProtectedTopBar only for authenticated users (avoids passkey prompt on public/auth routes).
		     Unauthenticated users on public routes (tasks, services, auth) see PublicTopBar. -->
		{#if $authState.isAuthenticated}
			<ProtectedTopBar />
		{:else}
			<PublicTopBar />
		{/if}
	</header>
{/if}

<!-- Scrollable middle content. This is the ONLY app-level scroll container. -->
<div bind:this={scrollEl} class="app-shell__content bg-base-200">
	<div class="bg-base-200 flex shrink-0 grow basis-auto flex-col">
		{@render children()}
	</div>
</div>

<!-- Toast notifications (fixed positioned) -->
<Toast />

<!-- Blockchain activity toast (persistent, below Toast at z-40) -->

<!-- BottomNavBar: Show on mobile/tablet (≤1024px) -->
{#if showTopBar}
	<footer bind:this={footerEl} class="app-shell__footer lg:hidden">
		<BottomNavBar />
	</footer>
{/if}

<InfiniteScroll />

<!-- Global portal target — overlays (dropdowns, modals) teleport here to escape
     overflow:hidden/overflow-x:hidden ancestors that break fixed positioning -->
<div id="portal-root" style="position:relative;z-index:9999;"></div>

import type { LayoutLoad } from './$types';
import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import { Preferences } from '@capacitor/preferences';
import { StorageKeys } from '$lib/utils/constants/storage';
import '$lib/utils/deep-link';

export const prerender = false;
export const ssr = false;
export const csr = true;

if (browser) {
	import('$lib/utils/debug').then(({ initDebug }) => initDebug());
}

export const load: LayoutLoad = async () => {
	if (browser) {
		const { value: npubHex } = await Preferences.get({ key: StorageKeys.NPUB });
		if (npubHex) {
			import('$lib/nostr/muteList')
				.then(({ fetchMuteList }) => fetchMuteList(npubHex))
				.catch(() => {});
		}
	}

	return {};
};

export async function load({ url }) {
	const baseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_CLIENT_URL || 'https://bittasker.com').replace(/\/$/, '');

	return {
		title: 'About BitTasker - Decentralized Bitcoin Task Marketplace',
		description:
			"Learn about BitTasker's mission to empower global earning through Bitcoin and decentralized technology. Discover our censorship-resistant task marketplace.",
		keywords:
			'BitTasker, Bitcoin marketplace, decentralized tasks, cryptocurrency earning, peer-to-peer jobs, Bitcoin Lightning Network, financial freedom, censorship-resistant, task platform, Bitcoin escrow',
		canonical: `${baseUrl}${url.pathname}`,
		image: 'https://bittasker.com/images/logos/bittasker-logomark.svg',
		ogTitle: 'About BitTasker - Decentralized Bitcoin Task Marketplace',
		ogDescription:
			'BitTasker empowers everyday people to earn, trade, and thrive without borders, banks, or barriers. Learn about our mission to build a decentralized future of work.',
		twitterTitle: 'About BitTasker - Powering Human Freedom One Task at a Time',
		twitterDescription:
			'Learn how BitTasker is building a decentralized Bitcoin task marketplace that empowers financial freedom and removes barriers to global earning.',
		jsonLd: {
			'@context': 'https://schema.org',
			'@type': 'WebPage',
			name: 'About BitTasker',
			description:
				"Learn about BitTasker's mission to empower global earning through Bitcoin and decentralized technology.",
			url: `${baseUrl}${url.pathname}`
		}
	};
}

<script lang="ts">
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import type { PageData } from './$types';

	let { data: seo }: { data: PageData } = $props();

	let openAccordion = $state({
		taskers: -1,
		taskees: -1
	});

	function toggleAccordion(category: keyof typeof openAccordion, index: number) {
		if (openAccordion[category] === index) {
			openAccordion[category] = -1; // Close if already open
		} else {
			openAccordion[category] = index; // Open the new one
		}
	}
</script>

	let openAccordion = $state({
		general: -1,
		taskers: -1,
		taskees: -1,
		payment: -1,
		nostr: -1,
		safety: -1
	});

	function toggleAccordion(category: keyof typeof openAccordion, index: number) {
		if (openAccordion[category] === index) {

		}

export async function load({ url }) {
	const baseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_CLIENT_URL || 'https://bittasker.com').replace(/\/$/, '');

	return {
		title: 'BitTasker FAQ - Bitcoin Task Marketplace Questions',
		description: 'Find answers to frequently asked questions about BitTasker, including how to use our Bitcoin task marketplace, secure payment contracts, fees, and payment process.',
		keywords: 'BitTasker FAQ, Bitcoin task marketplace questions, Lightning Network FAQ, Bitcoin secure payment contracts, task marketplace help, cryptocurrency gig economy, Bitcoin payment questions',
		canonical: `${baseUrl}${url.pathname}`,
		ogTitle: 'BitTasker FAQ - Your Questions Answered',
		ogDescription: 'Get answers to common questions about BitTasker\'s Bitcoin task marketplace, including how our secure payment contract system works, fees, and payment process.',
		twitterTitle: 'BitTasker FAQ - Common Questions Answered',
		twitterDescription: 'Find answers to frequently asked questions about using BitTasker\'s Bitcoin-powered task marketplace and secure payment contract system.',
		jsonLd: {
			'@context': 'https://schema.org',
			'@type': 'FAQPage',
			mainEntity: [
				{
					'@type': 'Question',
					name: 'What is BitTasker?',
					acceptedAnswer: {
						'@type': 'Answer',
						text: 'BitTasker is a trusted community platform that connects people who need to outsource tasks and find local services with people who are looking to earn money and ready to work.'
					}
				},
				{
					'@type': 'Question',
					name: 'How does BitTasker\'s secure payment contract system work?',
					acceptedAnswer: {
						'@type': 'Answer',
						text: 'Our Bitcoin secure payment contract system uses smart contracts on the Rootstock network to hold payments until tasks are completed satisfactorily, protecting both task posters and workers.'
					}
				},
				{
					'@type': 'Question',
					name: 'What fees does BitTasker charge?',
					acceptedAnswer: {
						'@type': 'Answer',
						text: 'BitTasker uses a tiered fee structure that rewards loyalty. Fees range from 7.5% to 12.5% depending on your activity level in the past 30 days.'
					}
				},
				{
					'@type': 'Question',
