<script lang="ts">
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	// Icon imports for unplugin-icons
	import IconFileUpload from '~icons/mdi/file-upload';
	import IconHandshake from '~icons/mdi/handshake';
	import IconLock from '~icons/mdi/lock';
	import IconClockOutline from '~icons/mdi/clock-outline';
	import IconLightningBolt from '~icons/mdi/lightning-bolt';
	import IconMessageText from '~icons/mdi/message-text';

	let { data: seo } = $props();

	// State to track which detailed step section is open
	let openStepSection = $state<number>(-1);

	// State for tasker/taskee accordion in step 3
	let openTaskTalentSection = $state<number>(-1); // Default to closed

	// Function to toggle between step sections
	function toggleStepSection(index: number): void {
		if (openStepSection === index) {
			openStepSection = -1; // Close if already open
		} else {
			openStepSection = index; // Open the new one
		}
	}

	// Function to toggle between tasker and taskee accordion
	function toggleTaskTalentSection(index: number): void {
		if (openTaskTalentSection === index) {
			openTaskTalentSection = -1; // Close if already open
		} else {
			openTaskTalentSection = index; // Open the new one
		}
	}
</script>

	// Function to toggle FAQ sections
	function toggleFaqSection(index: number): void {
		if (openFaqSection === index) {

<script lang="ts">
	import Logo from '$lib/components/Logo.svelte';
	import { t } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import IconEmailOutline from '~icons/mdi/email-outline';

	let { data: seo } = $props();

	const user = 'hello';
	const domain = 'bittasker.com';
	const mailtoHref = `mailto:${user}@${domain}`;

	// State to track which security best practice is open
	let openPractice = $state(-1);

	function togglePractice(index: number) {
		if (openPractice === index) {
			openPractice = -1; // Close if already open
		} else {
			openPractice = index; // Open the new one
		}
	}
</script>

export async function load({ url }) {
	const baseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_CLIENT_URL || 'https://bittasker.com').replace(/\/$/, '');

	return {

		canonical: `${baseUrl}${url.pathname}`,
		ogTitle: 'Taskee Fees & Earnings - BitTasker',
		ogDescription: 'Maximize your Bitcoin earnings on BitTasker with our transparent taskee fee structure. Loyalty rewards for active workers.',
		twitterTitle: 'BitTasker Taskee Fees - Maximize Your Bitcoin Earnings',

			'@context': 'https://schema.org',

				'@type': 'PriceSpecification',

<script lang="ts">
	import { browser } from '$app/environment';
	import { t as i18nT } from 'svelte-i18n';
	import PublicTopBar from '$lib/components/topbar/PublicTopBar.svelte';
	import BitTaskerFooter from '$lib/components/BitTaskerFooter.svelte';

	const { children, data } = $props();

	function delve(obj: unknown, fullKey: string): string | undefined {
		if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return undefined;
		const keys = fullKey.split('.');
		let result: unknown = obj;
		for (const key of keys) {
			if (result && typeof result === 'object') {
				result = (result as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
			} else {
				return undefined;
			}
		}
		return typeof result === 'string' ? result : undefined;
	}

	function t(key: string): string {
		if (browser) {
			const i18nValue = $i18nT(key);
			if (i18nValue && i18nValue !== key) return i18nValue;
		}
		if (data?.translations) {
			const value = delve(data.translations, key);
			if (value) return value;
		}
		return $i18nT(key);
	}

--- C:\Users\jonat\Documents\BitTasker\src\routes\(company)\+layout.ts ---
import { mergeTranslations } from '$lib/i18n/ssr';
export const prerender = false;
export const ssr = false;

export async function load({ fetch }) {
	const [homeResponse, commonResponse] = await Promise.all([
		fetch('/locales/en/home.json'),
		fetch('/locales/en/common.json')
	]);

	if (!homeResponse.ok || !commonResponse.ok) {
		console.warn('[company/+layout] Failed to load translations');
		return { translations: {} };
	}

	const [homeTranslations, commonTranslations] = await Promise.all([
		homeResponse.json(),
		commonResponse.json()
	]);

	const translations = mergeTranslations(homeTranslations, commonTranslations);

	return { translations };
}

	import FeaturedServiceCard from '$lib/components/homepage/FeaturedServiceCard.svelte';

	let { data: seo }: { data: PageData } = $props();

	function delve(obj: unknown, fullKey: string): string | undefined {
		if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object') return undefined;
		const keys = fullKey.split('.');
		let result: unknown = obj;
		for (const key of keys) {
			if (result && typeof result === 'object') {
				result = (result as Record<string, unknown>)[key];
			} else {
				return undefined;
			}
		}
		return typeof result === 'string' ? result : undefined;
	}

	const t = (key: string): string => {
		if (browser) {
			const i18nValue = $i18nT(key);
			if (i18nValue && i18nValue !== key) return i18nValue;
		}
		if (seo.translations) {
			const value = delve(seo.translations, key);
			if (value) return value;
		}
		return $i18nT(key);
	};

	// Initialize featured sections from load function data (fetched SSR-safe via nostr-tools)
	// untrack: seo is intentionally captured once at init — these sections manage their own state
	let featuredTasksState = $state<FeaturedSectionState<LiveTask>>(
		untrack(() => completeFeaturedSectionState(seo.homepageData?.tasks || [], null))
	);
	let featuredServicesState = $state<FeaturedSectionState<FeaturedService>>(
		untrack(() =>
			completeFeaturedSectionState(seo.homepageData?.services || [], null, { hideWhenEmpty: true })
		)
	);

	const jsonLdScript = $derived(
		seo.jsonLd
			? '<' + 'script type="application/ld+json">' + JSON.stringify(seo.jsonLd) + '</' + 'script>'
			: ''
	);

	type FeatureId = 'nostr' | 'bitcoin' | 'payments' | 'escrow';
	const featureIds: FeatureId[] = ['bitcoin', 'escrow', 'nostr', 'payments'];
	const featureImages: Record<FeatureId, string> = {
		nostr: '/images/features/nostr-decentralized.webp',
		bitcoin: '/images/features/bitcoin-money.webp',
		payments: '/images/features/pay-your-way.webp',
		escrow: '/images/features/bitcoin-escrow.webp'
	};
	const translationKeys = {
		bitcoin: {
			title: 'homepage.v2.trust.bitcoin.title' as const,
			description: 'homepage.v2.trust.bitcoin.description' as const
		},
		escrow: {
			title: 'homepage.v2.trust.escrow.title' as const,
			description: 'homepage.v2.trust.escrow.description' as const
		},
		nostr: {
			title: 'homepage.v2.trust.nostr.title' as const,
			description: 'homepage.v2.trust.nostr.description' as const
		},
		payments: {
			title: 'homepage.v2.trust.payments.title' as const,
			description: 'homepage.v2.trust.payments.description' as const
		}
	};

	let activeFeatureIndex = $state(0);

	function resolveHomepageTranslation(key: string, fallback: string): string {
		const value = t(key);
		return !value || value === key ? fallback : value;
	}

	let carouselInterval: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null;

	const rotateCarousel = () => {
		activeFeatureIndex = (activeFeatureIndex + 1) % featureIds.length;
	};
	const startCarouselRotation = () => {
		if (!carouselInterval) carouselInterval = setInterval(rotateCarousel, 5000);
	};
	const pauseCarouselRotation = () => {
		if (carouselInterval) {
			clearInterval(carouselInterval);
			carouselInterval = null;
		}
	};
	const resetCarouselRotation = () => {
		pauseCarouselRotation();
		startCarouselRotation();
	};

	onMount(() => {
		startCarouselRotation();
	});

	onDestroy(() => {
		pauseCarouselRotation();
	});
</script>

import { browser } from '$app/environment';
import { generateHomepageWebsiteJsonLd } from '$lib/utils/constants/seo.constants';
import type { HomepageData } from '$lib/services/homepageFetch';

const baseUrl = (import.meta.env.VITE_CLIENT_URL || 'https://bittasker.com').replace(/\/$/, '');

export async function load() {
	if (browser) {
		try {
			const { Preferences } = await import('@capacitor/preferences');
			const { StorageKeys } = await import('$lib/utils/constants/storage');
			const { value: token } = await Preferences.get({ key: StorageKeys.ACCESS_TOKEN });
			if (token) {
				const { redirect } = await import('@sveltejs/kit');
				redirect(303, '/hiring');
			}
		} catch (e) {
			if (e && typeof e === 'object' && 'status' in e) throw e;
		}
	}

	let homepageData: HomepageData = { tasks: [], services: [] };
	if (!browser) {
		try {
			const { fetchHomepageData } = await import('$lib/services/homepageFetch');
			homepageData = await fetchHomepageData(8);
		} catch {
			// Non-critical
		}
	}

	return {
		title: 'BitTasker - The Decentralized Workforce',
		description:
			'Hire skilled professionals for any task. Pay with Bitcoin, Lightning, or dollars. Built on Nostr. Join the decentralized workforce on BitTasker - the Bitcoin-powered task marketplace.',
		keywords:
			'BitTasker, Bitcoin marketplace, decentralized tasks, cryptocurrency earning, peer-to-peer jobs, Bitcoin Lightning Network, financial freedom, censorship-resistant, task platform, Bitcoin escrow, freelancers, gig economy, Bitcoin payments',
		canonical: `${baseUrl}/`,
		ogTitle: 'BitTasker - The Decentralized Workforce',
		ogDescription:
			'Hire skilled professionals for any task. Pay with Bitcoin, Lightning, or dollars. Built on Nostr. Join the decentralized workforce on BitTasker.',
		ogImage: `${baseUrl}/images/logos/bittasker-logomark-og.webp`,
		ogLocale: 'en_US',
		twitterTitle: 'BitTasker - The Decentralized Workforce',
		twitterDescription:
			'Hire skilled professionals for any task. Pay with Bitcoin, Lightning, or dollars. Join the decentralized workforce on BitTasker.',
		twitterImage: `${baseUrl}/images/logos/bittasker-logomark-og.webp`,
		jsonLd: generateHomepageWebsiteJsonLd(`${baseUrl}/`),
		homepageData
	};
}

<script lang="ts">
	import { onMount } from 'svelte';
	import { initializeTheme } from '$lib/stores/theme.store';
	import { applyIOSPwaSafeAreaFix } from '$lib/utils/helpers/iosPwa';
	import { initializeStatusBar } from '$lib/utils/helpers/statusBar';
	import { hideSplashScreenWhenReady } from '$lib/utils/helpers/splashScreen';
	import {
		BITTASKER_ORG_JSONLD,
		BITTASKER_SITE_NAVIGATION_JSONLD
	} from '$lib/utils/constants/seo.constants';
	import '../app.css';

	const { children } = $props();

	$effect.pre(() => {
		applyIOSPwaSafeAreaFix();
	});

	onMount(() => {
		initializeTheme();
		initializeStatusBar();
		hideSplashScreenWhenReady(300);

		const CHUNK_RELOAD_KEY = `chunk-reload-${__BUILD_VERSION__}`;

		const onPreloadError = (event: Event & { payload: Error }) => {
			if (!sessionStorage.getItem(CHUNK_RELOAD_KEY)) {
				event.preventDefault();
				sessionStorage.setItem(CHUNK_RELOAD_KEY, '1');
				location.reload();
			}
		};

		const onError = (event: ErrorEvent) => {
			const error = event.error;
			if (error === null || error === undefined) return;

			const errorMessage =
				error instanceof Error ? error.message : typeof error === 'string' ? error : String(error);
			if (!errorMessage || errorMessage === 'null' || errorMessage === 'undefined') return;

			console.error('[Global Error Handler]:', {
				error: errorMessage,
				stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
				type: 'error',
				timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
			});
			event.preventDefault();
		};

		const onUnhandledRejection = (event: PromiseRejectionEvent) => {
			const error = event.reason;
			if (error === null || error === undefined) return;

			const errorMessage =
				error instanceof Error ? error.message : typeof error === 'string' ? error : String(error);
			if (!errorMessage || errorMessage === 'null' || errorMessage === 'undefined') return;

			console.error('[Global Error Handler]:', {
				error: errorMessage,
				stack: error instanceof Error ? error.stack : undefined,
				type: 'unhandledrejection',
				timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
			});
		};

		window.addEventListener('vite:preloadError', onPreloadError);
		window.addEventListener('error', onError);
		window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', onUnhandledRejection);

		return () => {
			window.removeEventListener('vite:preloadError', onPreloadError);
			window.removeEventListener('error', onError);
			window.removeEventListener('unhandledrejection', onUnhandledRejection);
		};
	});
</script>
